The raw files say nothing about an expression signal either way. Raw file reads: "Purpose: Check plasmid size before DNA sequencing ... A1-3, A1-4, A1-8, A1-9, A2-6 : Pveg-RBS0-Ho1:PcyA-B0015"

title.zh: 五個恆常表現構築的統一架構
title.en: One shared architecture for five constitutive constructs

statement.zh: 五個恆常表現構築都用 Pveg、EEBD-RBS0、分泌訊號（SamyQ 或 Csn）、His 標籤與 B0015，組裝進 pSTK-EXP1-sfGFP 穿梭載體。
statement.en: All five constitutive constructs use Pveg, EEBD-RBS0, a secretion signal (SamyQ or Csn), a His tag and B0015, assembled into the pSTK-EXP1-sfGFP shuttle vector.

status_note.zh: 共用架構與穿梭載體沒錯——8/21 與 8/26 的 Golden Gate 記錄都寫「Vector (shuttle vector): pSTK-EXP-1-sfGFP」，其他部件為 Pveg、EEBD-RBS0 與 B0015——但「帶 His 標籤」並非五個都成立。SnapGene 產物中兩個 AmilCP 載貨（pSTK-EXP1-Pveg-EEBD-RBS0-Csn-AmilCP-B0015、pSTK-EXP1-Pveg-EEBD-RBS0-SamyQ-TAT-HA-AmilCP-B0015）完全沒有 6xHis 標註。凡有標註的，His 一律在 CDS 的 3' 端，也就是 C 端（待確認項目 37）。（原始檔："Vector (shuttle vector):  pSTK-EXP-1-sfGFP"）
status_note.en: The shared architecture and the shuttle vector are right - the 21 and 26 August Golden Gate entries name 'Vector (shuttle vector): pSTK-EXP-1-sfGFP' with Pveg, EEBD-RBS0 and B0015 as the other parts - but 'a His tag' is not true of all five. In the SnapGene products the two AmilCP cargoes (pSTK-EXP1-Pveg-EEBD-RBS0-Csn-AmilCP-B0015, pSTK-EXP1-Pveg-EEBD-RBS0-SamyQ-TAT-HA-AmilCP-B0015) carry no 6xHis feature at all. Where a tag is annotated it is always at the 3' end of the CDS, i.e. C-terminal (open item 37). Raw file reads: "Vector (shuttle vector):  pSTK-EXP-1-sfGFP"

statement.zh: 模組 H（Pveg-EEBD-RBS0-Csn:LEA-B0015）在建置紀錄裡沒有 clone 也沒有日期。
statement.en: Module H, Pveg-EEBD-RBS0-Csn:LEA-B0015, has no clone and no date on record.

status_note.zh: 濕式實驗檔案與「沒有 clone、沒有日期」的記錄相矛盾。7/25 的膠以 Exp fw / Exp seq 4 rv 篩 H1-H10（Pveg-EEBD-RBS0-csn::Lea-B0015）預期 1372 bp；7/26 miniprep 膠列出該構築的 H3、H7，3296 bp；7/26 實驗記錄以 BsmbI 切 H3、H7，全長 7030 bp，目的寫明「before DNA sequencing」；8 月膠資料夾還有一張 8/13 的「PCR of H (after sequencing)」，以 EEBD F / LEA R 判讀 H1，預期 735 bp。可見模組 H 有 H3、H7、H1 等 clone 且已送定序，缺的是定序結果。（原始檔："H1-H10: Pveg-EEBD-RBS0-csn::Lea-B0015 | Exp fw | Exp seq 4 rv | 1372"）
status_note.en: The wet lab files contradict 'no clone and no date on record'. The 25 July gel screens H1-H10 Pveg-EEBD-RBS0-csn::Lea-B0015 at 1372 bp (Exp fw / Exp seq 4 rv); the 26 July miniprep gel lists H3 and H7 of that construct at 3296 bp; the 26 July notebook digests H3 and H7 with BsmbI at full length 7030 bp 'before DNA sequencing'; and the August gel folder has a 13 August gel titled 'PCR of H (after sequencing)' reading H1 with EEBD F / LEA R at 735 bp. So module H had clones H3, H7 and H1 and was sequenced; what is missing is the sequencing outcome. Raw file reads: "H1-H10: Pveg-EEBD-RBS0-csn::Lea-B0015 | Exp fw | Exp seq 4 rv | 1372"

title.zh: 連續三輪 Level 2 組裝沒有結果

status_note.zh: 8 月膠標籤檔提供了日期。ACDI/ABDI 的 Level 2 菌落 PCR 用同一對引子（CcaR fw / PcpcG2-veg rv，1032-1045 bp）跑了三輪且全數失敗：8/4「All fail -> Retransform 0804」（W/X/V）、8/9「All fail -> RE-GGA」（X/V）、8/13 X1-X24 與 V1-V24 皆「all failed(re-gga)」。8/12 另有一輪 X/V 沒有備註。設計要到 8/26 的 Golden Gate 才改變，也就是掃插入片段與載體比例那一次。（原始檔："X1-24: ACDI | CcaR F | PcpcG2-veg R | 1032 ... Note: -> all failed(re-gga)"）
status_note.en: The August gel labels give the dates. Three Level-2 colony PCR rounds of ACDI/ABDI were run with the same primer pair (CcaR fw / PcpcG2-veg rv, 1032-1045 bp) and all failed: 4 August 'All fail -> Retransform 0804' (W/X/V), 9 August 'All fail -> RE-GGA' (X/V), and 13 August 'all failed(re-gga)' for X1-X24 and again for V1-V24. A further X/V round on 12 August carries no note. The design only changed at the 26 August Golden Gate, where the insert-to-vector ratio was swept. Raw file reads: "X1-24: ACDI | CcaR F | PcpcG2-veg R | 1032 ... Note: -> all failed(re-gga)"

statement.en: Sorted into fours, the green low group holds 2.33 to 2.34 and the green mid group 2.35 to 2.37, both inside 1 %, and the red groups hold to about 2 %.

status_note.zh: 綠光高強度組 2.38 到 2.42（約 1.7%），是剩下湊成的一組。
status_note.en: The green high group spans 2.38 to 2.42, about 1.7 %, and is the leftover group.

wiki.quote: the green low group holds 2.33 to 2.34 and the green mid group 2.35 to 2.37

title.zh: 三個強度層級不是靠 LED 挑選達成
title.en: The tiers do not come from LED selection

statement.zh: 分組後綠光低到高只差約 4%、紅光約 10%，因此強度層級必須由 PWM 工作週期決定，而不是 LED 挑選。
statement.en: Green low to green high is about 4 % and red low to red high about 10 % after sorting, so the tiers have to come from the PWM duty cycle rather than from LED selection.

status_note.zh: Results 指出實際量到的綠光通道只差約 3%，而分出層級的工作週期沒有紀錄。
status_note.en: Results notes the measured green channels differ by about 3 % and the duty cycles that would separate the tiers are unrecorded.

wiki.quote: Green low to green high is about 4% and red low to red high about 10%
the measured green channels span 2.33 to 2.40 kLux, a spread of about three per cent

title.zh: 整夜運轉弄斷底板立柱
title.en: The overnight run snapped a post off the base plate

statement.zh: 整夜在搖床上的測試弄斷底板上的連接立柱、扯鬆數條導線，白色試管座還讓光漏到鄰孔；修復後底板改用四顆螺絲、試管座改黑色且壁厚由兩圈增為四圈，修復尚未再測。
statement.en: The overnight run on a shaker snapped the connection post off the bottom plate, pulled wires loose and leaked light between wells; the repair uses all four screws, a black holder and walls four loops thick, and has not been through a second overnight run.

status_note.zh: 修復未經第二次整夜搖床測試驗證。
status_note.en: The repair has not been back on the shaker.

wiki.quote: The overnight run on a shaker snapped a post off the bottom plate
The overnight LPA runBrokeA snapped post and light between wells; the repair is untested

caption.zh: 封閉式 DiOPAL，24 個位置六種條件
caption.en: The enclosed DiOPAL, 24 positions under six conditions

title.zh: DiOPAL 的讀數單位是 lux 而非光子通量
title.en: DiOPAL readings are in lux, not photon flux

statement.zh: 這條軌道上的所有讀數都是 lux（以人眼視覺加權、峰值接近 555 nm），因此綠紅兩通道的加權誤差不同；對細胞有意義的是 µmol m−2 s−1 的光子通量，尚未換算。
statement.en: Every reading on this track is in lux, which is weighted for human vision and peaks near 555 nm, so the weighting error differs between the green and red channels; the dose that matters is photon flux in µmol m−2 s−1, which has not been computed.

status_note.zh: 在換算之前這些讀數只能彼此比較，不能與文獻劑量比較。
status_note.en: Until converted the readings compare the team's own LEDs with each other and cannot be compared with a published dose.

wiki.quote: Every reading on this track is in lux, which is weighted for human vision

title.zh: 光波長站內有兩組數字
title.en: Two sets of wavelengths on the wiki

statement.zh: Results 與首頁寫綠光 520 nm 誘導、紅光 660 nm 關閉；Engineering 寫約 535 nm 誘導、約 670 nm 停止，且說這些取自文獻、從未在自家零件上量過。
statement.en: Results and the homepage give green at 520 nm to induce and red at 660 nm to stop, while Engineering gives about 535 nm and about 670 nm and says these are taken from the literature and never measured on our own parts.

status_note.zh: 520/660 nm 對 535/670 nm；兩者都沒有自家量測。
status_note.en: 520/660 nm against 535/670 nm, with no in-house measurement behind either.

wiki.quote: green photons at 520 nm through the CcaS/CcaR two-component system, with red at 660 nm
about 535 nm to induce and about 670 nm to halt
Green light (520 nm) switches CcaS on in the membrane. Red light (660 nm) switches it off.

title.zh: 沒有任何誘導曲線
title.en: No induction curve exists

statement.zh: 專案中沒有任何實驗顯示 PcpcG2 的輸出隨綠光改變；DiOPAL 從未在活菌上跑過 CcaS/CcaR 實驗，也沒有任何劑量、時間或強度配上表現讀數。
statement.en: No experiment anywhere in the project shows PcpcG2 output changing with green light; the array has never run a CcaS/CcaR experiment on a live culture and no dose, duration or intensity has been paired with an expression readout.

status_note.zh: 與 WH-120 同一判讀：流程有寫，但沒有任何執行紀錄。流程規定每個時間點同時做 OD600 與 Western blot，若真的跑過應在筆記留下結果；四月到十月都沒有這類紀錄。這是濕式檔案中的缺席，不等於證明沒有跑過。（原始檔："From each of the 12 tubes take 200 uL: 100 uL for OD600 and 100 uL for Western blot."）
status_note.en: Same reading of the raw files as WH-120: the assay is written up but no run of it is recorded. The protocol pairs OD600 with a western blot at every time point, so an executed run should have left notebook results; nothing of the kind appears in April to October. This is absence in the wet lab files, not proof that no run happened. Raw file reads: "From each of the 12 tubes take 200 uL: 100 uL for OD600 and 100 uL for Western blot."

wiki.quote: No induction curve exists. Nothing anywhere in this project shows PcpcG2 output changing with green light
Light inductionOpenNothing shows PcpcG2 output changing with light

title.zh: 模型預測的 permeate 活性區間
title.en: The modelled permeate activity range

statement.zh: Math Model 預測的 permeate ACC deaminase 活性跨 0.039 到 14.8 mU mL−1，對照 1 mU mL−1 的驗收門檻；綠光劑量反應 K½ = 4.66 µmol m−2 s−1，22 °C 下綠光開啟後半衰時間 3.3 到 5.7 小時。
statement.en: The modelled permeate ACC deaminase activity spans 0.039 to 14.8 mU mL−1 against a 1 mU mL−1 acceptance gate, with a green-light dose-response K½ of 4.66 µmol m−2 s−1 and a modelled ON half time of 3.3 to 5.7 h at 22 °C.

status_note.zh: 全部是模型輸出而非量測，預測區間跨越門檻兩側。
status_note.en: Every number is a model output, not a measurement, and the prediction interval crosses the gate in both directions.

wiki.quote: the predicted permeate activity spanning 0.039 to 14.8 mU mL−1 against a 1 mU mL−1 acceptance gate

group.zh: Results 引用的植物頭條數字
group.en: Headline plant numbers quoted on Results

title.zh: 水耕資料無法歸因於任何保護劑
title.en: The hydroponic datasets cannot be attributed to a protectant

statement.zh: 兩組完整的水耕葉綠素資料存在，但沒有任何檔案寫明箱內加入的是什麼；熱逆境那組的條件欄只寫到「Conditions:」就結束。
statement.en: Two complete hydroponic chlorophyll datasets exist but no file names what went into the boxes, and the conditions section for the heat set stops at the word 'Conditions:' with nothing after it.

status_note.zh: 實驗記錄其實寫了箱內加入什麼。八月電子記錄：8/14 將 600 µL CH 保護劑加入 C2（前處理）、8/15 加入 C3（同時處理）、8/16 加入 C4（後處理），D1-D4 於 8/19 至 8/21 同樣處理；植物記錄本 7/25 將 600 µL 加入 box 4，7/28 將 600 µL 加入 box 1 並對 box 1-4 各加 10 mL 3M NaCl。熱逆境條件也有記錄：8/15 培養箱設定 37 °C、實測 33 °C，8/20 設定 50 °C、實測 35 °C。以上皆註明 Done by Alex。（原始檔："Add 600L CH protectant into C3 (co-treatment) ... Put all boxes into the incubator(setting 37℃, actual temperature 33℃)"）
status_note.en: The notebooks do name what went into the hydroponic boxes. The August lab notes record 600 uL of CH protectant into box C2 on 14 Aug (pre-treatment), into C3 on 15 Aug (co-treatment) and into C4 on 16 Aug (post-treatment), and the same pattern for boxes D1-D4 on 19-21 Aug; the Plant notebook records 600 uL into box 4 on 25 Jul and 600 uL into box 1 plus 10 mL of 3M NaCl into boxes 1-4 on 28 Jul. The heat conditions are logged as well: incubator set 37 C, actual 33 C on 15 Aug, and set 50 C, actual 35 C on 20 Aug. All of these entries are 'Done by Alex'. Raw file reads: "Add 600L CH protectant into C3 (co-treatment) ... Put all boxes into the incubator(setting 37℃, actual temperature 33℃)"

group.en: Headline plant numbers quoted on Results

title.zh: LEA14 與 BoPep4 從未施用於植物
title.en: LEA14 and BoPep4 have never been applied to a plant

statement.zh: 團隊自行設計的保護劑 LEA14 與 BoPep4 從未施用於植物；模組 G 失敗、模組 H 沒有 clone，SamyQ 融合直到八月底才組到 Level 1。
statement.en: The team's own designed protectants LEA14 and BoPep4 have never been applied to a plant: module G failed, module H produced no clone, and the SamyQ fusions were only assembled at Level 1 at the end of August.

wiki.quote: LEA14 and BoPep4 have never been applied to a plant
That LEA14 or BoPep4 does anything to a plant. Neither has ever been applied to one

title.zh: 現行浮板：42.27 cm³ 密閉空氣
title.en: Current plate: 42.27 cm³ of sealed air

statement.zh: 現行浮板由十六個 PLA 零件組成，兩個密閉腔室共 42.27 cm³ 空氣，吃水每增加 1 mm 船體增加 3.51 cm³。
statement.en: The current plate is sixteen PLA parts whose two chambers hold 42.27 cm³ of sealed air, and the hull gains 3.51 cm³ per millimetre of draft.

wiki.quote: the two chambers hold 42.27 cm³ of sealed air

title.zh: 浮板載重靈敏度 3.5 g 對 1 mm
title.en: Load sensitivity: 3.5 g per millimetre

statement.zh: 每增加約 3.5 g 載重浮板下沉約 1 mm；設計上水線在板下 6.0 mm、乾舷 9.2 mm，組裝後排水 54.2 cm³。
statement.en: Every 3.5 g added sinks the plate about 1 mm; as drawn the waterline sits 6.0 mm under the slab for a freeboard of 9.2 mm, where the assembled plate displaces 54.2 cm³.

status_note.zh: 沒有任何一塊浮板被秤過，乾舷也從未量測。
status_note.en: No plate has been on a balance and no run has had its freeboard measured.

wiki.quote: the waterline sits 6.0 mm under the slab, a freeboard of 9.2 mm
Plate buoyancyUnweighedThe load line is computed; no plate has been on a balance

title.zh: 十三個種植位置
title.en: Thirteen seed positions

statement.zh: 現行浮板有十三個種植位置，排成四、五、四三列。
statement.en: The current plate has thirteen seed positions in rows of four, five and four.

wiki.quote: thirteen seed positions in rows of four, five and four

title.zh: 矽砂理論值：1 mg/mL 約 OD600 2.3
title.en: Silica theory: 1 mg/mL is about OD600 2.3

statement.zh: 1 µm、折射率 1.46 的單分散矽砂微球，以 van de Hulst 近似計算 Qext ≈ 0.81，推得 1 mg/mL SiO2 約為 OD600 2.3（1 cm 光程）。
statement.en: For monodisperse silica microspheres of 1 µm and refractive index 1.46 the van de Hulst approximation gives Qext about 0.81 at 600 nm, putting 1 mg/mL of SiO2 at about OD600 2.3 at a 1 cm pathlength.

wiki.quote: a theoretical estimate of 1 mg/mL SiO2 ≈ OD600 2.3
puts 1 mg/mL of SiO2 at about OD600 2.3

title.zh: 光度計的量測方程式
title.en: The photometer's OD equation

statement.zh: 每次讀數為 OD600 = −log10[S / (K · R)]，K 由空白（培養基、無細胞）時的樣品除以參考通道決定，使 LED 漂移在長時間運轉中相消。
statement.en: Every live reading is OD600 = −log10[S / (K · R)], where a blank fixes K as the sample reading divided by the reference reading with medium and no cells, so LED drift divides out over a multi-week run.

status_note.zh: 長時間運轉的儀表板回報的是此值的五倍，還原後三個快照以同一個 K ≈ 9.16 重現。
status_note.en: The dashboard of the long run reported five times that value; with the factor restored all three snapshots reproduce on one K of about 9.16.

wiki.quote: every live reading is then OD600 = −log10[S / (K · R)]

title.zh: 離群值排除規則：14 次讀數取中位數
title.en: Rejection rule: a burst of fourteen readings, median taken

statement.zh: 每次讀數是 14 筆的一組，取中位數為值，超過中位數加減三倍中位絕對偏差者剔除；排除率超過 50% 時儀表板轉紅。
statement.en: Every reading is a burst of fourteen, the burst's median is its value, and anything beyond the median plus or minus three times the median absolute deviation is thrown out; above 50 % rejected the dashboard turns red.

status_note.zh: 規則在長時間運轉當時尚未寫下，42.9% 與 14.3% 分別等於 14 筆中的 6 與 2 筆。
status_note.en: The rule was not written down at the time of the long run; 42.9 % and 14.3 % are six and two readings out of fourteen.

wiki.quote: Every reading is a burst of fourteen, the burst's median is taken as its value

title.zh: 空白液體兩頁說法不同
title.en: Two records disagree on the blank liquid

statement.zh: 反應器紀錄寫空白改成蒸餾水以對齊驗證用的儀器；光度計紀錄寫空白必須帶有培養基自身的 600 nm 吸收，而以培養基作空白才讓讀值接近 Bio-Drop。
statement.en: The reactor record says the blank became distilled water to match the instrument validated against; the photometer record says the blank has to carry the medium's own 600 nm absorbance and that blanking on medium is what brought the readings close to the Bio-Drop.

status_note.zh: 兩者都在解釋同一個約 20% 的差異；cycle 3 表中的讀數是以培養基作空白。
status_note.en: Both describe the same roughly 20 % disagreement; the readings in the cycle 3 table are blanked on medium.

wiki.quote: The two hardware records state the blank differently

title.zh: 光度計的噪訊隨 OD 變化
title.en: Noise is not flat across the OD range

statement.zh: 光度計在約 0.4 OD 以下噪訊緊密，約 0.8 以上變得粗糙，因此有效精度並非全範圍一致。
statement.en: Noise is tight below about 0.4 OD and ragged above about 0.8, so the useful precision is not flat across the range.

wiki.quote: Noise is tight below about 0.4 OD and ragged above about 0.8

title.zh: 成本比較：自製約 150 美元對 BioDrop 約 15,000 美元
title.en: Cost: about $150 for our build against about $15,000 for the BioDrop

statement.zh: 長時間運轉所用的機型造價約 150 美元，對照用的 Bio-Drop 約 15,000 美元；簡化版預期再省約 70 美元、體積小三分之二，但目前仍是預期。
statement.en: The build the long run was made on cost about $150 against about $15,000 for the Bio-Drop it was checked against; a simplified build is expected to be two thirds smaller and $70 cheaper, which remains an expectation.

status_note.zh: 一份草稿寫簡化版準確、另一份寫未測試，沒有比較數據。
status_note.en: One draft reports the simplified build accurate, another reports it untested, and no comparison numbers exist.

wiki.quote: about $150 for the build the long run was made on and $15,000 for the Bio-Drop

title.zh: ACC deaminase 的分子量在站內有三個數字
title.en: Three molecular weights for ACC deaminase on the wiki

statement.zh: ACCD 的帶在 8/2 寫 35 到 40 kDa、8/24 寫約 41 kDa、反應器時序 blot 寫約 42 kDa，Engineering 另寫 ACC deaminase 約 36 kDa。
statement.en: The ACCD band is given as 35 to 40 kDa on 2 August, about 41 kDa on 24 August and about 42 kDa on the reactor time course, while Engineering also calls ACC deaminase roughly 36 kDa.

status_note.zh: 原始濕實驗檔案中沒有任何一處寫出 ACC deaminase 條帶的 kDa 值。八月膠標籤檔對兩張 Western blot（20260802 ACCD WB in B. subtilis 與 20260824 Western Blot）的「Expected Size (kDa)」欄都是空白，8/1-2、8/6-7、8/24、8/28-29、9/2、9/5 的筆記條目也都沒有寫帶的大小。檔案中唯一的 kDa 數字是 20260802 的 protein marker 刻度：180、130、100、75、63、48、35、28。因此站內四個數字（35 到 40、41、42、36 kDa）都是從照片讀出的，不是紀錄下來的數值；融合蛋白的理論質量在濕實驗檔案中完全沒有出現。（原始檔："Sample Protein / Construct Expected Size (kDa) ACCD 8/23 ACCD ACCD 8/18 ACCD"）
status_note.en: No raw wet lab file states a kDa value for any ACC deaminase band. In the August gel-label file the Expected Size (kDa) column is left empty for both western blots (20260802 ACCD WB in B. subtilis and 20260824 Western Blot), and no notebook entry for 1-2 Aug, 6-7 Aug, 24 Aug, 28-29 Aug, 2 Sep or 5 Sep gives a band size. The only kDa numbers in the archive are the 20260802 protein marker slide marks, 180, 130, 100, 75, 63, 48, 35 and 28. So all four wiki figures (35-40, 41, 42, 36 kDa) are reads off the photographs, not recorded numbers, and the fusion's computed mass appears nowhere in the wet lab files. Raw file reads: "Sample Protein / Construct Expected Size (kDa) ACCD 8/23 ACCD ACCD 8/18 ACCD"

with the ACC deaminase band at about 42 kDa

title.zh: 沒有任何 ACC deaminase 活性測定
title.en: No ACC deaminase activity assay exists

statement.zh: wet lab 檔案中沒有 ACC deaminase 活性測定、沒有 ELISA、也沒有酵素動力學；植物資料中標為 ACCD 的都是表型測試。
statement.en: There is no ACC deaminase activity measurement, no ELISA and no enzyme kinetics anywhere in the wet lab archive; everything labelled ACCD in the plant data is a phenotype test.

status_note.zh: 把濕實驗檔案全部搜過之後，沒有任何 ACC deaminase 活性測定、ELISA 或酵素動力學。DNPH 只出現一次，在 9/2 的 Bioreactor Sampling 條目，寫的是冷凍樣品未來的用途（「for ELISA and DNPH assay」）；Berthelot 完全沒有出現；其他「ELISA」都是量葉綠素與 OD600 用的 ELISA 盤讀機。_FILE_LISTING.txt 裡沒有任何活性、ELISA 或 DNPH 的資料檔。植物筆記本從頭到尾沒有提到 ACCD。（原始檔："Add 1mL 100X proteinase inhibitor to sample and storage in -80℃ for ELISA and DNPH assay"）
status_note.en: A full search of the wet lab archive finds no ACC deaminase activity assay, no ELISA and no enzyme kinetics. DNPH appears exactly once, in the 2 September Bioreactor Sampling entry, as the intended future use of frozen samples ('for ELISA and DNPH assay'); Berthelot appears nowhere; the other 'ELISA' hits are all the ELISA plate reader used for chlorophyll and OD600. _FILE_LISTING.txt contains no activity, ELISA or DNPH data file of any kind. The plant notebook never mentions ACCD at all. Raw file reads: "Add 1mL 100X proteinase inhibitor to sample and storage in -80℃ for ELISA and DNPH assay"

title.zh: Bradford、大量萃取、純化與透析都沒有結果

title.zh: 固定板時期需要每天補液
title.en: The fixed plate needed topping up by hand

statement.zh: 四月的固定板分別為 300 mL、1.5 L 與 2 L 三種箱體裁切，液位必須在每次試驗前以目視設定並在過程中補充，這正是浮板要移除的變因。

wiki.quote: Three plates cut, taped and drilled at 300 mL, 1.5 L and 2 L

title.zh: 自製穿梭載體後來發現多餘
title.en: The self-built shuttle vector turned out redundant

statement.zh: 四月在套件到貨前，團隊把 dropout 卡匣移進 pNW33N 自製 Golden Gate 穿梭載體；套件的 pSTK-EXP-1-sfGFP 本身就是由 pNW33N 改來的。
statement.en: In April, before the kit arrived, the team built its own Golden Gate shuttle vector by moving a dropout cassette into pNW33N; the kit's pSTK-EXP-1-sfGFP is itself pNW33N adapted for STK.

status_note.zh: 四月那次自建確認無誤。4/28 實驗記錄有兩則「Gibson assembly and Transformation／Purpose: To create the shuttle vector with MoClo 2.0 system」，把純化後的 pNW33N EcoRI/BtsI 切割產物（4021 bp）與 pJUMP49-2B PCR 產物（1207 bp，4/27 擴增的 sfGFP dropout）接在一起，塗在含氯黴素的培養盤；pNW33N 本身是 4/22 自 BCRC 復甦的。至於套件裡的 pSTK-EXP-1-sfGFP 是否就是同一個 pNW33N 骨架，濕式檔案完全沒有提到。（原始檔："Purpose: To create the shuttle vector with MoClo 2.0 system ... pNW33N enzyme digestion product ... pJUMP49-2B PCR product"）
status_note.en: Confirmed for the April build itself. The 28 April notebook has two entries titled 'Gibson assembly and Transformation / Purpose: To create the shuttle vector with MoClo 2.0 system', assembling the cleaned-up pNW33N EcoRI/BtsI digestion product (4021 bp) with the pJUMP49-2B PCR product (1207 bp, the sfGFP dropout amplified on 27 April), plated on chloramphenicol; pNW33N itself was recovered from BCRC on 22 April. Whether the kit's pSTK-EXP-1-sfGFP is the same pNW33N backbone is not stated anywhere in the wet lab files. Raw file reads: "Purpose: To create the shuttle vector with MoClo 2.0 system ... pNW33N enzyme digestion product ... pJUMP49-2B PCR product"

title.en: Well-to-well evenness was never measured

statement.en: An acceptance criterion for well-to-well evenness was written on 19 May and never measured, so the claim that every tube sees the same dose has no measurement behind it.

status_note.zh: 要關掉這一項需要二十四個位置的 lux 圖與寫下的工作週期。

title.zh: 光路三個固定距離
title.en: Three fixed distances in the light path

statement.zh: 光路量得 LED 尖端到聚焦透鏡 5.5 cm、透鏡到分光鏡中心 10 cm、分光鏡中心到每個感測器 2 cm，之後每一代機構都照這三個距離設計。
statement.en: The light path measures 5.5 cm from the LED tip to the focal lens, 10 cm from the lens to the centre of the beam splitter and 2 cm from the splitter to each sensor; every printed build is dimensioned from these.

wiki.quote: We measured the tip of the LED to the focal lens at 5.5 cm

title.zh: Prototype I 的最終 OD600：迴路 0.304 對對照 0.48
title.en: Prototype I final OD600: 0.304 in the loop against 0.48

statement.zh: 第一版結束時迴路內 OD600 為 0.304，對照為 0.480；lumen 序列迴歸的平均 OD 為 0.142，斜率 −0.0024 OD/h，p = 0.759。
statement.en: Version 1 ended at OD600 0.304 in the loop against 0.480 in the control, and a regression on the lumen series gives a mean OD of 0.142 with a slope of −0.0024 OD/h at p = 0.759.

status_note.zh: 六月實驗記錄本可以定案。6/6「Bacillus subtilis growth rate in bioreactor」每 30 分鐘記 OD600 至 390 分鐘；接續條目「Bacillus subtilis growth rate in Bioreater (Continuous from 20260606)」（Chars 做）記反應器 24 h 0.197、25 h 0.342、26 h 0.370、27 h 0.304，培養箱那一組為 2.169／2.461／2.402，另有一行「Sampling from medium : 0.480」。因此 0.304 是 27 h 的反應器讀值，0.480 是從培養液（medium）取樣，支持 Engineering 頁的「medium reservoir」寫法，而非 Results 頁的「serum-bottle control」。（原始檔："27 | - | 0.304 ... Sampling from medium : 0.480"）
status_note.en: The June lab notebook settles this. The 6 June entry 'Bacillus subtilis growth rate in bioreactor' logs OD600 every 30 min to 390 min, and the continuation entry 'Bacillus subtilis growth rate in Bioreater (Continuous from 20260606)' (done by Chars) gives 24 h 0.197, 25 h 0.342, 26 h 0.370, 27 h 0.304 for the reactor, with the incubator arm at 2.169/2.461/2.402 and a separate line 'Sampling from medium : 0.480'. So 0.304 is the 27 h reactor reading and 0.480 is a sample drawn from the medium, which supports the Engineering page's 'medium reservoir' wording rather than the Results page's 'serum-bottle control'. Raw file reads: "27 | - | 0.304 ... Sampling from medium : 0.480"

title.en: Incubation time and temperature were not recorded for the June plate

title.zh: 改用 SubtiToolKit
title.en: The build moved into the SubtiToolKit

statement.zh: 因 MoClo 2.0 效率低，整個建置改用 SubtiToolKit，Level 1 目標載體為 pSTK-1A 到 1D-sfGFP。
statement.en: Because MoClo 2.0 gave low efficiency the whole build moved into the SubtiToolKit, with pSTK-1A to 1D-sfGFP as the Level 1 destination vectors.

status_note.zh: SubtiToolKit 由一位與原始論文有關的教授提供，提供日期未記。

title.zh: Prototype II：攪拌 200 rpm、37 °C，兩小時達平台
title.en: Prototype II: 200 rpm stirring at 37 °C, plateau in about two hours

statement.zh: 6/14 的第二版加入 200 rpm 磁攪拌、把取樣口移到儲液瓶出口並在 37 °C 運轉，約兩小時達 OD600 0.8 到 0.9 的平台，搖瓶則約四個半小時達 0.6 到 0.8。
statement.en: On 14 June version 2 added 200 rpm magnetic stirring, moved the sampler to the reservoir outlet and ran at 37 °C, reaching plateau at OD600 0.8 to 0.9 in about two hours against a shake flask at 0.6 to 0.8 in about four and a half hours.

status_note.zh: build/drylab_notebook_wet.json 6/14 條目與兩頁敘述一致。
status_note.en: The 14 June entry in build/drylab_notebook_wet.json matches both pages.

title.zh: Prototype II 的三個變因同時改變
title.en: Three changes at once between prototype I and II

statement.zh: 攪拌、取樣位置與從室溫改到 37 °C 三件事同時發生，因此改善無法歸因於其中任何一項；室溫下單獨加攪拌的實驗沒有做。
statement.en: Stirring, the new sampling point and the move from room temperature to 37 °C all changed between prototype I and II, so the improvement cannot be attributed to any one of them; stirring alone at room temperature has not been run.

status_note.zh: 濕式記錄證實三項改動中的兩項，並補上燒瓶那一組缺的細節。20260614 條目寫「Add 20 mL on culture medium to bioreactor & flask (volume 500mL)」與「Sample and measure OD600 culture in 37℃, 200rpm orbital shaker (flask) and 200 rpm stir (bioreactor)」，所以燒瓶那一組是 500 mL 燒瓶、同樣接入 20 mL 培養液、200 rpm 振盪，攪拌與 37°C 都有記錄。第三項改動（新的取樣點）沒有被提到。另外要注意，20260606 的 run 1 條目既沒寫溫度也沒寫攪拌，所以 run 1 的「室溫」在濕式記錄中同樣沒有依據。（原始檔："Add 20 mL on culture medium to bioreactor & flask (volume 500mL)"）
status_note.en: The wet lab record confirms two of the three changes and fills in the missing flask details. The 20260614 entry reads 'Add 20 mL on culture medium to bioreactor & flask (volume 500mL)' and 'Sample and measure OD600 culture in 37 degrees C, 200rpm orbital shaker (flask) and 200 rpm stir (bioreactor)' - so the flask arm is a 500 mL flask, inoculated with the same 20 mL of culture medium, shaken at 200 rpm, and the stirring and the 37 degrees C are both on the record. The third change, the new sampling point, is not mentioned. Note also that the 20260606 run 1 entry records no temperature and no stirring at all, so 'room temperature' for run 1 is not in the wet lab record either. Raw file reads: "Add 20 mL on culture medium to bioreactor & flask (volume 500mL)"

statement.zh: 模組 C（PlepA-RBS0-CcaSm3-B0015）以構築專一引子驗證，預期 1,667 bp；九株中五株乾淨，C6 與 C9 於 7/24 定序。
statement.en: Module C, PlepA-RBS0-CcaSm3-B0015, verified with construct-specific primers against an expected 1,667 bp product: nine colonies, five clean, clones C6 and C9 sequenced 24 July.

status_note.zh: 1,667 bp 與構築專一引子沒錯：7/22 的實驗記錄與膠標籤都寫「C: PlepA-EEBD-RBS0-CcaSm3-B0015 | biobrick prefix | CcaSm3 R | 1667」，膠上有九個泳道（1-9）。但有兩點不合。7/22 膠的備註挑出的是「(C6, C10)」而非 C6、C9；而且 C6/C9 要到 8/1 才第一次 miniprep（「Miniprep (liquid culture 0731)」，濃度 C6 98、C9 78 ng/µL）並於同日做 EcoRI 確認，因此 7/24 的定序日期不可能成立。膠上也沒有寫九個中有幾個乾淨。（原始檔："C: PlepA-EEBD-RBS0-CcaSm3-B0015 (C6, C10) | biobrick prefix | CcaSm3 R | 1667"）
status_note.en: The 1,667 bp expected size and the construct-specific primers are right: the 22 July notebook and gel give 'C: PlepA-EEBD-RBS0-CcaSm3-B0015 | biobrick prefix | CcaSm3 R | 1667' and a nine-lane gel (1-9). Two things do not match. The 22 July gel note names the picked clones '(C6, C10)', not C6 and C9; and C6/C9 were first miniprepped on 1 August ('Miniprep (liquid culture 0731)', concentrations C6 98, C9 78 ng/uL) and EcoRI-checked the same day, so a 24 July sequencing date cannot be right. The gel does not say how many of the nine were clean. Raw file reads: "C: PlepA-EEBD-RBS0-CcaSm3-B0015 (C6, C10) | biobrick prefix | CcaSm3 R | 1667"

status_note.zh: 已釐清：1,588 bp 是菌落 PCR 產物，3,757 bp 是整個質體長度。20260727 Colony PCR（I in E. statement.zh: 8/2 以三個分劃（P1 總沉澱、P2 可溶沉澱、S 上清液）跑 B. subtilis 帶 ACCD 構築的 Western blot，帶出現在 35 到 40 kDa 之間的兩條 S 泳道，兩條沉澱泳道幾乎空白；曝光六分鐘，雙 ladder 28 到 180 kDa。
statement.en: On 2 August a Western blot of B. subtilis carrying the ACCD construct ran three fractions, P1 total pellet, P2 soluble pellet and S supernatant: bands sit between 35 and 40 kDa in the supernatant lanes and both pellet lanes are effectively blank, six-minute exposure, dual ladders from 28 to 180 kDa.

status_note.zh: 這張 blot 在 8/1 架好、標記 2026/8/2 完成，膠標籤檔把影像命名為「20260802 ACCD WB in B. subtilis」。筆記本寫的上樣順序是 ladder 5 µL、P1、P2、S、S、ladder 2 µL，跑 10% SDS-PAGE，以 anti His-tag mouse 抗體 1:1000 於 4 °C 隔夜；樣品來自構築 J（Pveg-EEBD-RBS0-csn:ACCD-B0015）在 B. subtilis。膠標籤檔定義 P1 為 Bacillus total pellet、P2 為 Bacillus soluble pellet、S 為 Supernatant，註明「Exposure: 6 min」，並列出 marker 刻度 180、130、100、75、63、48、35、28。兩條泳道確實都標 S。唯一沒有任何原始檔案寫到的是帶的位置：Expected Size (kDa) 欄是空的，所以「35 到 40 kDa」是從照片讀出來的。（原始檔："ladder P1 P2 S S ladder / 5mL 50mL 50mL 50mL 50mL 2mL ... Results: 2026/8/2"）
status_note.en: The blot was set up on 1 August and ticked off 2026/8/2, and the gel-label file names the image '20260802 ACCD WB in B. subtilis'. The notebook gives the layout as ladder 5 uL, P1, P2, S, S, ladder 2 uL on a 10% SDS-PAGE, probed with anti His-tag mouse antibody 1:1000 overnight at 4 C; the samples are from construct J, Pveg-EEBD-RBS0-csn:ACCD-B0015, in B. subtilis. The gel-label file defines P1 as Bacillus total pellet, P2 as Bacillus soluble pellet and S as Supernatant, notes 'Exposure: 6 min' and lists the marker marks 180, 130, 100, 75, 63, 48, 35, 28. Both S lanes do carry the same label. The one thing no raw file states is the band position: the Expected Size (kDa) cells are empty, so '35 to 40 kDa' is a read off the photograph. Raw file reads: "ladder P1 P2 S S ladder / 5mL 50mL 50mL 50mL 50mL 2mL ... Results: 2026/8/2"

Replace blocking solution by anti- His-tag mouse mAb (1:1000) In 5% milk"）
status_note.en: The 6 August Western Blotting entry starts 'After SDS-PAGE, carefully collect gel 1 for transfer', transfers to PVDF at 100 V for 90 min and probes with anti-His-tag mouse mAb 1:1000 overnight at 4 C. Gel one carries exactly six samples, the 5 August 25, 10, 150 and 250 mM fractions and the 6 August 25 and 150 mM fractions, so the 10 to 250 mM span is right; the same entry's buffer table sets the equilibrate, wash and elute buffers at 10, 25 and 150 mM imidazole. No band position, yield or concentration is recorded - the entry's Results line is blank. Raw file reads: "After SDS-PAGE, carefully collect gel 1 for transfer ... Replace blocking solution by anti- His-tag mouse mAb (1:1000) In 5% milk"

title.zh: 8/7 的鹽階 blot 不可用
title.en: The 7 August salt-series blot is not usable

statement.zh: 8/7 的第三張八月 blot 有六條泳道、25 到 250 mM 的鹽階，每條泳道在約 35 kDa 都有帶，紀錄為不可用。
statement.en: The third August blot, on 7 August, carried six lanes across a 25 to 250 mM salt series with a band near 35 kDa in every lane, and is recorded as not usable.

status_note.zh: 有兩點對不上。第一是範圍：膠標籤檔的「20260807 western blot」列出 M 與 S1-S6，條件是 25mM (0805)、10mM (0805)、150mM (0805)、250mM (0805)、25mM (0806)、150mM (0806)，所以這個階是 10 到 250 mM imidazole，不是 25 到 250 mM。第二，筆記本在 8/7 根本沒有 western blot 條目，8/7 只有 colony PCR、golden gate、液體培養與電泳。這組樣品清單和 8/6 SDS-PAGE 的「Gel one」完全一樣，也就是 8/6 Western Blotting 條目轉印的那塊膠，所以 20260807 的影像看起來就是 8/6 的 anti-His blot 隔天顯影，等於 WW-094 的同一張，而不是第三張。原始檔案沒有任何地方寫它不可用，也沒有給出 35 kDa 的帶。（原始檔："S1 25mM (0805) S2 10mM (0805) S3 150mM (0805) S4 250mM (0805) S5 25mM (0806) S6 150mM (0806)"）
status_note.en: Two things do not match. First the range: the gel-label file's '20260807 western blot' lists M plus S1-S6 as 25mM (0805), 10mM (0805), 150mM (0805), 250mM (0805), 25mM (0806), 150mM (0806), so the series runs 10 to 250 mM imidazole, not 25 to 250 mM. Second, there is no 7 August western blot entry in the notebook at all - 7 August is colony PCR, golden gate, liquid culture and gel electrophoresis. That sample list is identical to 'Gel one' of the 6 August SDS-PAGE, the gel transferred in the 6 August Western Blotting entry, so the 20260807 image looks like the 6 August anti-His blot developed the next morning, i.e. the same blot as WW-094 rather than a third one. Nothing in the raw files says it was unusable or gives a 35 kDa band. Raw file reads: "S1 25mM (0805) S2 10mM (0805) S3 150mM (0805) S4 250mM (0805) S5 25mM (0806) S6 150mM (0806)"

status_note.en: The SnapGene products carry the markers. status_note.en: Confirmed on both halves. status_note.zh: 分劃與抗體是對的，但這個時序不是一張 blot，也沒有 14 小時這個點。筆記本記了三塊膠。20260902「SDS-PAGB and Western Blot」由 Chars 做，上九條樣品泳道：lumen cell lysate、lumen medium、shell medium 各在 16、18、20 小時，以 anti His-tag mouse antibody (CST) 隔夜偵測。接著 20260905「SDS page electrophoresis」由 Sophie C 做，Gel 1 上 lumen／lumen supernatant／shell supernatant 的 20、22、24 小時，Gel 2 上同樣三個分劃的 40、42、44 小時，20260905 的 Western blot 條目負責轉印 PVDF 並以 anti-Histag mouse mAb 1:1000 偵測。所以取樣時間是 16、18、20、22、24、40、42、44 小時，共八個點、三塊膠、每塊九條泳道。檔案中任何地方都沒有 14 小時的樣品，也沒有任何一條紀錄日期是 9/4。（原始檔："Ladder lumen40hr lumen42hr lumen44hr lumensupernatant40hr LS42hr LS44hr shellsupernatant40hr SS42hr SS44hr"）
status_note.en: The fractions and the antibody are right but the time course is not one blot and has no 14 h point. The notebook records three gels. 20260902 SDS-PAGB and Western Blot, done by Chars, loads nine sample lanes: lumen cell lysate, lumen medium and shell medium at 16, 18 and 20 h, probed with anti His-tag mouse antibody (CST) overnight. Then 20260905 SDS page electrophoresis, done by Sophie C, loads Gel 1 at lumen / lumen supernatant / shell supernatant 20, 22 and 24 h and Gel 2 at the same three fractions at 40, 42 and 44 h, with the 20260905 Western blot entry transferring to PVDF and probing anti-Histag mouse mAb 1:1000. So the sampled times are 16, 18, 20, 22, 24, 40, 42, 44 h - eight points over three gels, nine lanes each. No 14 h sample appears anywhere in the archive, and nothing is dated 4 September. Raw file reads: "Ladder lumen40hr lumen42hr lumen44hr lumensupernatant40hr LS42hr LS44hr shellsupernatant40hr SS42hr SS44hr"

title.zh: Golden Gate 的循環條件
title.en: Golden Gate cycling conditions

statement.zh: Golden Gate 的程式為 95 °C 2 分鐘，接著 95 °C 30 秒、65 °C 40 秒、72 °C 2.5 分鐘共 30 個循環，最後 72 °C 1 分鐘。
statement.en: The Golden Gate program is 95 °C for 2 min, then 30 cycles of 95 °C 30 s, 65 °C 40 s and 72 °C 2.5 min, with a final 72 °C for 1 min.

status_note.zh: 原始檔案裡沒有這個 Golden Gate 程式。紀錄本的 Golden Gate 是切割／接合循環：BsaI 用 37 °C 1.5 分鐘加 16 °C 3 分鐘共 25-45 循環、最後 60 °C 10 分鐘失活（SOP Golden gate assembly、8/1）；BsmBI 用 42 °C 5 分鐘加 16 °C 5 分鐘共 45 循環、最後 80 °C 20 分鐘（9/15）。wiki 上 95 °C 2 分鐘／95 °C 30 秒／65 °C 40 秒／72 °C／72 °C 1 分鐘的 30 循環程式，其實是沿用自 iGEM 2025 的 Colony PCR 程式。（原始檔："37 °C (Restriction enzyme digestion) | 1.5 minutes | 25-45 cycles"）
status_note.en: No Golden Gate program in the raw files looks like this. The notebook runs Golden Gate as digestion/ligation cycling: 37 C 1.5 min with 16 C 3 min for 25-45 cycles then 60 C 10 min inactivation with BsaI (SOP Golden gate assembly, 1 August), and 42 C 5 min with 16 C 5 min for 45 cycles then 80 C 20 min with BsmBI (15 September). The 95 C 2 min / 95 C 30 s / 65 C 40 s / 72 C / 72 C 1 min 30-cycle program on the wiki is the inherited iGEM 2025 Colony PCR program, not a Golden Gate program. Raw file reads: "37 °C (Restriction enzyme digestion) | 1.5 minutes | 25-45 cycles"

wiki.quote: Annealing | 65 °C | 40 sec

title.zh: PCR 以 TaKaRa Ex Taq 50 µL 反應
title.en: PCR runs as a 50 µL TaKaRa Ex Taq reaction

statement.zh: PCR 為 50 µL 反應，含 5 µL 10X Ex Taq buffer、4 µL 2.5 mM dNTP、各 1 µL 10 µM 引子、2 µL 模板（10 ng/µL）與 0.25 µL Ex Taq；程式為 98 °C 30 秒後 25 個循環（98 °C 10 秒、50 到 72 °C 30 秒、72 °C 每 kb 1 分鐘），最後 72 °C 2 分鐘。
statement.en: PCR is a 50 µL reaction with 5 µL 10X Ex Taq buffer, 4 µL 2.5 mM dNTP, 1 µL of each 10 µM primer, 2 µL template at 10 ng/µL and 0.25 µL Ex Taq; cycling is 98 °C 30 s then 25 cycles of 98 °C 10 s, 50 to 72 °C 30 s and 72 °C 1 min per kb, with a final 72 °C 2 min.

status_note.zh: 2026/7/23 的 PCR 是 50 µL Ex Taq 反應：5 µL 10x Ex Taq buffer、4 µL 2.5 mM dNTP mix、各 1 µL 引子、0.25 µL Ex Taq，程式為 98 °C 30 秒後 25 循環（98 °C 10 秒／65 °C 30 秒／72 °C）。但紀錄本用 1 µL 模板配 37.75 µL 水，流程表寫 2 µL 模板配 36.75 µL 水；實際黏合溫度有記錄（7/23 為 65 °C，9/19 為 60 °C）。（原始檔："10x EX Taq buffer | 5 μL | 15 μL"）
status_note.en: The 23 July 2026 PCR is a 50 uL Ex Taq reaction: 5 uL 10x Ex Taq buffer, 4 uL 2.5 mM dNTP mix, 1 uL each primer, 0.25 uL Ex Taq polymerase, and cycling of 98 C 30 s then 25 cycles of 98 C 10 s / 65 C 30 s / 72 C. Note the notebook uses 1 uL of template with 37.75 uL water, where the wiki sheet has 2 uL template and 36.75 uL water; the annealing temperature actually used is recorded (65 C on 23 July, 60 C on 19 September). Raw file reads: "10x EX Taq buffer | 5 μL | 15 μL"

title.zh: Colony PCR 使用 Q-Amp 2X ScreeningFire Taq
title.en: Colony PCR uses Q-Amp 2X ScreeningFire Taq

statement.zh: Colony PCR 為 20 µL 反應：10 µL Q-Amp 2X ScreeningFire Taq master mix、各 1 µL 10 µM 引子（終濃度 0.5 µM）、8 µL 水；每支挑起的菌落同時畫在格線備份盤上。
statement.en: Colony PCR is a 20 µL reaction with 10 µL Q-Amp 2X ScreeningFire Taq master mix, 1 µL of each 10 µM primer to 0.5 µM final and 8 µL water, and each picked colony is also streaked onto a gridded backup plate.

status_note.zh: 紀錄本的 colony PCR 正是這個 20 µL 配方：10 µL Q-amp master mix、各 1 µL 10 µM 引子、8 µL ddH₂O，2026 年 5 月到 10 月出現數十次；菌落也先畫在格線盤上（「Pick up colonies and streak on grid」，2026/10/3）。注意：2026 年每一次 Q-Amp 篩選 PCR 都是 35 循環的 95 °C 20 秒、55／60／65 °C 黏合 20 秒、72 °C 延伸依產物長度調整（30 秒到 5 分），前有 95 °C 5 分、後有 72 °C 5 分（10/3、10/8 以及 8 月每一筆）。從來不是 wiki 上並列的 30 循環、65 °C、2.5 分程式。（原始檔："Q-amp | 10 µL | 100 µL"）
status_note.en: Colony PCR in the notebook is exactly this 20 uL mix: 10 uL Q-amp master mix, 1 uL of each 10 uM primer and 8 uL ddH2O, repeated in dozens of entries from May to October 2026, and the colony is streaked on a gridded plate first ('Pick up colonies and streak on grid', 3 October 2026). Caution: every Q-Amp screening run in 2026 is 35 cycles of 95 C 20 s, 20 s annealing at 55, 60 or 65 C and a 72 C extension scaled to the product (30 sec to 5 min), with 95 C 5 min up front and 72 C 5 min at the end (3 and 8 October, and every August entry). It is never the 30-cycle, 65 C, 2.5 min program printed beside this reaction on the wiki. Raw file reads: "Q-amp | 10 µL | 100 µL"

title.zh: 限制酶切割為 20 µL、500 ng 質體
title.en: Restriction digests are 20 µL with 500 ng of plasmid

statement.zh: 限制酶切割在冰上配置 20 µL 反應：2 µL 10X CutSmart buffer、0.5 µL 酵素（20 units/µL）、500 ng 質體，其餘補水。
statement.en: Restriction digests are set up on ice as 20 µL: 2 µL 10X CutSmart buffer, 0.5 µL enzyme at 20 units/µL, 500 ng of plasmid and water to volume.

status_note.zh: 2026/8/20 的切割在冰上配成 20 µL 反應：2 µL CutSmart buffer、0.5 µL 限制酶、無核酸酶水，DNA 體積以目標質量 500 ng 計算。8/1 的切割同樣是 2 µL CutSmart／0.5 µL EcoRI／總量 20 µL。紀錄本沒有寫「20 units/µL」。（原始檔："*desired DNA mass = 500ng"）
status_note.en: The 20 August 2026 digest is set up on ice as a 20 uL reaction with 2 uL CutSmart buffer, 0.5 uL restriction enzyme and nuclease-free water, with the DNA volume calculated from a desired mass of 500 ng. The 1 August digests use the same 2 uL CutSmart / 0.5 uL EcoRI / 20 uL total. The '20 units/uL' enzyme strength is not written in the notebook. Raw file reads: "*desired DNA mass = 500ng"

title.zh: DNA 膠體電泳條件
title.en: DNA gel electrophoresis conditions

statement.zh: DNA 電泳以 20 mL 1X TAE 中的瓊脂糖膠，safe stain 稀釋 1:20,000，每孔 5 µL，100 V 跑 30 分鐘；常用膠濃度為 0.8%、1.0% 與 2.0%。
statement.en: DNA gels are agarose in 20 mL of 1X TAE with safe stain at 1:20,000, 5 µL per well, run at 100 V for 30 minutes; the gels used are 0.8 %, 1.0 % and 2.0 %.

status_note.zh: 除了膠體體積外都對：7 月到 10 月每筆電泳都寫「Resolve at 100 v for 30 min」、每孔 5 µL，安全染劑一律是每 20 mL 緩衝液 1 µL（1:20,000），0.8%、1%、2% 的膠都做過。但膠不一定是 20 mL 1X TAE：僅 8 月就有 20 mL（1%，8/2）、40 mL、60 mL（0.8%，8/1）、80 mL（2%，8/2）、100 mL 與 120 mL。請改掉 20 mL 或改寫成「每 20 mL」。（原始檔："Weight 1.6 g of agarose powder and measure 80 mL of 1X TAE buffer"）
status_note.en: Everything except the gel volume checks out: every gel entry from July to October reads 'Resolve at 100 v for 30 min' with 5 uL loaded per well, the safety dye is always 1 uL per 20 mL of buffer (1:20,000), and 0.8 %, 1 % and 2 % gels are all cast. But the gel is not always 20 mL of 1X TAE: August 2026 alone casts 20 mL (1 %, 2 Aug), 40 mL, 60 mL (0.8 %, 1 Aug), 80 mL (2 %, 2 Aug), 100 mL and 120 mL batches. Fix the 20 mL or make it 'per 20 mL'. Raw file reads: "Weight 1.6 g of agarose powder and measure 80 mL of 1X TAE buffer"

title.zh: 使用 1 kb 與 3 kb ladder
title.en: 1 kb and 3 kb ladders

statement.zh: 電泳使用 1 kb 或 3 kb ladder，規定 ladder 範圍必須超過樣品的鹼基對數；9/19 的 Level 2 膠使用 3 kb ladder。
statement.en: Gels use a 1 kb or 3 kb ladder, chosen so the ladder range exceeds the sample size; the 19 September Level 2 gel ran against a 3 kb ladder.

status_note.zh: 兩種 ladder 都在用：8 月的膠體標籤表上「M: 1kb DNA ladder; M2: 3kb DNA ladder」並列。2026/9/19 的 Level 2 膠（X: ACDI，三組引子，375／632／661 bp）以 100 v 跑 30 分鐘，marker 寫「M: 3kb ladder」。「ladder 範圍必須超過樣品鹼基對數」只寫在 wiki 的流程表上，紀錄本沒有。（原始檔："M: 3kb ladder"）
status_note.en: Both ladders are in use: '1kb DNA ladder' and '3kb DNA ladder' appear side by side on the August gel label sheets ('M: 1kb DNA ladder; M2: 3kb DNA ladder'). The 19 September 2026 level 2 gel (X: ACDI, three primer pairs, 375 / 632 / 661 bp) is run at 100 v for 30 min against 'M: 3kb ladder'. The rule that the ladder range must exceed the sample size is on the wiki sheet only, not in the notebook. Raw file reads: "M: 3kb ladder"

title.zh: Western blot 的抗體組合
title.en: Western blot antibody pair

statement.zh: Western blot 以 His-Tag 抗體 AD1.1.10（sc-53073，Santa Cruz Biotechnology）為一抗，4 °C 隔夜；二抗為 Peroxidase AffiniPure Goat Anti-Mouse IgG (H+L)（Jackson ImmunoResearch），室溫 1 小時；以 T-Pro LumiDura ECL 顯影。
statement.en: Western blots use His-Tag antibody AD1.1.10 (sc-53073, Santa Cruz Biotechnology) overnight at 4 °C as primary and Peroxidase AffiniPure Goat Anti-Mouse IgG (H+L) (Jackson ImmunoResearch) for 1 h at room temperature as secondary, detected with the T-Pro LumiDura ECL kit.

status_note.zh: 抗體稀釋倍數可以補上：紀錄本的一抗是 anti-His-tag mouse mAb，1:1000 於 5% 奶粉中、4 °C 隔夜（2026/8/6、8/29、9/2 的 Western blot）。但廠牌對不上：9/2 與 8/26 的 blot 寫一抗是 CST（Cell Signaling Technology）的 anti-His-tag mAb（1:1000 於 2% BSA），wiki 流程表卻寫 Santa Cruz sc-53073（AD1.1.10）。原始檔案完全沒有 AD1.1.10、sc-53073、Santa Cruz、Jackson ImmunoResearch 或 T-Pro LumiDura，流程只寫「Prepare chemiluminescence (ECL) reagent by mixing 1:1」。（原始檔："Replace blocking solution by anti-Histag-vouse mAb(1:1000) in 5% milk"）
status_note.en: The antibody dilution is recoverable: the notebook uses the anti-His-tag mouse mAb at 1:1000 in 5 % milk, 4 C overnight (6 August, 29 August and 2 September 2026 Western blots). But the vendor does not match. The notebook names the primary as a CST (Cell Signaling Technology) anti-His-tag mAb on 2 September and in the 26 August blot (1:1000 in 2 % BSA), while the wiki sheet names Santa Cruz sc-53073 (AD1.1.10). Nothing in the raw files mentions AD1.1.10, sc-53073, Santa Cruz, Jackson ImmunoResearch or T-Pro LumiDura; the protocols only say 'Prepare chemiluminescence (ECL) reagent by mixing 1:1'. Raw file reads: "Replace blocking solution by anti-Histag-vouse mAb(1:1000) in 5% milk"

title.zh: Western blot 每孔上樣 30 到 50 µg
title.en: Western blots load 30 to 50 µg per well

statement.zh: Western blot 每孔上樣 30 到 50 µg 總蛋白，95 °C 變性 5 到 10 分鐘，堆疊膠 80 到 120 V、分離膠 100 到 200 V，以 5% 脫脂奶粉阻斷 1 小時。
statement.en: Western blots load 30 to 50 µg of total protein per well, denatured at 95 °C for 5 to 10 min, stacking at 80 to 120 V and separation at 100 to 200 V, blocked in 5 % non-fat milk for 1 hour.

status_note.zh: SOP Western blot 把每個數字都寫明：「Heat samples at 95C for 5-10 minutes」、「Load 30-50ug of total protein into each well」、「Initial stacking: 80-120 V」、「Separation: 100-200 V」、「Blocking in 5% non-fat milk for 1 h at room temperature」。一個保留：紀錄本 2026/8/1 的 blot 是以 5% 奶粉的 TBST 阻斷 2 小時，不是 1 小時。（原始檔："Load 30-50ug of total protein into each well."）
status_note.en: The SOP Western blot states every number: 'Heat samples at 95C for 5-10 minutes', 'Load 30-50ug of total protein into each well', 'Initial stacking: 80-120 V', 'Separation: 100-200 V' and 'Blocking in 5% non-fat milk for 1 h at room temperature'. One caveat: the 1 August 2026 blot in the notebook blocks in 5 % milk in TBST for 2 hr, not 1 h. Raw file reads: "Load 30-50ug of total protein into each well."

wiki.quote: Load 30 to 50 μg of total protein into each well

title.zh: SDS-PAGE 條件
title.en: SDS-PAGE conditions

statement.zh: SDS-PAGE 每片膠為 8 mL 分離膠與 3 mL 堆疊膠，樣品與 6X Laemmli buffer 混合後 95 °C 加熱 10 分鐘，先 200 V 跑 10 分鐘再 120 V 跑 45 到 60 分鐘，ladder 上在頭尾兩孔。
statement.en: SDS-PAGE uses 8 mL of resolver and 3 mL of stacker per gel, samples heated with 6X Laemmli buffer at 95 °C for 10 min, run at 200 V for 10 min then 120 V for 45 to 60 min, with ladder in the first and last wells.

status_note.zh: Protocol 資料夾的 HisTag 純化流程把這些都寫了：分離膠是等量的 resolver A 與 B（各 4 mL，共 8 mL），堆疊膠是等量的 stacker A 與 B（各 1.5 mL，共 3 mL），樣品以 6x Laemmli buffer 配製並在 95 °C 煮 10 分鐘，ladder 上在第一與最後一孔，200 V 跑 10 分鐘後轉 120 V 約 45 分鐘到 1 小時。（原始檔："Load the first well with 2-3 μL of protein ladder."）
status_note.en: The HisTag purification sheet in the Protocol folder gives all of it: resolver is equal volumes of resolver A and B (4 mL each, 8 mL), stacker equal volumes of stacker A and B (1.5 mL each, 3 mL), samples made up with 6x Laemmli buffer and boiled at 95 C for 10 minutes, ladder loaded in both the first and the last well, run at 200 V for 10 min then 120 V for about 45 min to 1 hr. Raw file reads: "Load the first well with 2-3 μL of protein ladder."

title.zh: Coomassie 染色配方
title.en: Coomassie staining recipe

statement.zh: Coomassie 染色液為 0.05% CBR-250、50% 甲醇、10% 醋酸，染 1 小時；脫色液為 30% 甲醇、10% 醋酸，至少搖 1 小時。
statement.en: The Coomassie stain is 0.05 % CBR-250 in 50 % methanol and 10 % acetic acid for 1 hour, and the destain is 30 % methanol and 10 % acetic acid for at least an hour.

status_note.zh: Coomassie 配方在原始檔案中出現兩次且完全一致：Coomassie Blue Solution（50 mL）為 0.05% CBR-250、50% 甲醇、10% 醋酸，在搖床上染 1 小時；脫色液為 30% 甲醇與 10% 醋酸，至少浸泡 1 小時。（原始檔："Stain the gel with 0.05% Coomassie blue R250 for 1 hr on the shaker."）
status_note.en: The Coomassie recipe is given twice in the raw files, identically: Coomassie Blue Solution (50 mL) is 0.05 % CBR-250, 50 % methanol, 10 % acetic acid, stained 1 hr on the shaker; the destain buffer is 30 % methanol and 10 % acetic acid, soaked for at least 1 hr. Raw file reads: "Stain the gel with 0.05% Coomassie blue R250 for 1 hr on the shaker."

title.zh: Ni-NTA 純化的 imidazole 階梯
title.en: Imidazole steps for Ni-NTA purification

statement.zh: His 標籤蛋白以 HisPur Ni-NTA 離心管柱純化，平衡 10 mM、洗滌 25 mM、沖提 150 mM imidazole，各步 175 g 離心 2 分鐘。
statement.en: The His-tagged protein comes off a HisPur Ni-NTA spin column with 10 mM imidazole to equilibrate, 25 mM to wash and 150 mM to elute, each spun at 175 g for 2 min.

status_note.zh: 2026/8/5 與 8/6 的純化正是用這組緩衝液（以 50 mL 配製）：平衡 10 mM、洗滌 25 mM、沖提 150 mM imidazole，每一步都以 175 g 離心 2 分鐘。實際執行的是團隊自己的 50 mL 配方；Protocol 資料夾裡的 HisPur 套件文件寫的是廠商的 250 mM 沖提與 700 x g 離心，「10 到 250 mM」就是從那裡來的。（原始檔："Centrifuge the Ni-NTA column at 175g for 2 min to remove storage buffer"）
status_note.en: The 5 and 6 August 2026 purifications use exactly this buffer ladder, made up as 50 mL stocks: equilibrate 10 mM, wash 25 mM, elute 150 mM imidazole, and the column is spun at 175 g for 2 min at every step. The team's own 50 mL formulation is what was run; the HisPur kit document in the Protocol folder lists the manufacturer's 250 mM elution and 700 x g spins instead, which is where the '10 to 250 mM' range comes from. Raw file reads: "Centrifuge the Ni-NTA column at 175g for 2 min to remove storage buffer"

title.zh: 透析條件
title.en: Dialysis conditions

statement.zh: 透析使用 Slide-A-Lyzer G3 10K MWCO 匣，於冰上對 1.6 L 的 1X PBS pH 8 換液三次（2 小時、2 小時、隔夜），之後存於 −80 °C。
statement.en: Dialysis uses a Slide-A-Lyzer G3 10K MWCO cassette against three changes of 1.6 L of 1X PBS at pH 8 on ice, two hours, two hours and overnight, and the protein is then stored at −80 °C.

status_note.zh: 2026/8/6 的透析紀錄與流程表一致：10x PBS 稀釋到 1.6 L、pH 調到 8、準備三杯 1.6 L PBS，匣在冰上攪 2 小時，換液再攪 2 小時，再換液攪隔夜，之後蛋白存於 −80 °C。紀錄本只寫「dialysis cassette」；Slide-A-Lyzer G3 10K MWCO 的型號只出現在 wiki 流程表，紀錄本沒有。（原始檔："Replace 1X PBS and stir on ice overnight"）
status_note.en: The 6 August 2026 dialysis entry matches the sheet: 10x PBS diluted to 1.6 L, pH adjusted to 8, three beakers of 1.6 L PBS, the cassette stirred on ice for 2 hours, the PBS replaced and stirred 2 more hours, replaced again and stirred overnight, then the protein stored at -80 C. The notebook only says 'dialysis cassette'; the Slide-A-Lyzer G3 10K MWCO identification appears on the wiki sheet, not in the notebook. Raw file reads: "Replace 1X PBS and stir on ice overnight"

title.zh: 小量蛋白萃取條件
title.en: Trial scale protein extraction conditions

statement.zh: 小量萃取在 5 到 50 mL 培養上進行：4 °C、4,000 到 8,000 × g 離心 10 到 20 分鐘，上清液立即加入不含 EDTA 的蛋白酶抑制劑，再以 15,000 × g 澄清；沉澱以 1.5 mL（OD600 0.5 到 1.0）分裝並用不同稀釋度的 CelLytic B 溶解。
statement.en: Trial scale extraction runs on 5 to 50 mL of culture: spin 4,000 to 8,000 × g for 10 to 20 min at 4 °C, add EDTA-free protease inhibitor to the supernatant at once and clarify at 15,000 × g; pellets are taken as 1.5 mL aliquots at OD600 0.5 to 1.0 and lysed in different CelLytic B dilutions.

status_note.zh: HisTag 純化流程同時寫了兩半：收取步驟是「Pellet the induced liquid culture by centrifugation at 4,000-8,000 x g for 10-20 minutes at 4C」，上清液立即加入不含 EDTA 的蛋白酶抑制劑，再以 15,000 x g 澄清；小量步驟每個 CelLytic B 稀釋條件取 1.5 mL、OD600 0.5 到 1.0 的培養。該流程寫的是 10 mL 培養而非 5 到 50 mL，與之不衝突。（原始檔："Use 1.5 mL of the bacterial culture with an OD600 of 0.5-1.0"）
status_note.en: The HisTag purification sheet carries both halves: the harvest step is 'Pellet the induced liquid culture by centrifugation at 4,000-8,000 x g for 10-20 minutes at 4C', then EDTA-free protease inhibitor is added to the supernatant at once and it is clarified again at 15,000 x g; the trial-scale step takes 1.5 mL of culture at OD600 0.5-1.0 per CelLytic B dilution condition. That sheet says a 10 mL culture rather than 5 to 50 mL, which is consistent rather than contradictory. Raw file reads: "Use 1.5 mL of the bacterial culture with an OD600 of 0.5-1.0"

title.zh: Viogene Mini Plus 質體萃取與 BioDrop 定量
title.en: Viogene Mini Plus miniprep with BioDrop quantification

statement.zh: 質體以 Viogene Mini Plus 套件從隔夜培養（每次 1.8 mL）萃取，50 µL 沖提，並在 BioDrop 上量濃度、A260/230 與 A260/280。
statement.en: Plasmid is pulled out of an overnight culture, 1.8 mL at a time, with the Viogene Mini Plus kit, eluted in 50 µL, and measured on the BioDrop for concentration, A260/230 and A260/280.

status_note.zh: 2026/8/13 的 miniprep 每次沉澱 1.8 mL 隔夜培養，走 Viogene 的 MX1／MX2／MX3／WN 緩衝液系列，以 50 µL 沖提，並在 BioDrop 上記錄濃度、A260/230 與 A260/280（8/2 的紀錄同樣是這組緩衝液、50 µL EB 沖提，三個讀值列成表）。9 月以後有些 miniprep 改用 QIAprep 的 P1／P2／N3／PB／PE 系列，沖提量仍是 50 µL。（原始檔："Pellet 1.8mL bacterial overnight culture by centrifuge 6800g for 3min"）
status_note.en: The 13 August 2026 miniprep pellets 1.8 mL of overnight culture at a time, runs the Viogene MX1 / MX2 / MX3 / WN buffer series, elutes in 50 uL and records concentration, A260/230 and A260/280 off the BioDrop (the 2 August 2026 entry shows the same buffers and the 50 uL EB elution with the three readings tabulated). Some minipreps from September onwards use the QIAprep P1 / P2 / N3 / PB / PE series instead, still eluting in 50 uL. Raw file reads: "Pellet 1.8mL bacterial overnight culture by centrifuge 6800g for 3min"

title.zh: Bradford 標準曲線六點
title.en: Six-point Bradford standard curve

statement.zh: Bradford 以 BSA 100 到 600 µg/mL 六點標準曲線，於室溫避光 5 到 10 分鐘後在 595 nm 讀值；此流程在 wiki 上沒有結果。
statement.en: The Bradford assay uses a six-point BSA standard curve from 100 to 600 µg/mL, read at 595 nm after 5 to 10 min in the dark; no result from it appears on the wiki.

status_note.zh: 2025 年的 Bradford 流程給了同樣的六點標準與同樣的波長：「Albumin standard concentrations: 600 ug/mL, 500 ug/mL, 400 ug/mL, 300 ug/mL, 200 ug/mL 100 ug/mL」，接著「Set the spectrophotometer to 595 nm」。該流程寫室溫靜置 5 分鐘，沒有提到避光；「5 到 10 分鐘避光」只在 wiki 流程表上。紀錄本裡沒有任何 Bradford 結果，與 wiki 寫「沒有結果」一致。（原始檔："Set the spectrophotometer to 595 nm."）
status_note.en: The 2025 Bradford protocol gives the same six standards and the same wavelength: 'Albumin standard concentrations: 600 ug/mL, 500 ug/mL, 400 ug/mL, 300 ug/mL, 200 ug/mL 100 ug/mL', then 'Set the spectrophotometer to 595 nm'. That protocol says to incubate at room temperature for 5 minutes and does not mention protecting from light; the '5 to 10 min in the dark' wording is on the wiki sheet only. No Bradford result appears anywhere in the notebook, which matches the wiki saying there is none. Raw file reads: "Set the spectrophotometer to 595 nm."

title.zh: 中空纖維模組型號與規格
title.en: Hollow fibre module model and specification

statement.zh: 使用 Biophsep mPES Minilab 中空纖維模組 HF-E-MI-M020-10-60-P，廠規為 0.2 µm、150 cm²、8 根纖維、1.0 mm 內徑、最大跨膜壓力 0.25 MPa。
statement.en: The module is a Biophsep mPES Minilab hollow-fibre module, HF-E-MI-M020-10-60-P, specified 0.2 µm, 150 cm², 8 fibres, 1.0 mm bore and 0.25 MPa maximum transmembrane pressure.

statement.zh: 矽砂標準品為 Tomicro 單分散 SiO2 微球：密度 2.3 g/cm³、固含量 2.5%（25 mg/mL）、平均粒徑 1 µm、折射率 1.46、總量 10 mL；工作母液稀釋成 2.5 mg/mL。
statement.en: The silica standard is a Tomicro monodisperse SiO2 microsphere stock: density 2.3 g/cm³, 2.5 % solids at 25 mg/mL, mean diameter 1 µm, refractive index 1.46, total volume 10 mL, diluted to a 2.5 mg/mL working stock.

status_note.zh: SiO2 OD600 的 SOP 原文就寫了母液規格：「Tomicro, density 2.3 g/cm³, solids content 2.5% (25 mg/mL), mean particle diameter 1 µm, refractive index 1.46 (589 nm, 25°C), total volume 10 mL」；第 5.1 節以 6 mL 原液加 54 mL 去離子水配成 2.5 mg/mL 工作母液。（原始檔："Tomicro, density 2.3 g/cm³, solids content 2.5% (25 mg/mL), mean particle diameter 1 µm, refractive index"）
status_note.en: The SiO2 OD600 SOP states the stock specification verbatim: 'Tomicro, density 2.3 g/cm3, solids content 2.5% (25 mg/mL), mean particle diameter 1 um, refractive index 1.46 (589 nm, 25C), total volume 10 mL', and section 5.1 makes the 2.5 mg/mL working stock from 6 mL of the original stock plus 54 mL of DI water. Raw file reads: "Tomicro, density 2.3 g/cm³, solids content 2.5% (25 mg/mL), mean particle diameter 1 µm, refractive index"

title.zh: LB 瓊脂板配方
title.en: LB agar plate recipe

statement.zh: 每批 250 mL LB agar 含 9.25 g LB agar 粉與 2 mL 甘油，高壓滅菌 30 分鐘，冷卻後加入 250 µL 抗生素。
statement.en: Each 250 mL batch of LB agar takes 9.25 g of LB agar powder and 2 mL of glycerol, is autoclaved 30 min and takes 250 µL of antibiotic once cooled.

status_note.zh: 配方沒錯，但滅菌時間不對。2026/8/14 的 LBC 盤紀錄逐字寫「250mL ddH₂O 9.25 LB agar powder, and 2mL glycerol to a 500mL flask」，接著寫「Autoclave for 20 minutes at 127°C」，紀錄本裡其他每一批瓊脂（8/7、7/30）也都是 20 分鐘；完全找不到 30 分鐘的 LB agar 滅菌。另外「250 µL 抗生素」只對 chloramphenicol 成立：8/24 的盤子在同樣 250 mL 裡加的是 500 µL ampicillin、25 µL kanamycin、1250 µL erythromycin 或 250 µL chloramphenicol。（原始檔："Add 250mL ddH₂O 9.25 LB agar powder, and 2mL glycerol to a 500mL flask"）
status_note.en: The recipe is right but the autoclave time is not. The 14 August 2026 LBC plate entry is word for word '250mL ddH2O 9.25 LB agar powder, and 2mL glycerol to a 500mL flask', but it then says 'Autoclave for 20 minutes at 127C', as does every other agar batch in the notebook (7 August, 30 July). No 30-minute LB agar autoclave appears anywhere. Also, '250 uL of antibiotic' is only true for chloramphenicol: the 24 August plate batch adds 500 uL ampicillin, 25 uL kanamycin, 1250 uL erythromycin or 250 uL chloramphenicol to the same 250 mL. Raw file reads: "Add 250mL ddH₂O 9.25 LB agar powder, and 2mL glycerol to a 500mL flask"

source.label: Lab notebook, 2026-08-14 entry
source.path: Wetlab stuff/Electronic Lab Notes/August Electronic Lab Notes.docx

wiki.quote: 250 mL LB agar with 2 mL glycerol

title.zh: 三種抗生素與選擇對應
title.en: Three antibiotics and what they select

statement.zh: 使用 ampicillin、chloramphenicol 與 erythromycin：Level 1 構築用 ampicillin、Level 0 與 Level 2 用 chloramphenicol，B. subtilis 轉形後塗在含 erythromycin 的 LB 盤上。
statement.en: Ampicillin, chloramphenicol and erythromycin are used: ampicillin for Level 1 constructs, chloramphenicol for Level 0 and Level 2, and B. subtilis transformants are plated on LB with erythromycin.

status_note.zh: 選擇對應是對的，缺的濃度也補得回來，但 ampicillin 的數字錯了。紀錄本用的是 50 mg/mL 的 ampicillin，不是 25 mg/mL（「Prepare TB medium: 12 mL of TB medium and 12 µL of 50mg/mL Ampicillin」，2026/6/6；6/11 再出現一次）。chloramphenicol 是 25 mg/mL 母液、終濃度 25 µg/mL；erythromycin 自行配成 1 mg/mL（0.01 g 溶於 10 mL 純酒精，7/23）；7/30 的 LBE 甘油盤確實是 5 µg/mL。另外還用了第四種抗生素 kanamycin（8/24 每 250 mL 批次加 25 µL）。（原始檔："Prepare TB medium: 12 mL of TB medium and 12 µL of 50mg/mL Ampicillin."）
status_note.en: The selection scheme is right and the missing concentrations are recoverable, but the ampicillin figure is wrong. The notebook uses ampicillin at 50 mg/mL, not 25 mg/mL ('Prepare TB medium: 12 mL of TB medium and 12 uL of 50mg/mL Ampicillin', 6 June 2026; again on 11 June). Chloramphenicol is 25 mg/mL stock to 25 ug/mL final, erythromycin is made at 1 mg/mL (0.01 g in 10 mL of 100 % alcohol, 23 July), and the 30 July LBE with glycerol plates are 5 ug/mL as the wiki says. A fourth antibiotic, kanamycin, is also in use (25 uL per 250 mL batch, 24 August). Raw file reads: "Prepare TB medium: 12 mL of TB medium and 12 µL of 50mg/mL Ampicillin."

title.zh: 隔夜液體培養條件
title.en: Overnight liquid culture conditions

statement.zh: 液體培養為 3 mL TB 加 1:1,000 抗生素，斜放培養 16 小時。
statement.en: Liquid cultures are 3 mL of TB with antibiotic at 1:1,000, incubated 16 hours with the tube at a slant.

status_note.zh: 紀錄本每一筆液體培養都是這樣：每支管 3 mL TB 培養基加 3 µL 抗生素（即 1:1,000），然後「Place the tubes in the incubator, slant around 45%」（2026/8/1）、「Incubate in 37℃ at 200rpm for 16 hr」（2026/8/11）。同樣的 3 mL + 3 µL 也見於 7/23、8/4、8/21、8/26。（原始檔："Place the tubes in the incubator, slant around 45%"）
status_note.en: The notebook does this in every liquid-culture entry: 3 mL of TB medium with 3 uL of antibiotic (that is the 1:1,000) per tube, then 'Place the tubes in the incubator, slant around 45%' (1 August 2026) and 'Incubate in 37C at 200rpm for 16 hr' (11 August 2026). The same 3 mL + 3 uL appears on 23 July, 4 August, 21 August and 26 August. Raw file reads: "Place the tubes in the incubator, slant around 45%"

title.zh: E. coli 熱休克轉形條件
title.en: E. coli heat-shock transformation conditions

statement.zh: E. coli 轉形：冰上 20 分鐘、42 °C 熱休克 45 秒、冰上 3 分鐘，加 1 mL SOC 於 37 °C 回復 1 小時，塗盤後 37 °C 培養 16 小時。
statement.en: E. coli transformation is 20 min on ice, 42 °C heat shock for 45 seconds, 3 min on ice, 1 mL SOC and 1 h recovery at 37 °C, then plating and 16 h at 37 °C.

status_note.zh: 2026/8/4 的轉形步驟順序完全一致：42 °C 水浴、10 µL 質體加入 100 µL 勝任細胞、冰上 20 分鐘、42 °C 熱休克 45 秒、冰上 3 分鐘、1 mL SOC、37 °C 1 小時、5000 g 離心 5 分鐘、塗盤，然後「Incubate at 37°C for 16 hr」。同一段在 2026/9/8 以及整個 7、8 月反覆出現。（原始檔："Heat shock at 42 °C for 45 sec"）
status_note.en: The 4 August 2026 transformation lists the steps in exactly this order: water bath at 42 C, 10 uL plasmid into 100 uL competent cell, 20 min on ice, heat shock at 42 C for 45 sec, 3 min on ice, 1 mL SOC medium, 1 hr at 37 C, spin 5000 g 5 min, spread, then 'Incubate at 37C for 16 hr'. The same block repeats on 8 September 2026 and through July and August. Raw file reads: "Heat shock at 42 °C for 45 sec"

title.zh: ½ MS 春化瓊脂配方
title.en: ½ MS vernalisation agar recipe

statement.zh: 750 mL 春化用瓊脂（15 盤）含 ½ MS 粉 1.725 g、MES 0.375 g、蔗糖 7.5 g、瓊脂 7.5 g，pH 調到 5.7 到 5.8，127 °C 滅菌 20 分鐘。
statement.en: 750 mL of vernalisation agar, fifteen plates, takes 1.725 g of ½ MS powder, 0.375 g MES, 7.5 g sucrose and 7.5 g agar at pH 5.7 to 5.8, autoclaved at 127 °C for 20 minutes.

status_note.zh: 同一配方見於 1/2 MS 瓊脂盤流程的 500 mL 版（8 盤）：1.15 g ½ MS 粉、0.25 g MES、5 g 蔗糖（1%）、5 g 瓊脂（1%），以 0.1 M KOH 調 pH 5.7-5.8，「Autoclave for 20 minutes at 127°C」。wiki 的 750 mL／15 盤正是該配方乘 1.5（2.3 g/L ½ MS、0.5 g/L MES、1% 蔗糖、1% 瓊脂），與水耕培養基流程的每公升比例相同。原始檔案裡有 500 mL（8 盤）與 420 mL（14 盤）版本，沒有 750 mL 版。（原始檔："Autoclave for 20 minutes at 127°C"）
status_note.en: The same recipe is in the 1/2 MS agar plate preparation protocol at 500 mL for 8 plates: 1.15 g 1/2 MS powder, 0.25 g MES, 5 g sucrose (1 %), 5 g agar (1 %), pH 5.7-5.8 adjusted with 0.1 M KOH, 'Autoclave for 20 minutes at 127C'. The wiki's 750 mL / 15 plate figures are that recipe scaled 1.5x exactly (2.3 g/L 1/2 MS, 0.5 g/L MES, 1 % sucrose, 1 % agar), the same per-litre rates as the hydroponic medium protocol. The corpus has 500 mL (8 plates) and 420 mL (14 plates) versions, not a 750 mL one. Raw file reads: "Autoclave for 20 minutes at 127°C"

title.zh: 鹽度試驗盤的設計矩陣
title.en: The salinity plate design matrix

statement.zh: 鹽度瓊脂試驗為四個海藻糖濃度（0、1、5、10 mM）乘三個鹽濃度（0、150、250 mM NaCl）共 12 盤，每 50 mL 培養基分別加 0、500、2,500、5,000 µL 海藻糖。
statement.en: The salinity agar design is four trehalose levels, 0, 1, 5 and 10 mM, crossed with three salt levels, 0, 150 and 250 mM NaCl, over twelve plates, with 0, 500, 2,500 and 5,000 µL of trehalose per 50 mL of medium.

status_note.zh: Plant notebook 2026/7/4 的紀錄正是這個設計：「prepare salinity agar plates for plant model Experimental Set #5 0,1,5,10 mM trehalose vs. 150, 250mM NaCl」，600 mL 瓊脂做 12 盤，十二種組合全部列出，海藻糖表格為每 50 mL 培養基 0 µL、500 µL、2500 µL、5000 µL。7/27 執行的第 6 組用的是另一個矩陣（0／75／100／150 mM NaCl 搭配 0 與 5 mM 海藻糖），那是後來的組別，不是對這一組的反證。（原始檔："Purpose: prepare salinity agar plates for plant model Experimental Set #5 0,1,5,10 mM trehalose vs. 150, 250mM NaCl"）
status_note.en: The Plant notebook entry of 4 July 2026 is this design exactly: 'prepare salinity agar plates for plant model Experimental Set #5 0,1,5,10 mM trehalose vs. 150, 250mM NaCl', 600 mL of agar for 12 plates, all twelve combinations listed, and the trehalose table gives 0 uL, 500 uL, 2500 uL and 5000 uL per 50 mL of medium. The set 6 run of 27 July used a different matrix (0 / 75 / 100 / 150 mM NaCl with 0 and 5 mM trehalose), so that is a later set, not a contradiction of this one. Raw file reads: "Purpose: prepare salinity agar plates for plant model Experimental Set #5 0,1,5,10 mM trehalose vs. 150, 250mM NaCl"

title.zh: 播種模板與每盤 18 顆種子
title.en: Seed template and eighteen seeds per plate

statement.zh: 每個方盤以 3 cm、5 cm、4 cm 的模板播 18 顆種子（兩列各九顆），4 °C 春化 4 天後在生長箱 4 天，再移到處理盤觀察 10 天。
statement.en: Each square plate takes 18 seeds in two rows of nine on a 3 cm, 5 cm, 4 cm template, vernalised 4 days at 4 °C, 4 days in the chamber, then transferred and observed for 10 days.

status_note.zh: Agar Application of Protectant 流程一行就寫明：「Use the seed template (3cm, 5cm, 4cm) to plant 18 seeds on each agar plate in two rows, nine seeds on each row」，接著 4 °C 春化 4 天、再進生長箱。觀察 10 天（同一份檔案裡「Observe for 10 days」出現三次）。注意：這一節的培養寫 7 天，同一份流程的 A 節與 wiki 都寫 4 天；紀錄本的圓盤試驗則是每盤 25 或 40 顆種子。（原始檔："Use the seed template (3cm, 5cm, 4cm) to plant 18 seeds on each agar plate in two rows, nine seeds on each row"）
status_note.en: The Agar Application of Protectant protocol says it in one line: 'Use the seed template (3cm, 5cm, 4cm) to plant 18 seeds on each agar plate in two rows, nine seeds on each row', then vernalize at 4 C for 4 days and incubate in the growth chamber. Observation is 10 days ('Observe for 10 days', three times in the same file). Note that the incubation line in this section reads 7 days, while section A of the same protocol and the wiki both say 4 days; and the circular-plate runs in the notebook plant 25 or 40 seeds per plate instead. Raw file reads: "Use the seed template (3cm, 5cm, 4cm) to plant 18 seeds on each agar plate in two rows, nine seeds on each row"

title.zh: 水耕試驗的 3 M NaCl 母液
title.en: 3 M NaCl stock for the hydroponic assay

statement.zh: 水耕鹽度試驗的鹽來自 3 M NaCl 於 ½ MS 中的母液：400 mL 水加 ½ MS 粉 0.92 g、MES 0.2 g 與 NaCl 70.128 g，127 °C 滅菌 20 分鐘。
statement.en: Salt for the hydroponic assay comes from a 3 M NaCl stock in ½ MS: 400 mL of water with 0.92 g of ½ MS powder, 0.2 g MES and 70.128 g NaCl, autoclaved at 127 °C for 20 min.

status_note.zh: 配方到克數都對，但滅菌時間不對。Plant notebook 2026/7/25 標題為「Prepare 3M NaCl with ½ MS medium」的紀錄用 400 mL 水、0.92 g ½ MS 粉、0.2 g MES，pH 調到 5.7-5.8，並加入 70.128 g NaCl（400 mL 中即 3 M）。但接著寫的是「Autoclave the medium at 127C for 30min」，不是 20 分鐘。（原始檔："Add 70.128g of NaCl slowly into the flask, and use stirring bar to dissolve NaCl into medium"）
status_note.en: The recipe is confirmed to the gram but the autoclave time is not. The Plant notebook entry of 25 July 2026, titled 'Prepare 3M NaCl with 1/2 MS medium', uses 400 mL with 0.92 g 1/2 MS powder, 0.2 g MES, pH to 5.7-5.8, and 70.128 g of NaCl (which is 3 M in 400 mL). But it then says 'Autoclave the medium at 127C for 30min', not 20 minutes. Raw file reads: "Add 70.128g of NaCl slowly into the flask, and use stirring bar to dissolve NaCl into medium"

wiki.quote: 3 M NaCl in ½ MS, autoclaved

title.zh: 水耕育苗裝置
title.en: The hydroponic seedling rig

statement.zh: 水耕以 48 個打洞的 Eppendorf 蓋、每蓋 250 µL 瓊脂，架在裝有 2 mL 0.1x MS 的 48 孔試管架上，4 °C 春化 4 天。
statement.en: The hydroponic rig is 48 punched Eppendorf lids with 250 µL of agar each over a 48-well rack holding 2 mL of 0.1x MS per well, stratified 4 days at 4 °C.

status_note.zh: 裝置本身對，但兩個體積不對。Plant notebook 2026/7/30 的紀錄先做 3 mm 孔的蓋子並滅菌，然後「Add 0.8% agar into 48 lids (270 µL each)」、「Add 2.2 mL of ½ MS medium into 48 tube racks」，再入 4 °C。所以瓊脂是 270 µL 不是 250 µL，孔內是 2.2 mL ½ MS 不是 2 mL 0.1x MS。原始檔案中完全找不到「0.1x MS」字樣；水耕培養基流程是 2.3 g/L 的 ½ MS。（原始檔："Add 0.8% agar into 48 lids (270 μL each)"）
status_note.en: The rig is right, the two volumes are not. The 30 July 2026 Plant notebook entry makes lids with 3 mm holes, autoclaves them, then 'Add 0.8% agar into 48 lids (270 uL each)' and 'Add 2.2 mL of 1/2 MS medium into 48 tube racks' before 4 C. So the agar is 270 uL, not 250 uL, and the well holds 2.2 mL of 1/2 MS, not 2 mL of 0.1x MS. The string '0.1x MS' does not appear anywhere in the raw files; the hydroponic medium protocol is 1/2 MS at 2.3 g/L. Raw file reads: "Add 0.8% agar into 48 lids (270 μL each)"

source.label: Plant notebook, 2026-07-30 entry
source.where: Plant seeds for set C and vernalize in hydroponic system, 20260730

title.zh: 葉綠素萃取：80% 丙酮與 Arnon 係數
title.en: Chlorophyll extraction: 80 % acetone with Arnon coefficients

statement.zh: 葉綠素萃取以整株幼苗、10 顆不鏽鋼珠、−80 °C 10 分鐘後加 4 mL 80% 丙酮，每樣品 3 孔、每孔 200 µL，讀 A663 與 A645，以 Arnon 係數換算。
statement.en: Chlorophyll extraction uses whole seedlings with 10 steel beads, 10 min at −80 °C and 4 mL of 80 % acetone, read at A663 and A645 in three wells of 200 µL per sample with Arnon's coefficients.

status_note.zh: Protocol 資料夾裡標示「updated procedure」的 Chlorophyll Extraction 就是 80% 丙酮／Arnon 版：每管 10 顆不鏽鋼（304）珠、丙酮稀釋到 80% 每管加 4 mL、每樣品 3 孔各 200 µL、讀 A663 與 A645，並用 Arnon 公式「( 20.2 * OD645 + 8.02 * OD663 ) V / ( 1000 * fw )」。兩個保留：該流程是 −80 °C 放隔夜而非 10 分鐘，且公式取 V = 2 mL 卻加了 4 mL 丙酮。原始檔案中完全沒有 95% 丙酮、649 nm 或 Lichtenthaler 係數。（原始檔："Place 10 stainless steel (304) balls in each of the centrifuge tubes, then place them in -80 degrees C overnight"）
status_note.en: The Chlorophyll Extraction protocol in the Protocol folder, headed 'updated procedure', is the 80 % acetone / Arnon version: 10 stainless steel (304) balls per tube, acetone diluted to 80 % with 4 mL per tube, 200 uL into each of 3 wells per sample, read at A663 and A645, and the Arnon equation '( 20.2 * OD645 + 8.02 * OD663 ) V / ( 1000 * fw )'. Two caveats: the protocol freezes at -80 C overnight, not for 10 min, and it sets V = 2 mL while adding 4 mL of acetone. No 95 % acetone, 649 nm or Lichtenthaler coefficients appear anywhere in the raw files. Raw file reads: "Place 10 stainless steel (304) balls in each of the centrifuge tubes, then place them in -80 degrees C overnight"

wiki.quote: read at 663 and 645 nm in 80% acetone with Arnon's coefficients
read at 649 and 665 nm in 95 per cent acetone with the Lichtenthaler coefficients

title.zh: 土耕流程的時程與施肥
title.en: Soil protocol timeline and feeding

statement.zh: 土耕為 4 °C 3 天、盤上 7 天、移入 3 吋盆約 3 週後開始處理；以底盤給水，並每隔一次給水時施用 1:1,000 的花寶 2 號。
statement.en: The soil protocol is 3 days at 4 °C, 7 days on plates and about 3 weeks in soil before treatment, with tray watering and Hyponex No. 2 at 1:1,000 on alternate waterings.

status_note.zh: Plant notebook 2026/7/25 的紀錄與土耕流程逐步相符：盆與底盤以 1:100 漂白水浸 10 分鐘、泥炭土滅菌、3 吋盆填到 80%、從表面澆透，再用鑷子從子葉下方夾起 7 天齡的苗。4 °C 是 3 天（4/28 紀錄：「Put the seed-containing holder at 4°C for 3 days」）。肥料是花寶 2 號（Plant notebook 筆記中點名），比例為每 1000 mL 加 1 g，2026/8/14 與 8/15 配製。底盤給水與水肥交替只寫在流程表上。（原始檔："Fill 3-inch pots until 80% full, lightly press down and thoroughly water from the surface"）
status_note.en: The Plant notebook entry of 25 July 2026 matches the soil sheet step for step: pots and water trays soaked in 1:100 bleach for 10 min, peat soil autoclaved, 3-inch pots filled to 80 %, watered from the surface, and 7-day-old seedlings lifted with tweezers from beneath the cotyledons. The 4 C step is 3 days (28 April entry, 'Put the seed-containing holder at 4C for 3 days'). The feed is Hyponex No. 2 (named as 'hua bao 2 hao' in the Plant notebook notes) at 1 g per 1000 mL, made up on 14 and 15 August 2026. Subirrigation and alternating water/fertiliser are on the sheet only. Raw file reads: "Fill 3-inch pots until 80% full, lightly press down and thoroughly water from the surface"

title.zh: 十三支引子構成整組轉換
title.en: Thirteen primers make up the whole conversion set

statement.zh: 把 MoClo 零件帶進 SubtiToolKit 的引子共十三支，六支用於三個 CDS（Ho1 F/pcyA R、ccaSm3 F/R、CcaR F/R），尾段 29 bp 完全相同。
statement.en: Thirteen primers make up the set that carried MoClo parts into the kit; six of them cover three coding sequences, Ho1 F with pcyA R, ccaSm3 F with R and CcaR F with R, and the 29 bp tail is identical on all six.

status_note.zh: 《2026 primer list.docx》顯示的不是十三支。用途標為「Convert MoClo to STK」的有二十七支（ccaR F/R、ccaSm3 F/R、csn F、Csn R、SamyQ F、ACCD R、AmilCP R、Lea R、EEBD F、MF001 F/R、MF002 F/R、Ho1 F、pcyA R、L3S1P52-L3S2P56 F/R、P43 F/R、PcpcG2-veg F/R、PREF F/R、PrpsD F/R），其中十三支才是 wiki 列表的那些。另外，六支編碼序列引子的 29 bp 尾端並不全部相同：三支正向共用 ATATATGAAGACATCTGAGGTCTCATATG，三支反向共用 ATATATGAAGACATGAGGGGTCTCATGTC。（原始檔："ccaR F | Forward | ATA TAT GAA GAC ATC TGA GGT CTC ATA TGA GAA TTC TTT TAG TGG AGG AT"）
status_note.en: 2026 primer list.docx does not show thirteen. Twenty-seven primers carry the purpose 'Convert MoClo to STK' (ccaR F/R, ccaSm3 F/R, csn F, Csn R, SamyQ F, ACCD R, AmilCP R, Lea R, EEBD F, MF001 F/R, MF002 F/R, Ho1 F, pcyA R, L3S1P52-L3S2P56 F/R, P43 F/R, PcpcG2-veg F/R, PREF F/R, PrpsD F/R); thirteen of them are the ones the wiki tabulates. Also, the 29 bp tail is not identical on all six coding-sequence primers: the three forwards share ATATATGAAGACATCTGAGGTCTCATATG and the three reverses share ATATATGAAGACATGAGGGGTCTCATGTC. Raw file reads: "ccaR F | Forward | ATA TAT GAA GAC ATC TGA GGT CTC ATA TGA GAA TTC TTT TAG TGG AGG AT"

title.zh: 引子尾段的四段結構
title.en: The four-element primer tail

statement.zh: 非套件零件的引子都帶同一種尾段：5′ 間隔、定義 Level 0 overhang 的 BpiI 位點、定義 Level 1 位置的 BsaI 位點，以及基因專一的黏合區。
statement.en: Primers for parts not in the kit all carry the same tail: a 5′ spacer, a BpiI site defining the Level 0 overhang, a BsaI site defining the Level 1 positional overhang, and a gene-specific annealing region.

status_note.zh: 《2026 primer list.docx》中每一支帶尾端的引子都看得到這四個元件。csn F 是 ATATAT（間隔）GAAGAC（BpiI）AT CTGA（Level 0 黏接端）GGTCTC（BsaI）A TATG（Level 1 黏接端）再接基因專一區；反向引子在同樣兩個位置用 GAGG 與 TGTC。一個例外：清單裡的 Csn R 是沒有尾端的 19 nt 短引子 CAAGTAATGAGATCGCTGC，實際是當篩選引子而非轉換引子使用。（原始檔："csn F | Forward | ATA TAT GAA GAC ATC TGA GGT CTC ATA TGA AAA TCA GTA TGC AAA AAG CA"）
status_note.en: The four elements are visible in every tailed primer in 2026 primer list.docx. csn F reads ATATAT (spacer) GAAGAC (BpiI) AT CTGA (Level 0 overhang) GGTCTC (BsaI) A TATG (Level 1 overhang) then the gene-specific part; the reverse primers use GAGG and TGTC in the same two slots. One exception: Csn R in the list is a plain untailed 19-mer, CAAGTAATGAGATCGCTGC, used as a screening primer rather than a conversion primer. Raw file reads: "csn F | Forward | ATA TAT GAA GAC ATC TGA GGT CTC ATA TGA AAA TCA GTA TGC AAA AAG CA"

statement.zh: Ho1:pcyA 的 amplicon 為 1,549 bp，兩個 CDS 之間以 GGGGS ×2 linker 相連；CcaR 的 amplicon 為 760 bp。
statement.en: The Ho1:pcyA amplicon is 1,549 bp with the two coding sequences joined by a GGGGS times two linker, and the CcaR amplicon is 760 bp.

status_note.zh: 1,549 bp 出現在 8/8 的 Level 2 V PCR 膠上：「S: ABDI | Ho1 F | pcyA R | 1549」。GGGGS×2 連接子就在序列裡：pSTK-1A-PtagC+RBS-Ho1-pcyA-L3S2P21.dna 中 Ho1 CDS 止於 1032、pcyA 起於 1063，中間 30 個鹼基為 GGTGGTGGTGGTTCTGGTGGTGGTGGTTCT，即 (GGGGS)×2。CcaR 圖的 760 bp 等於 pGEM-Teasy-CcaR.dna 中 702 bp 的 ccaR 區段加上兩段 29 bp 引子尾端，與 ho1:pcyA 的 1,549（1491+58）是同一個算法。（原始檔："S: ABDI | Ho1 F | pcyA R | 1549"）
status_note.en: 1,549 bp is on the 8 August Level 2 V PCR gel: 'S: ABDI | Ho1 F | pcyA R | 1549'. The GGGGS x2 linker is in the sequence: in pSTK-1A-PtagC+RBS-Ho1-pcyA-L3S2P21.dna the Ho1 CDS ends at 1032 and pcyA starts at 1063, and the 30 bases between them read GGTGGTGGTGGTTCTGGTGGTGGTGGTTCT, i.e. (GGGGS)x2. The CcaR figure's 760 bp is the 702 bp ccaR feature in pGEM-Teasy-CcaR.dna plus the two 29 bp primer tails, the same arithmetic that gives 1,549 for ho1:pcyA (1491+58). Raw file reads: "S: ABDI | Ho1 F | pcyA R | 1549"

status_note.zh: SnapGene 產物檔可以定案。pSTK-Exp1-Pveg-EEBD-RBS0-csn-ACCD-B0015.dna 中 CDS-Csn_Acc 區段為 5853-6989，Csn 在 5' 端，而 6xHis 標註在 6969-6986，也就是融合蛋白的 3' 端。每一個帶標籤的產物都是同樣的排列：pSTK-0C-Csn-Lea（Csn-LEA 486-1061、6xHis 1041-1058）、STK-0C-SamyQ-ACCD-v2t1（SamyQ 29-118、ACCD 119-1150、6xHis 1130-1147）、S-pSTK-EXP1-…-SamyQ-LEAv2t1（SamyQ 626-715、6xHis 1166-1183）。所以訊號肽在 N 端，His6 在 C 端。（原始檔："CDS-Csn_Acc [misc_feature] 5853-6989 ... 6xHis [CDS] 6969-6986"）
status_note.en: The SnapGene products settle the orientation. In pSTK-Exp1-Pveg-EEBD-RBS0-csn-ACCD-B0015.dna the CDS-Csn_Acc feature runs 5853-6989 with Csn at its 5' end and the 6xHis feature at 6969-6986, i.e. at the 3' end of the fusion. The same pattern holds in every tagged product: pSTK-0C-Csn-Lea (Csn-LEA 486-1061, 6xHis 1041-1058), STK-0C-SamyQ-ACCD-v2t1 (SamyQ 29-118, ACCD 119-1150, 6xHis 1130-1147), S-pSTK-EXP1-...-SamyQ-LEAv2t1 (SamyQ 626-715, 6xHis 1166-1183). So the signal peptide is N-terminal and His6 is C-terminal. Raw file reads: "CDS-Csn_Acc [misc_feature] 5853-6989 ... 6xHis [CDS] 6969-6986"

statement.en: The homepage big picture and Description name the chassis B. subtilis WB800, while Results and Engineering say every reactor number on the wiki is strain 168.

status_note.zh: 兩株在原始檔案裡都是真的，用途不同。B. subtilis 168 是 2026 年 5 月電穿孔條件測試用的菌株（5/4「electroporation competent B.sub 168 preparation」）。WB800 則是 8 月之後的菌株：8/8、8/18、8/31、9/2、9/13 製備電勝任細胞；8/29 的 Western blot 樣品「#J1 in Bacillus subtilis WB800」；9/15 與 10/1 把 ACDI 電穿孔進 WB800；Optogenetic LPA Assay 流程標題為「CcaSR in B. subtilis WB800」。所以「站上每個反應器數字都是 168」與「底盤是 WB800」可以同時成立，但哪一頁該寫哪一個是編輯判斷，不是原始檔案能決定的。（原始檔："#J1 in Bacillus subtilis WB800"）
status_note.en: Both strains are real in the raw files, and they are used for different things. B. subtilis 168 is the strain in the May 2026 electroporation condition tests (4 May, 'electroporation competent B.sub 168 preparation'). WB800 is the strain from August onwards: electrocompetent cell preps on 8, 18 and 31 August and on 2 and 13 September; the Western blot sample '#J1 in Bacillus subtilis WB800' on 29 August; electroporation of ACDI into WB800 on 15 September and 1 October; and the Optogenetic LPA Assay protocol is titled 'CcaSR in B. subtilis WB800'. So 'every reactor number on this wiki is strain 168' and 'the chassis is WB800' can both be defensible, but which page should say what is an editorial call, not a raw-file one. Raw file reads: "#J1 in Bacillus subtilis WB800"

title.zh: 168 電勝任細胞在 OD600 0.85 到 0.95 收取
title.en: 168 competent cells are harvested at OD600 0.85 to 0.95

statement.zh: 製備 168 電勝任細胞時，隔夜培養稀釋 16 倍後在 37 °C、200 rpm 培養到 OD600 0.85 到 0.95，冰浴 5 分鐘後 5,000 × g 離心 10 分鐘，以 EP buffer 洗兩次，最後以原體積 1/20 回溶。
statement.en: For strain 168 the overnight culture is diluted 16-fold and grown at 37 °C and 200 rpm to OD600 0.85 to 0.95, cooled on ice 5 min, spun at 5,000 × g for 10 min, washed twice in ice-cold EP buffer and resuspended in 1/20 of the original volume.

status_note.zh: OD 範圍確實在 SOP 上，但 168 那一欄的其餘條件和任何已記錄的 168 製備都不符。Electroporation SOP 寫稀釋 16 倍、37 °C 200 rpm 培養「to OD600 of 0.85~0.95」，但接著是冰上 10 分鐘、5000 rpm 離心 5 分鐘、以原體積 1/40 回溶。紀錄本裡唯一的 168 製備（2026/5/4，Gabriel）是培養到 OD600 0.7、冰上 10 分鐘、5000 g 離心 5 分鐘、1/40 回溶。wiki 放在 168 欄的組合（冰上 5 分鐘、5,000 x g 10 分鐘、1/20）其實是 2026/9/2 WB800 製備的做法，兩欄的 1/20 與 1/40 可能互換了。（原始檔："Dilute an overnight culture of B.sub 168 16-fole in growth medium and grow at 37​​℃ to 0.600 of 0.7"）
status_note.en: The OD window is in the SOP but the rest of the 168 column does not match any recorded 168 prep. The Electroporation SOP says to dilute 16-fold and grow at 37 C and 200 rpm 'to OD600 of 0.85~0.95', but then cools on ice for 10 min, spins at 5000 rpm for 5 min and resuspends in 1/40 of the culture volume. The only 168 prep in the notebook (4 May 2026, Gabriel) was grown to OD600 0.7, cooled 10 min, spun at 5000 g for 5 min and resuspended in 1/40. The combination the wiki puts in the 168 column (ice 5 min, 5,000 x g for 10 min, 1/20 volume) is what the 2 September 2026 WB800 prep did, so the 1/20 and 1/40 may be swapped between the two columns. Raw file reads: "Dilute an overnight culture of B.sub 168 16-fole in growth medium and grow at 37​​℃ to 0.600 of 0.7"

statement.en: For WB800 the culture is grown to OD600 2.2, washed four times with ice-cold EP buffer containing 0.5 mol/L trehalose and resuspended in 1/40 of the original volume.

status_note.zh: 海藻糖緩衝液、四次洗滌與 1/40 回溶都得到確認，但 OD600 2.2 沒有。2026/9/13 的製備（「Prepare WB800 Electrocompetent cell via the method from Lu eeul., 2012」）以 0.5 M trehalose 配 Lu 的 EP buffer、洗滌重複四次、把 40 mL 培養回溶於 1 mL，但記錄到的收取 OD 是 14:20 的 2.082 與 14:45 的 2.346；更早的 WB800 製備分別收在 OD600 0.907（8/18）、0.91（8/31），9/2 那次是 0.926。沒有任何一筆寫 2.2。（原始檔："Repeat step 9 and 10 for 4 times"）
status_note.en: The trehalose buffer, the four washes and the 1/40 resuspension are confirmed, but the OD600 2.2 is not. The 13 September 2026 prep ('Prepare WB800 Electrocompetent cell via the method from Lu eeul., 2012') makes Lu's EP buffer with 0.5 M trehalose, repeats the wash four times and resuspends 40 mL of culture in 1 mL, but the recorded harvest ODs are 2.082 at 14:20 and 2.346 at 14:45, and the earlier WB800 preps were harvested at OD600 0.907 (18 August) and 0.91 (31 August), with the 2 September one at 0.926. No entry records 2.2. Raw file reads: "Repeat step 9 and 10 for 4 times"

title.zh: 電穿孔參數：168 與 WB800 不同
title.en: Electroporation parameters differ between 168 and WB800

statement.zh: 168 使用 2.1、2.2、2.3 kV 與 300 Ω，WB800 使用 2.1、2.3、2.5 kV 與 250 Ω，兩者都是 25 µF、0.2 cm 管，脈衝後加 2 mL SOC、37 °C、200 rpm 回復 3 小時。
statement.en: Strain 168 is pulsed at 2.1, 2.2 and 2.3 kV with 300 Ω, WB800 at 2.1, 2.3 and 2.5 kV with 250 Ω, both at 25 µF in a 0.2 cm cuvette, recovered in 2 mL SOC for 3 h at 37 °C and 200 rpm.

status_note.zh: WB800 那一欄確認了，168 那一欄沒有。2026/9/15「For ACCD, 2.1 / 2.3 / 2.5 kv, 250 Ω, 25 μF were tested」是在 WB800 上做的，10/1 重複 2.5 kV／25 µF／250 Ω。168 在 5 月的測試用的是 2.0、2.1、2.2 kV、300 Ω、25 µF（5/10 的 trial 3 到 5；5/12 的膠註記寫 2.2 kv, 300Ω），不是 2.1、2.2、2.3 kV。回復條件也不一致：5/10 加 1 mL SOC-RM、200 rpm 搖 4 小時，SOP 寫 1 mL、225 rpm 3 小時，只有 9/19 寫「2 mL recovery medium was used」。9/15 另有一個例外：ABDI 用 200 Ω，這個值 wiki 完全沒列。（原始檔："For ACCD, 2.1 / 2.3 / 2.5 kv, 250 Ω, 25 μF were tested"）
status_note.en: The WB800 column is confirmed and the 168 column is not. On 15 September 2026 'For ACCD, 2.1 / 2.3 / 2.5 kv, 250 ohm, 25 uF were tested' on WB800, and 1 October repeats 2.5 kV / 25 uF / 250 ohm. For 168 the May tests used 2.0, 2.1 and 2.2 kV at 300 ohm and 25 uF (10 May trials 3 to 5; the 12 May gel note says 2.2 kv, 300 ohm), not 2.1, 2.2 and 2.3 kV. Recovery also varies: the 10 May entry adds 1 mL SOC-RM and shakes 4 hours at 200 rpm, the SOP says 1 mL and 3 hours at 225 rpm, and only the 19 September entry says '2 mL recovery medium was used'. One more oddity on 15 September: ABDI was pulsed at 200 ohm, a value the wiki does not list at all. Raw file reads: "For ACCD, 2.1 / 2.3 / 2.5 kv, 250 Ω, 25 μF were tested"
