title.en: Three vectors from outside the kit

statement.zh: 非套件載體有三個：pGEM-T Easy（TA cloning 中間載體，ampicillin）、pJUMP-29（MoClo 2.0 時期的 Level 1 目標載體）與 pNW33N（四月自 BCRC 回收的 E. coli 與 B. subtilis 穿梭質體）。
statement.en: Three vectors come from outside the kit: pGEM-T Easy, the TA cloning intermediate on ampicillin, pJUMP-29, the Level 1 destination vector in the MoClo 2.0 phase, and pNW33N, the E. coli to B. subtilis shuttle plasmid recovered from BCRC in April.

status_note.zh: 三者都在實驗記錄裡。pGEM-T Easy：6/12 的「TA cloning」以及 7/1-7/8 整串篩選，其 SnapGene 產物都帶 AmpR CDS。pJUMP-29：6/6 的 Golden Gate 組進「Vector (pJUMP29-1A)」，同日「Liquid Culture of pJUMP1A-pJUMP29-1D」在康黴素下養八個菌落，可見手上的版本是 1A 到 1D。pNW33N：4/22「Recover E. coli harboring pNW33N from BCRC」，4/28 以 Gibson 組成 pNW33N-L2(sfGFP)。MoClo 2.0 的 dropout 是從 pJUMP49-2B 擴增的，與 pJUMP29 是不同質體。（原始檔："Title: Liquid Culture of pJUMP1A-pJUMP29-1D ... Prepare TB with antibiotics ... kanamycin"）
status_note.en: All three are in the notebook. pGEM-T Easy: the 12 June 'TA cloning' entry and the whole 1-8 July screen series, and its SnapGene products carry an AmpR CDS. pJUMP-29: the 6 June Golden Gate assembles into 'Vector (pJUMP29-1A)' and the same day's 'Liquid Culture of pJUMP1A-pJUMP29-1D' grows eight colonies on kanamycin, so the variants in hand were 1A to 1D. pNW33N: 'Recover E. coli harboring pNW33N from BCRC' on 22 April, then Gibson-assembled into pNW33N-L2(sfGFP) on 28 April. The MoClo 2.0 dropout was amplified from pJUMP49-2B, a different plasmid from pJUMP29. Raw file reads: "Title: Liquid Culture of pJUMP1A-pJUMP29-1D ... Prepare TB with antibiotics ... kanamycin"

status_note.en: The 15 August 2026 entry, 'add zhenhen protectant to heat stress testing agar plates', dilutes the peptide 1/500 as 40 uL of peptide plus 19960 uL of ddH2O to 20 mL and sprays twice from about 15 cm with the plate vertical. The next day's entry puts all groups into the incubator at 37 C under white light for thermo priming, and the Agar Application of Protectant protocol gives the same 1/500 (19.96 mL + 40 uL), the same 15 cm and 'Observe for 5 days inside the incubator'. Raw file reads: "Dilute zhenhen protectant by 1/500 (40µL of peptide+19960µL of ddH₂O -> total:20mL)"

status_note.en: The 12 May 'pNW33N-L2 (sfGFP) plasmid linearization' entry in the May notebook digests the same seven plasmids purified earlier that day and carries the note that samples 1-7 are the plasmids from 5/12's purification made under 2.2 kV, 300 Ohm. Raw file reads: "Samples 1~7 are plasmids from 5/12's purification under the conditions of 2.2 kv, 300Ω. And the plasmid is pNW33N-L2 (sfGFP)"

statement.zh: 模組以 A 到 M 命名，clone 也以字母加數字命名（A1、B2、G3、H10、J9），模組 D 的 clone 卻是 B2、B4，容易與模組 B 的 B2 混淆。
statement.en: Modules are lettered A to M and clones are also lettered, A1, B2, G3, H10, J9, but module D's clones are B2 and B4, which collide with module B's clone B2.

status_note.zh: 模組 D 的 B2 與模組 B 的 B2 是不同菌落，原因是 clone 標籤其實是當天 colony PCR 的盤面字母，每次重新指派。6/24 的 B 盤是 PliaG-RBS0-CcaSm3-B0015（「Note: B: Positive clone」）；6/26 的 B 盤是 1C-Pveg-RBS0-CCaR-B0015（「Note: B2, B4 Positive clone」），6/27 的 miniprep 更寫成「B2 : 1C-Pveg-RBS0-CCaR-B0015 #2」。同一個字母、相隔兩天、兩個不同構築。模組字母 A 到 M 是另一套系統。（原始檔："B2 : 1C-Pveg-RBS0-CCaR-B0015 #2"）
status_note.en: Module D's B2 and module B's B2 are different isolates, and the reason is that clone labels are the plate letter of that day's colony PCR, reassigned every run. On 24 June plate B was PliaG-RBS0-CcaSm3-B0015 ('Note: B: Positive clone'); on 26 June plate B was 1C-Pveg-RBS0-CCaR-B0015 ('Note: B2, B4 Positive clone'), and the 27 June miniprep writes them out as 'B2 : 1C-Pveg-RBS0-CCaR-B0015 #2'. Same letter, two days apart, two constructs. The module letters A to M are a separate scheme. Raw file reads: "B2 : 1C-Pveg-RBS0-CCaR-B0015 #2"

status_note.zh: 20260614「Bioreactor growth test」條目證實日期、200 rpm 攪拌與 37°C：「Sample and measure OD600 culture in 37℃, 200rpm orbital shaker (flask) and 200 rpm stir (bioreactor)」。它也給出待問清單想知道的體積：加 20 mL 培養液到生物反應器與 500 mL 燒瓶。但有兩點它沒有說：取樣位置（完全沒提 sampler、儲液瓶出口或泵前），以及它把菌株寫成「Bacillus subtilis 169」，幾乎確定是 168 的筆誤，卻是六月兩次運轉在濕式記錄中唯一的菌株標示。（原始檔："Sample and measure OD600 culture in 37℃ , 200rpm orbital shaker (flask) and 200 rpm stir (bioreactor)"）
status_note.en: The 20260614 'Bioreactor growth test' entry confirms the date, the 200 rpm stirring and the 37 degrees C: 'Sample and measure OD600 culture in 37 degrees C, 200rpm orbital shaker (flask) and 200 rpm stir (bioreactor)'. It also gives the volumes the open question asked for: 20 mL of culture medium added to the bioreactor and to a 500 mL flask. Two things it does NOT say: where the sample was drawn from (no mention of a sampler, reservoir outlet or pump), and it writes the strain as 'Bacillus subtilis 169', which is almost certainly a typo for 168 but is the only strain designation in the wet lab record for the June runs. Raw file reads: "Sample and measure OD600 culture in 37℃ , 200rpm orbital shaker (flask) and 200 rpm stir (bioreactor)"

status_note.en: The notebook's own table settles the conflict in favour of 7.1 h. title.zh: Western blot 取樣

statement.zh: Run 4 中 wet lab 在 44 小時內九個時間點取腔側菌體裂解物、腔側培養基與殼側培養基做 Western blot。
statement.en: In run 4 the wet lab sampled lumen cell lysate, lumen medium and shell medium at nine points to 44 h for a western blot.

status_note.zh: 三種取樣部位與 44 h 的終點都在濕式記錄中。20260902「Bioreactor Sampling」條目（Chars 做）描述從 shell side 與 lumen side 取樣並將 lumen 沉澱物裂解，其 western blot 上樣為 lumen 細胞裂解液、lumen 培養液、shell 培養液的 16、18、20 h。20260905「SDS page electrophoresis」條目（Sophie C 做）跑兩片膠，每片九個樣品：lumen／lumen supernatant／shell supernatant 的 20、22、24 h，以及同三部位的 40、42、44 h。所以「九點」是每片膠九個 lane（三部位 × 三時間）；記錄上的取樣時間是 16、18、20、22、24、40、42、44 h，最早是 16 h，不是 Bioreactor 圖說寫的 14 h。（原始檔："Gel2: Ladder lumen40hr lumen42hr lumen44hr lumensupernatant40hr LS42hr LS44hr shellsupernatant40hr SS42hr SS44hr"）
status_note.en: The three fractions and the 44 h end point are in the wet lab record. The 20260902 'Bioreactor Sampling' entry (done by Chars) describes drawing shell-side and lumen-side samples and lysing the lumen pellet, and its western blot loads lumen cell lysate, lumen medium and shell medium at 16, 18 and 20 h. The 20260905 'SDS page electrophoresis' entry (done by Sophie C) loads two gels of nine samples each: lumen / lumen supernatant / shell supernatant at 20, 22 and 24 h, and the same three fractions at 40, 42 and 44 h. So 'nine points' is nine lanes per gel, three fractions at three times; the sampled times on the record are 16, 18, 20, 22, 24, 40, 42 and 44 h, and the earliest is 16 h, not the 14 h in the Bioreactor figure caption. Raw file reads: "Gel2: Ladder lumen40hr lumen42hr lumen44hr lumensupernatant40hr LS42hr LS44hr shellsupernatant40hr SS42hr SS44hr"

status_note.en: The only shell-side plating in the wet lab notebook is one line of the 20260902 Bioreactor Sampling entry, done by Chars: 'Sample the shell side medium at 16hr and 24hr. Spread on the LB plate overnight antibiotics'. Read against that line, the 24 h is a reactor run time point, not an incubation time, and the plates were incubated 'overnight' with no temperature given - so the Measurement Figure 23 caption ('after a 24 hour run') matches the notebook and 'read after 24 h at 37 C' does not. The entry also mentions only shell-side plates, names no lumen plate, gives no volume plated and records no result. Raw file reads: "Sample the shell side medium at 16hr and 24hr. Spread on the LB plate overnight antibiotics"

status_note.zh:

[14 Oct 濕實驗原始檔] 電子實驗記錄本在 9/19 沒有任何 LPA 執行紀錄。日期為 20260919 的五筆是 miniprep、電穿孔、PCR、跑膠與 Level 2 Golden Gate，另有 Gabriel 的上清液 western；LPA、lux、LED、PWM、umol 在各月記錄中除了 assay 協議本身以外都查無。9 月膠片資料夾中確實有一次疑似光照實驗，日期為 9/29，lane 標為 VG3/VR3/VG6/VR6/VG20/VR20/VG25/VR25 與 13G/13R/16G/16R。指導老師 10/13 的回覆與 registered forecast 檔仍支持此次執行與 37 C，所以這不是矛盾，只是缺少實驗台紀錄：值得向 Chars 或 Gabriel 問一句到底是 19 號還是 29 號，因為 WH-122 與 WH-128 沿用這個日期，群組標題與 Hardware、LPA 時間軸也會跟著動。（原始檔："Double check LEA, ACCD in supernatant"）
status_note.en:
37 °C confirmed by the instructor on 13 Oct. The registered forecast file names the strain WB800N; the wiki writes WB800.
[14 Oct wet lab raw files] The electronic lab notebook has no LPA run on 19 September. The five entries dated 20260919 are a miniprep, an electroporation, a PCR, a gel and a Level 2 Golden Gate assembly, plus Gabriel's supernatant western; LPA, lux, LED, PWM and umol return no hits in any month outside the assay protocol itself. A candidate optogenetic run does exist in the September gel folder dated 29 September, with lanes VG3/VR3/VG6/VR6/VG20/VR20/VG25/VR25 and 13G/13R/16G/16R. The instructor's 13 Oct answer and the registered forecast file still support the run and the 37 C, so this is not a contradiction, only an absent bench record: worth one question to Chars or Gabriel about whether the plate run is the 19th or the 29th, because WH-122 and WH-128 inherit the date and the group title and the Hardware and LPA timeline entries move with it. statement.en: The pressure transducers are BP8G-AGA: 0 to 1 MPa, 0 to 5 V output, 1.0% full-scale accuracy, 24 VDC supply.

status_note.zh: Biomanufacturing 參考文獻與硬體筆記：0 至 5 V 電壓輸出，經分壓到 3.3 V。Measurement：「輸出電流訊號，原生範圍 0 至 1 A」。Biomanufacturing 另寫精度 ±10 kPa，對比軸向壓降 11.6 kPa。
status_note.en: Biomanufacturing reference and hardware notebook: 0 to 5 V voltage output through a divider to 3.3 V. Measurement: "outputs a current signal, with a native range of 0 to 1 A". Biomanufacturing also notes ±10 kPa accuracy against an 11.6 kPa axial drop.

wiki.quote: BP8G-AGA pressure transmitter
The pressure transducer outputs a current signal, with a native range of 0 to 1 A

status_note.zh: Digital Twin 寫韌體讀四顆中的三顆；成本表列 3 顆；組裝指南四段各一顆。

1× pressure transducer

title.zh: 跨膜壓定義
title.en: Transmembrane pressure definition

statement.zh: Measurement 把 TMP 定義為（進料壓 - 截留壓）/ 2。
statement.en: Measurement defines TMP as (P feed - P retentate) / 2.

status_note.zh: Measurement 公式：TMP =（Pfeed - Pretentate）/2，但前一句寫腔側平均壓減殼側壓。Digital Twin：TMP_out = P_out - P_s。Measurement 自己註明 8 月 16 日的數字是沿腔側的壓降，不是跨膜壓差。
status_note.en: Measurement formula: TMP = (Pfeed - Pretentate)/2, while the sentence before it says mean lumen pressure minus shell pressure. Digital Twin: TMP_out = P_out - P_s. Measurement itself notes the 16 August figure is a drop along the lumen, not across the wall.

wiki.quote: calculate the transmembrane pressure using the standard approximation
the lumen drop minus the water column

statement.en: Pressure is read at 14-bit, sixteen-fold oversampled at 100 Hz, with peak, trough and mean of a one-second window every 200 ms.

status_note.zh: 韌體註解證實 14 位元 ADC；其餘數字未在 sketch.ino 逐行追查。
status_note.en: Firmware comment confirms a 14-bit ADC; the other figures were not traced line by line in sketch.ino.

status_note.zh: constants.json：tmp_limit_bar 0.5、feed_limit_bar 0.5；README 表格寫連續兩個 200 ms 視窗。

title.zh: 引用的 CcaS 峰值波長

title.zh: 氣泡濾波的連讀筆數
title.en: Burst size of the bubble filter

statement.zh: 光度計每個讀值是 14 筆計分的照度連讀，以中位數 ± 3·MAD 剔除。
statement.en: Each photometer reading is a burst of 14 scored lux readings cut at median ± 3·MAD.

status_note.zh: Photometer 與 Bioreactor：14 筆。Digital Twin：四筆暗讀、十六筆亮讀、前兩筆捨棄、十四筆計分。Measurement：「16 筆」以及「捨棄 2 筆暖機…再取 16 筆」。剔除率 42.9% 與 14.3% 正好是 14 取 6 與 14 取 2。
status_note.en: Photometer and Bioreactor: burst of 14. Digital Twin: four dark, sixteen lit, first two dropped, fourteen scored. Measurement: "a burst of 16 data points" and "Discard 2 warm-up readings… Take a burst of 16". Rejection rates of 42.9% and 14.3% equal 6 and 2 of 14.

wiki.quote: We take 14 lux readings in a short burst
Four dark readings, then sixteen lit, of which the first two are dropped
is determined by a burst of 16 data points

statement.en: OD600 = -log10(S / (K·R)), with K the sample-to-reference ratio on the blank; the dashboard multiplies by a path factor of five.

status_note.en: Run 3 raw CSV reproduces: at 30.77 h, 5 × log10(9.16 × 26.67 / 195.54) = 0.483, matching the logged 0.48336.

status_note.zh: 濕式記錄不支持生長測試從 6/6 跑到 6/10。六月記錄本的生物反應器生長測試日期為 20260606（0 到 390 分鐘），接續條目涵蓋 24 到 27 h，落在 6/7；六月之後要到 20260614 的 run 2 測試才再有生物反應器條目。所以 run 1 在濕式記錄這一側是 6/7、27 h 結束，儘管原始工作簿檔名是 260610。Prototype I 的組裝日期在濕式記錄本中完全沒有。（原始檔："Title: Bacillus subtilis growth rate in Bioreater (Continuous from 20260606) Purpose: continue 20260606 experiment"）
status_note.en: The wet lab record does not support a growth test running 6 to 10 June. The June notebook has the bioreactor growth test dated 20260606 (0 to 390 min) and its continuation covering 24 to 27 h, which lands on 7 June; there is no further bioreactor entry in June until the 20260614 run 2 test. So the wet lab side of run 1 ends on 7 June at 27 h, even though the raw workbook file is named 260610. The build date of Prototype I is not in the wet lab notebook at all. Raw file reads: "Title: Bacillus subtilis growth rate in Bioreater (Continuous from 20260606) Purpose: continue 20260606 experiment"

title.zh: BioDrop 拼法
title.en: BioDrop spelling

statement.zh: 參考儀器寫成 BioDrop、Biodrop 與 Bio-Drop。
statement.en: The reference instrument is written BioDrop, Biodrop and Bio-Drop.

status_note.zh: 應使用 BioDrop，而 Bio-Drop 在任何原始檔案中都沒有依據。唯一正式命名這台參考儀器的文件 Protocol/SiO2_OD600_Experiment_SOP.pdf 兩次寫「BioDrop or equivalent」。紀錄本用字不嚴謹（BioDrop 13 次、Biodrop 35 次、biodrop 9 次），但 Development 頁用的連字號寫法「Bio-Drop」在整個濕實驗語料中完全沒有出現。（原始檔："Benchtop spectrophotometer | BioDrop or equivalent, capable of a 1 mL sample at 1 cm pathlength, 600 nm"）
status_note.en: BioDrop is the form to use and Bio-Drop is not supported by any raw file. The only formal document that names the reference instrument, Protocol/SiO2_OD600_Experiment_SOP.pdf, writes 'BioDrop or equivalent' twice. title.zh: 反應器產出 1.056 g ACC/L/day
title.en: Reactor output 1.056 g ACC cleared per litre per day

statement.zh: 以 samyQ 構築測得的 7.25 mU mL⁻¹，換算為每公升上清液每小時清除 44.0 mg ACC，即每天 1.056 g。單一重複，高於偵測極限、低於定量極限。
statement.en: At the measured samyQ titre of 7.25 mU mL-1 the reactor clears 44.0 mg of ACC per litre of supernatant per hour, or 1.056 g per day. One replicate, above the limit of detection and below the limit of quantitation.

status_note.zh:
只有一孔、低於定量極限；批次時間未記錄，所以產速是推得而非量得。
〔10/14 乾實驗封存核對〕算式已重算無誤：7.25 mU/mL = 7.25 nmol min⁻¹ mL⁻¹ = 435 µmol L⁻¹ h⁻¹，乘 ACC 分子量 101.10 g/mol 得 43.98 mg L⁻¹ h⁻¹，24 小時為 1.056 g L⁻¹ d⁻¹。但輸入的 7.25 mU/mL 仍未見原始檔，批次時間也沒記錄，所以維持 pending。
status_note.en:
One well only and below the quantitation limit; batch duration was not recorded, so the production rate is inferred rather than measured.
[14 Oct dry lab archive check] The arithmetic reproduces: 7.25 mU/mL is 7.25 nmol min-1 mL-1, or 435 micromol L-1 h-1, which times the ACC molar mass of 101.10 g/mol gives 43.98 mg L-1 h-1 and 1.056 g L-1 d-1 over 24 hours. The input titre of 7.25 mU/mL still has no archived raw file and the batch duration was never recorded, so this stays pending.

wiki.quote: 7.25 mU mL−1 is 44.0 mg of ACC cleared per litre of supernatant per hour, or 1.056 g per day
Reactor output One replicate 1.056 g ACC cleared per L per day with samyQ

statement.zh: DNPH 比色法於培養上清液：WB800 宿主 A540 0.388、OD600 3.322、活性 0 mU mL⁻¹（定義為空白）；csn A540 0.404、OD600 2.638、3.31 mU mL⁻¹（低於偵測極限）；samyQ A540 0.423、OD600 3.058、7.25 mU mL⁻¹（偵測到，低於定量極限）。

status_note.zh:
未見原始 FlexA 讀值檔，n = 1。與區塊 3 用的 7.2514 mU mL⁻¹ 是同一次測定但位數不同。
〔10/14 乾實驗封存核對〕原始 FlexA 檔案仍未看到，狀態不動。封存提供的交叉檢查：8/23 的 permeate 門檻文件算出 30 分鐘、未濃縮 permeate 的 DNPH 定量極限為 3.3 mU/mL，csn 的 3.31 正落在極限上，samyQ 的 7.25 在其上但仍低於可靠定量帶——與頁面的註記一致。驗收門檻 1 mU/mL 也來自同一份文件。

The raw FlexA reading file was not seen and n = 1. Block 3 quotes the same assay as 7.2514 mU mL-1, to more digits.
[14 Oct dry lab archive check] The raw FlexA file has still not been seen, so the status does not move. The archive does supply a cross-check: the 23 August permeate threshold dossier computes a 3.3 mU/mL DNPH limit of quantitation for a 30-minute incubation on neat permeate, which is exactly where csn's 3.31 lands, with samyQ's 7.25 above it but still inside the unreliable band, consistent with the page's own annotations. The 1 mU/mL acceptance gate comes from the same dossier.

group.zh: 數學模型 · 區塊 2 光遺傳動力學

title.zh: 推得分泌酵素濃度 54 nM、1.96 mg/L
title.en: Implied secreted enzyme concentration 54 nM, 1.96 mg/L

statement.zh: 基質 43.0 mM 對 Km 3.4 mM，測定在 93% Vmax。修正得 Vmax = 7.82 mU mL⁻¹，以 kcat = 146 min⁻¹ 換算分泌酵素 53.6 nM 活性位，即 1.96 mg L⁻¹（36.5 kDa 次單元）。
statement.en: Substrate 43.0 mM against a Km of 3.4 mM puts the assay at 93% of Vmax. Correcting gives Vmax = 7.82 mU mL-1 and, with kcat = 146 min-1, a secreted enzyme concentration of 53.6 nM of active sites, or 1.96 mg L-1 using the 36.5 kDa subunit.

status_note.zh:
頁面自述這比 B. subtilis 異源分泌的已發表區間 4 至 200 mg L⁻¹ 的下限再低兩倍。
〔10/14 乾實驗封存核對〕推導鏈重算無誤：43.0 / 3.4 = 12.65 倍 K_M，即 12.65/13.65 = 92.7% 的 V_max；7.2514 / 0.927 = 7.82 mU/mL；7.82 nmol min⁻¹ mL⁻¹ ÷ 146 min⁻¹ = 53.6 nM 活性位；53.6 nM × 36.5 kDa = 1.96 mg/L。但 36.5 kDa 這個次單元質量本身有爭議（見 WM-025）：用我們構築的 37.636 kDa 會得 2.01 mg/L，用文獻文件的 41 kDa 會得 2.20 mg/L。54 nM 不受影響，mg/L 受影響。
status_note.en:
The page notes this sits a factor of two below the floor of the published 4 to 200 mg L-1 range for B. subtilis heterologous secretion.
[14 Oct dry lab archive check] The derivation reproduces: 43.0 / 3.4 is 12.65 times K_M, so 12.65/13.65 = 92.7% of V_max; 7.2514 / 0.927 = 7.82 mU/mL; 7.82 nmol min-1 mL-1 divided by 146 min-1 is 53.6 nM of active sites; and 53.6 nM times 36.5 kDa is 1.96 mg/L. The 36.5 kDa subunit mass is itself disputed, see WM-025: our construct's 37.636 kDa gives 2.01 mg/L and the dossier's 41 kDa gives 2.20 mg/L. The 54 nM figure is unaffected, the mg/L figure is not.

wiki.quote: a secreted enzyme concentration of 54 nM, or 1.96 mg L−1

group.zh: 數學模型 · 區塊 2 光遺傳動力學

title.zh: ACC deaminase 動力學常數 Km 3.4 mM、kcat 146 min⁻¹
title.en: ACC deaminase kinetics: Km 3.4 mM, kcat 146 per minute

statement.zh: 換算所用的動力學常數取自 Pseudomonas putida UW4：Km 3.4 mM、kcat 146 min⁻¹。四聚體約 144 kDa，每個次單元 36.5 kDa。
statement.en: The kinetic constants used are from Pseudomonas putida UW4: Km 3.4 mM and kcat 146 min-1. The enzyme is a homotetramer of about 144 kDa with 36.5 kDa per subunit.

status_note.zh: 〔10/14 乾實驗封存核對〕K_M = 3.4 ± 0.2 mM 與 k_cat = 146 ± 5 min⁻¹ 已由團隊自己的 ACCD permeate 門檻文件核對（出處 Hontzeas et al. 2004, P. putida UW4）。但次單元質量與寡聚體對不上：該文件用 41 kDa，releaf-model 參數表記我們構築的成熟蛋白為 37,636 Da，頁面寫 36.5 kDa；同一份文件談的是三聚體組裝，頁面寫約 144 kDa 的同源四聚體。需要蛋白組決定一個數字，因為它會動到 mg/L。
status_note.en: [14 Oct dry lab archive check] K_M = 3.4 +/- 0.2 mM and k_cat = 146 +/- 5 min-1 are confirmed by the team's own ACCD permeate threshold dossier, sourced to Hontzeas et al. 2004 on P. putida UW4. The subunit mass and the oligomer do not match: the dossier uses 41 kDa, the releaf-model parameter table records our construct's mature protein at 37,636 Da and the page says 36.5 kDa; the same dossier describes trimer assembly while the page says a homotetramer of about 144 kDa. The protein team has to pick one, because it moves the mg/L figure.

wiki.quote: Pseudomonas putida UW4, Km 3.4 mM, kcat 146 min−1

group.zh: 數學模型 · 區塊 2 光遺傳動力學

title.zh: DNPH 測定條件：43.0 mM ACC、pH 8.0、30 °C、30 min
title.en: DNPH assay conditions: 43.0 mM ACC, pH 8.0, 30 C, 30 min

statement.zh: ACC deaminase 活性以 DNPH 比色法測於培養上清液，反應條件為 43.0 mM ACC、pH 8.0、30 °C、30 分鐘，以 WB800 宿主上清液為空白。
statement.en: ACC deaminase activity was measured by DNPH colorimetry on culture supernatant at 43.0 mM ACC, pH 8.0, 30 C for 30 minutes, with WB800 host supernatant as the blank.

status_note.zh: 〔10/14 乾實驗封存核對〕反應條件本身仍只在 wiki 上（FlexA 原始檔不在封存裡），但封存有一個值得寫下來的交叉檢查：團隊 8/23 的 ACCD permeate 門檻文件算出標準 DNPH 流程在未濃縮 permeate 上、30 分鐘反應的定量極限是 3.3 mU/mL（15 分鐘是 6.7），並建議至少反應 2 小時。10/7 跑的是 30 分鐘，samyQ 讀 7.25、csn 讀 3.31 mU/mL，正好落在那個極限附近，與頁面「detected, below LOQ」「below LOD」的敘述一致。同一份文件也把 permeate 驗收門檻定在 ≥ 1 mU/mL，所以 samyQ 約為門檻的 7 倍。
status_note.en: [14 Oct dry lab archive check] The reaction conditions themselves are still wiki-only, since the FlexA raw file is not in the archive, but the archive does supply a cross-check worth writing down. The team's 23 August ACCD permeate threshold dossier computes the standard DNPH protocol's limit of quantitation on neat permeate as 3.3 mU/mL for a 30-minute incubation (6.7 for 15 minutes) and recommends at least 2 hours. The 7 October run was 30 minutes, samyQ read 7.25 and csn read 3.31 mU/mL, which sits right at that limit and is consistent with the page's 'detected, below LOQ' and 'below LOD'. The same dossier sets the permeate acceptance gate at 1 mU/mL or more, so the samyQ result is about 7 times the gate.

group.zh: 數學模型 · 區塊 2 光遺傳動力學

title.en: CcaSR transfer function K-half 4.66 +/- 0.63, n 1.88 +/- 0.16

statement.zh: Castillo-Hair 等人（2019）在 B. subtilis 量得 CcaSR 穩態反應的 Hill 參數：半飽和強度 K½ = 4.66 ± 0.63 µmol m⁻² s⁻¹、Hill 係數 n = 1.88 ± 0.16，動態範圍超過 70 倍。同一系統在 E. coli 為 K½ = 1.075、n = 2.737。
statement.en: Castillo-Hair et al. (2019) fitted the CcaSR steady-state response in B. subtilis to a Hill function with K-half = 4.66 +/- 0.63 micromol m-2 s-1 and n = 1.88 +/- 0.16, over a dynamic range exceeding 70-fold. The same system in E. coli gives K-half = 1.075 and n = 2.737.

status_note.zh:
頁面與參考文獻歸給 Castillo-Hair 等人（2019），但 build/model_figures.py 的常數註解寫「Ohlendorf et al. 2019, via the docx」。兩個出處要擇一。
〔10/14 乾實驗封存核對〕常數本身已核對：releaf-model 的參數表 level2_reserve 與 7/4 硬體規格凍結都記 Hill n = 1.88 ± 0.16、K½ = 4.66 ± 0.63 µmol m⁻² s⁻¹（526 nm），出處是 Castillo-Hair et al. 2019, Nat. Commun. 10:3099。歸屬衝突因此解決：頁面是對的，錯的是 releaf-wiki/build/model_figures.py:63 的註解「Ohlendorf et al. 2019, via the docx」，改一行即可。E. coli 的 K½ 1.075、n 2.737 在封存裡找不到，仍未核對。
status_note.en:
The page and its reference list credit Castillo-Hair et al. (2019) while the constant in build/model_figures.py is commented 'Ohlendorf et al. 2019, via the docx'. One attribution has to go.
[14 Oct dry lab archive check] The constants check out: level2_reserve in the releaf-model parameter table and the 4 July hardware spec freeze both carry Hill n = 1.88 +/- 0.16 and K-half = 4.66 +/- 0.63 micromol m-2 s-1 at 526 nm, attributed to Castillo-Hair et al. 2019, Nat. Commun. 10:3099. That resolves the attribution conflict in favour of the page: the error is the comment at releaf-wiki/build/model_figures.py:63, 'Ohlendorf et al. 2019, via the docx', which is a one-line fix. The E. coli values K-half 1.075 and n 2.737 are in no archived file and remain unchecked.

wiki.quote: K½ = 4.66 ± 0.63 µmol m−2 s−1 and Hill coefficient n = 1.88 ± 0.16

group.zh: 數學模型 · 區塊 2 光遺傳動力學

title.zh: 可用燈控區間 demand 0.015 至 0.94
title.en: Usable lamp control runs from demand 0.015 to 0.94

statement.zh: 由 demand 反推燈設定 I = K½ (f/(1−f))^(1/n)。低於 f = 0.015 算出的強度低於燈具下限；高於 f = 0.94 超過 20 µmol m⁻² s⁻¹ 上限，啟動子飽和，之上的 demand 對反應器無法區分。
statement.en: Inverting the Hill function as I = K-half (f/(1-f))^(1/n), below f = 0.015 the computed intensity falls under the lamp floor and above f = 0.94 it exceeds the 20 micromol m-2 s-1 ceiling, which saturates the promoter.

status_note.zh: 〔10/14 乾實驗封存核對〕以已核對的 K½ = 4.66、n = 1.88 反解 I = K½ (f/(1-f))^(1/n)：f = 0.015 得 0.50 µmol m⁻² s⁻¹（約 62 lux，低於燈的下限），f = 0.94 得 20.1 µmol m⁻² s⁻¹（超過 20 µmol 上限）。兩個邊界都重算得出。
status_note.en: [14 Oct dry lab archive check] Inverting I = K-half (f/(1-f))^(1/n) with the now-confirmed K-half = 4.66 and n = 1.88 gives 0.50 micromol m-2 s-1 at f = 0.015, about 62 lux and under the lamp floor, and 20.1 micromol m-2 s-1 at f = 0.94, over the 20 micromol ceiling. Both bounds recompute.

source.label: recomputed 14 Oct from the Hill inversion

wiki.quote: Below f = 0.015 the computed intensity falls under the lamp floor

group.zh: 數學模型 · 區塊 2 光遺傳動力學

title.zh: 照度換算 124 lux 每 µmol m⁻² s⁻¹
title.en: Illuminance conversion: 124 lux per micromol m-2 s-1

statement.zh: 以 526 nm 的光子能量（3.78 × 10⁻¹⁹ J，即 0.228 J µmol⁻¹）與該波長的明視覺光視效能（683 × 0.80 = 546 lm W⁻¹）換算，得 124 lux 每 µmol m⁻² s⁻¹。
statement.en: Using the photon energy at 526 nm (3.78e-19 J, or 0.228 J micromol-1) and the photopic luminous efficacy at that wavelength (683 x 0.80 = 546 lm W-1) gives 124 lux per micromol m-2 s-1.

status_note.zh: 〔10/14 乾實驗封存核對〕重算：526 nm 的光子能量 hc/λ = 3.777e-19 J，乘以亞佛加厥數得 0.2274 J µmol⁻¹；明視覺發光效率 683 × 0.80 = 546 lm W⁻¹；0.2274 × 546 = 124.2 lux per µmol m⁻² s⁻¹。與頁面一致。
status_note.en: [14 Oct dry lab archive check] Recomputed: the photon energy at 526 nm is hc/lambda = 3.777e-19 J, which is 0.2274 J per micromol, and the photopic luminous efficacy is 683 x 0.80 = 546 lm/W, so 0.2274 x 546 = 124.2 lux per micromol m-2 s-1. It matches the page.

wiki.quote: giving 124 lux per µmol m−2 s−1

statement.en: Lamp setpoints for six demand levels: 0.05 gives PPFD 0.97 and 121 lux; 0.1 gives 1.45 and 180; 0.25 gives 2.6 and 322; 0.5 gives 4.66 and 578; 0.75 gives 8.36 and 1,037; 0.9 gives 15.00 and 1,859.

title.zh: 從決策到葉內酵素 7.3 小時
title.en: 7.3 hours from decision to enzyme in the leaf

statement.zh: 五步驟合計 H = 7.3 h：轉錄延遲（到半飽和）1.8 h、累積所需量 2 h（假設佔位值）、收穫濃縮裝填 0.5 h、噴灑 0.1 h、經氣孔進入質外體 3 h。只算反應器的話是 4.2 h。
statement.en: The five steps total H = 7.3 h: transcription lag to half-max 1.8 h, accumulate required amount 2 h (assumed placeholder), harvest/concentrate/load 0.5 h, spray 0.1 h, and stomatal uptake into the apoplast 3 h. The reactor alone would be 4.2 h.

status_note.zh: 其中「累積所需量 2 h」是頁面自承的假設佔位值，不是量測。
status_note.en: The 2 h accumulation step is labelled on the page as an assumed placeholder, not a measurement.

title.zh: CcaSR 開燈半飽和 105 分、關燈半衰 75 分
title.en: CcaSR reaches half output 105 min on, 75 min off

statement.zh: 圖 16：開燈後 105 分鐘輸出達最終值的一半；關燈後 75 分鐘輸出降到一半。活化比去活化慢，系統在能確認逆境之前就必須投入生產。
statement.en: Figure 16: output rises to half of final 105 minutes after the lamp goes on and falls to half 75 minutes after it goes off. Activation is slower than deactivation, so the system commits to production before it can confirm the stress.

status_note.zh: 〔10/14 乾實驗封存核對〕t½ 開燈 105.1 ± 1.5 min、關燈 74.97 ± 0.39 min，與頁面的 105 分鐘與 75 分鐘一致，兩處來源相同（Castillo-Hair 2019）。
status_note.en: [14 Oct dry lab archive check] t-half on 105.1 +/- 1.5 min and off 74.97 +/- 0.39 min, matching the 105 and 75 minutes on the page, from the same source (Castillo-Hair 2019) in both archived places.

title.zh: 宿主與回路：B. subtilis WB800 帶 CcaSR、ho1、pcyA
title.en: Chassis: B. subtilis WB800 carrying CcaSR plus ho1 and pcyA

statement.zh: 反應器裝 Bacillus subtilis WB800，帶藍綠菌 CcaSR 雙組分系統。535 nm 綠光活化 CcaS，672 nm 紅光逆轉。CcaS 需要發色團 phycocyanobilin，B. subtilis 不會合成，所以構築必須同時帶 ho1 與 pcyA。
statement.en: The reactor holds Bacillus subtilis WB800 carrying the cyanobacterial CcaSR two-component system. Green light at 535 nm activates CcaS and red light at 672 nm reverses it. CcaS requires the chromophore phycocyanobilin, which B. subtilis does not synthesise, so the construct must also carry ho1 and pcyA.

status_note.zh: 〔10/14 乾實驗封存核對〕底盤與發色團的敘述成立：封存有 ho1+pcyA 的質體檔，參數表也記下 CcaSR 來源論文用 535/672 nm。要注意的是硬體用 520/660 nm，參數表自己標明這個偏移「尚未調和」，頁面若引用波長應該說清楚是論文的還是燈的。
status_note.en: [14 Oct dry lab archive check] The chassis and chromophore statement holds: the archive contains the ho1 + pcyA plasmid file, and the parameter table records that the CcaSR source paper used 535 / 672 nm. Note that the hardware runs 520 / 660 nm and the parameter table flags that offset as unreconciled, so any wavelength quoted on the page should say whether it is the paper's or the lamp's.

group.zh: 數學模型 · 區塊 2 光遺傳動力學

title.zh: 培養達 OD600 3.06，約 5.9 次倍增
title.en: Culture reached OD600 3.06, about 5.9 doublings

statement.zh: 培養達 OD600 3.06。以 LB、37 °C 下 29 分鐘的倍增時間推算，自 1:100 接種約 5.9 次倍增，含進入穩定期約 4 至 6 小時。批次時間未記錄。
statement.en: Culture reached OD600 3.06. At a doubling time of 29 min in LB at 37 C that is about 5.9 doublings from a 1:100 inoculum, or 4 to 6 h including the approach to stationary phase. Batch duration was not recorded.

status_note.zh:
批次時間未記錄，所以產速是推得的。倍增時間 28 至 30 分鐘取自文獻。
〔10/14 乾實驗封存核對〕OD600 3.06 與倍增次數的推算都只在 wiki 上；封存裡能對照的是 releaf-model 的 37 °C 擬合（logistic r = 1.3057 h⁻¹，對應倍增 31.9 分鐘，接近頁面用的 29 分鐘），但那是 2026-06-01 的 40 mL 搖瓶、無質體菌株，不是這一批。批次時間仍未記錄。
status_note.en:
Batch duration was not recorded, so the production rate is inferred. The 28 to 30 min doubling time is from the literature.
[14 Oct dry lab archive check] The OD600 of 3.06 and the doubling count are wiki-only. What the archive can offer alongside is the releaf-model 37 C fit, a logistic r of 1.3057 h-1 for a 31.9-minute doubling, close to the 29 minutes the page assumes, but that fit is a 40 mL shaken tube of plasmid-free cells from 1 June 2026, not this batch. The batch duration is still unrecorded.

wiki.quote: Culture reached OD600 3.06.

group.zh: 數學模型 · 區塊 2 光遺傳動力學

title.zh: 訊號不是生物量假象
title.en: The signal is not a biomass artefact

statement.zh: WB800 的 OD600 最高而吸光最低；samyQ 生物量較低而訊號較高。若背景來自細胞密度或分泌的羰基代謝物，兩者排序應一致。此論證與標準曲線無關。
statement.en: WB800 has the highest OD600 and the lowest absorbance while samyQ has lower biomass and higher signal. A background from cell density or secreted carbonyl metabolites would produce matching ranks, so the argument is independent of the standard curve.

wiki.quote: Signal is not a biomass artefact.

title.zh: P_cpcG2 誘導曲線完全未量測
title.en: The P_cpcG2 induction curve has never been measured

statement.zh: build/model_figures.py 產生的 pcpcg2-predicted-output 圖以虛線畫出，圖上標註「這條曲線上沒有任何一點被量過，形狀是 CcaS 的 Hill 函數，不是這個啟動子的」。OFF 1,500 MEFL、ON 漸近 30,000 MEFL。
statement.en: The pcpcg2-predicted-output figure built by build/model_figures.py is drawn dashed and labelled: nothing on the curve has been measured, the shape is the CcaS Hill function rather than the promoter's. OFF state 1,500 MEFL, ON asymptote 30,000 MEFL.

status_note.zh: 〔10/14 乾實驗封存核對〕補一筆：來源論文擬合的 MEFL 錨點記在 releaf-model 參數表為 y0 = 1,997.6、Δy = 106,740.5（ON 漸近線約 108,738 MEFL），而圖上用的是 1,500 與 30,000。圖已標明未測量，所以這只是外觀問題，但熟悉該論文的評審會注意到。
status_note.en: [14 Oct dry lab archive check] One addition: the MEFL anchors fitted in the source paper are recorded in the releaf-model parameter table as y0 = 1,997.6 and dy = 106,740.5, an ON asymptote near 108,738 MEFL, while the figure uses 1,500 and 30,000. The figure is already labelled as unmeasured so this is cosmetic, but a judge who knows the paper will notice.

title.zh: 介質中酵素半衰期未量測
title.en: The enzyme half-life in the medium has not been measured

statement.zh: 累積的活性在「產速 × 平均壽命」處飽和，再延長運轉不會增加。圖 19 以三種假設的介質半衰期作圖，頁面註明此製備的半衰期未被量測。
statement.en: Banked activity saturates at production rate times mean lifetime, so running longer adds nothing. Figure 19 plots three assumed medium half-lives and the page states the half-life has not been measured for this preparation.

status_note.zh: 介質半衰期與儲存穩定性都未量測，但區塊 3 的「先產後存」策略靠它。
status_note.en: Neither the medium half-life nor storage stability has been measured, yet the Block 3 produce-and-store strategy depends on them.

title.zh: 每公頃每次施用 4,082 L 培養液（情境值）
title.en: 4,082 L/ha of culture per modelled pass

statement.zh: 區塊 3 的工作情境：每公頃每次施用約 4,082 L 培養液當量，稀釋進 400 L 桶混液。來自一次回報的盤面處理量、一個假設的盤面面積，與一個未驗證的稻冠層修正。
statement.en: Block 3's working scenario is about 4,082 L/ha of culture-equivalent per modelled pass, formulated into 400 L of tank mix. It follows from a reported plate treatment, an assumed plate area and an unvalidated rice-canopy correction.

status_note.zh:
同一頁同時寫 4,082 L/ha（內文、摘要、結論）與 4,008 L/ha（三張圖與表格）。頁面解釋 4,008 是冠層修正取 2.4、4,082 是未取整的 2.444，相差 1.8%，但兩個數字仍並列在頁面上。待問清單第 25 題。
〔10/14 乾實驗封存核對〕兩個數字的來源都重算清楚了：1,670 L/ha × 2.444 = 4,081.5（頁面的 4,082），1,670 × 2.4 = 4,008。差距 1.8% 就是修正係數取捨位數的差別，與頁面的解釋一致。要用哪一個是編輯決定，不是資料爭議。
status_note.en:
The same page carries 4,082 L/ha in the prose, abstract and conclusion and 4,008 L/ha in the figures and tables. The page explains 4,008 uses a canopy correction rounded to 2.4 while 4,082 uses the unrounded 2.444, 1.8% apart, but both numbers still stand side by side. Open question 25.
[14 Oct dry lab archive check] Both numbers reproduce: 1,670 L/ha times 2.444 is 4,081.5, the page's 4,082, and 1,670 times 2.4 is 4,008. The 1.8% gap is exactly the rounding of the correction factor, as the page explains. Which one to carry is an editorial decision, not a data disagreement.

wiki.quote: about 4,082 L/ha of culture-equivalent per modelled pass

group.en: Math Model · Block 3 dose and payback

title.en: Canopy correction 2.44x, spanning 1.68 to 3.52

statement.zh: 稻冠層比幼苗盤多捕捉 16 倍噴液，但葉面積多 39 倍要分攤，淨效果是劑量乘 2.44 倍。葉面積指數 4.5（抽穗分化期）對盤面 0.115。此修正本身跨 1.68 至 3.52，對應 2,806 至 5,878 L 的帶寬。
statement.en: Rice catches 16x more spray than a seedling plate but carries 39x more leaf to share it among, so the dose is multiplied by 2.44x. Leaf area index 4.5 at panicle initiation against 0.115 on a seedling plate. The correction itself spans 1.68 to 3.52, a 2,806 to 5,878 L band.

status_note.zh:
頁面自承這是模型而非量測，是區塊 3 唯一一個被建模的步驟，也是最大的不確定來源。直接量稻葉面積與噴液捕捉率才能取代它。
〔10/14 乾實驗封存核對〕修正係數的算術重算吻合：葉面積指數 4.5 / 0.115 = 39.1 倍葉面積，除以 16 倍的噴灑攔截 = 2.444。頁面的 2.44 來自這裡。但 LAI、攔截倍數與每葉面積等效劑量這三個前提都是模型假設，頁面自己也說這是 Block 3 唯一的模型步驟，所以維持 pending。
status_note.en:
The page states this is a model and not a measurement, the only modelled step in Block 3 and the widest uncertainty in it. Measuring rice leaf area and spray capture directly would replace it.
[14 Oct dry lab archive check] The correction's arithmetic reproduces: a leaf area index of 4.5 against 0.115 is 39.1 times the leaf area, divided by 16 times the spray capture gives 2.444, which is where the page's 2.44 comes from. The leaf area index, the capture ratio and the equal-dose-per-leaf-area premise are all modelled, as the page itself says this is the only modelled step in Block 3, so it stays pending.

wiki.quote: Rice catches 16× more spray and carries 39× more leaf to share it among
the canopy correction, which alone spans 1.68 to 3.52

caption.en: Figure 23, the canopy correction

group.en: Math Model · Block 3 dose and payback

title.zh: 25 個作期中 17 個完全不觸發
title.en: 17 of 25 seasons never fire at all

statement.zh: 以 2001 至 2025 年雲林縣二期（二期）逐旬重建逆境指數，當本酵素可作用的逆境（此處為淹水）單獨達 1% 預期損失時，該旬合格釋放。25 個作期中有 17 個沒有任何一旬越過觸發門檻。
statement.en: Rebuilding the stress index dekad by dekad for every Yunlin second crop from 2001 to 2025, a dekad qualifies for release when the addressable stress, here waterlogging, reaches 1% expected loss on its own. 17 of the 25 seasons never cross the trigger.

wiki.quote: 17 of 25 seasons never fire at all
reaches 1% expected loss on its own

group.zh: 數學模型 · 區塊 3 劑量與回本
group.en: Math Model · Block 3 dose and payback

title.zh: 會觸發的中位作期需 9 次施用、36,072 L/ha
title.en: A median season that fires takes 9 passes, 36,072 L/ha

statement.zh: 四種基準：25 個作期平均 3.28 次、13,146 L/ha（僅供編列預算）；會觸發的中位作期 9 次、36,072 L/ha（實務規劃案）；第 90 百分位 12 次、48,096 L/ha（設備規模依據）；歷史最差（2001 與 2008）17 次、68,136 L/ha。
statement.en: Four bases: averaged over all 25 seasons 3.28 applications and 13,146 L/ha, for budgeting only; a median season that fires 9 and 36,072 L/ha, the realistic planning case; 90th percentile 12 and 48,096 L/ha, for sizing capacity; worst on record in 2001 and 2008, 17 and 68,136 L/ha.

status_note.zh:
施用次數建立在暫定的釋放規則與未量測的保護持續時間上，頁面自承是歷史模擬。
〔10/14 乾實驗封存核對〕四個基準的體積都重算吻合（以 4,008 L/ha 計）：3.28 → 13,146；9 → 36,072；12 → 48,096；17 → 68,136。施用次數本身是歷史模擬，觸發規則與保護期都未測量。
status_note.en:
The pass counts are historical simulations under a provisional trigger and an unmeasured protection lifetime, as the page states.
[14 Oct dry lab archive check] All four bases reproduce at 4,008 L/ha: 3.28 gives 13,146, 9 gives 36,072, 12 gives 48,096 and 17 gives 68,136. The pass counts themselves are historical simulations under an unmeasured trigger and protection lifetime.

wiki.quote: | A median season that fires | 9 | 36,072 | The realistic planning case
| Worst on record, 2001 and 2008 | 17 | 68,136

group.zh: 數學模型 · 區塊 3 劑量與回本
group.en: Math Model · Block 3 dose and payback

title.zh: 一公頃一次施用 4,008 L，稀釋進 400 L 桶混液
title.en: One hectare per application: 4,008 L neat, 400 L tank mix

statement.zh: 依地塊大小的生培養液量表：1 分（0.097 ha）389 L；5 分 1,944 L；1 甲（0.970 ha）3,887 L；1 公頃 4,008 L；3 公頃 12,024 L；10 公頃 40,080 L。每公頃一次施用稀釋進 400 L 桶混液。
statement.en: Litres of neat culture by field size for one application: 1 fen (0.097 ha) 389 L, 5 fen 1,944 L, 1 jia (0.970 ha) 3,887 L, 1 hectare 4,008 L, 3 hectares 12,024 L, 10 hectares 40,080 L. One application is diluted into 400 L of tank mix per hectare.

status_note.zh:
表格用 4,008 L/ha，內文與結論用 4,082 L/ha。見同組的 4,082 條目。
〔10/14 乾實驗封存核對〕表格一列一列重算吻合：4,008 L/ha 對應修正係數 2.4，而正文的 4,082 對應未取捨的 2.444。單次施用稀釋成每公頃 400 L 槽液的部分仍只在頁面上。
status_note.en:
The table uses 4,008 L/ha while the prose and conclusion use 4,082 L/ha. See the 4,082 fact in this group.
[14 Oct dry lab archive check] The table reproduces row by row: 4,008 L/ha corresponds to a correction factor of 2.4 while the prose's 4,082 corresponds to the unrounded 2.444. The dilution of one application into 400 L of tank mix per hectare is still wiki-only.

group.zh: 數學模型 · 區塊 3 劑量與回本
group.en: Math Model · Block 3 dose and payback

title.zh: 兩個逆境窗的作期：12 次、48,096 L
title.en: A two-window season: 12 applications, 48,096 L

statement.zh: 25 個作期中有 2 個（2007 與 2023）出現兩個逆境窗，即兩次分開的運轉：一公頃 12 次施用、全季 48,096 L 培養液與 4,800 L 桶混液。
statement.en: Two of the 25 seasons, 2007 and 2023, had two stress windows and therefore two separate runs: 12 applications on one hectare, 48,096 L of culture across the season and 4,800 L of tank mix.

status_note.zh: 〔10/14 乾實驗封存核對〕算術重算吻合：12 × 4,008 = 48,096 L，槽液 12 × 400 = 4,800 L。2007 與 2023 兩季有兩個窗口的判定來自同一組歷史模擬，未獨立核對。
status_note.en: [14 Oct dry lab archive check] The arithmetic reproduces: 12 times 4,008 is 48,096 L of culture and 12 times 400 is 4,800 L of tank mix. That 2007 and 2023 each had two stress windows comes from the same historical simulation and was not independently checked.

wiki.quote: 12 applications, 48,096 L of culture across the season and 4,800 L of tank mix

group.zh: 數學模型 · 區塊 3 劑量與回本
group.en: Math Model · Block 3 dose and payback

title.zh: 10 台機組生產一公頃份需 4.5 天
title.en: A 10-unit fleet needs 4.5 days per hectare-application

statement.zh: 反應器產速 34,807 mU 每反應器公升每天，即每公升培養液 0.2083 反應器公升日。一次施用的前置時間為培養體積除以總槽體積，再加 7.3 h 預報延遲。2 台（40 L）21.2 天；5 台（100 L）8.7 天；10 台（200 L）4.5 天；20 台（400 L）2.4 天。三公頃分別為 62.9、25.4、12.8、6.6 天。
statement.en: The reactor produces 34,807 mU per reactor-litre per day, which is 0.2083 reactor-litre-days per litre of culture. Lead time is culture volume over total vessel volume plus the 7.3 h forecast lag: 2 units (40 L) 21.2 d, 5 units (100 L) 8.7 d, 10 units (200 L) 4.5 d, 20 units (400 L) 2.4 d. For three hectares, 62.9, 25.4, 12.8 and 6.6 d.

status_note.zh: 〔10/14 乾實驗封存核對〕換算重算吻合：7,251.4 mU 每公升培養液 ÷ 34,807 mU 每反應器公升日 = 0.2083 反應器公升日/公升。各機組的前置時間則取決於未記錄的實際容積與該效價。
status_note.en: [14 Oct dry lab archive check] The conversion reproduces: 7,251.4 mU per litre of culture divided by 34,807 mU per reactor-litre-day is 0.2083 reactor-litre-days per litre. The per-fleet lead times then depend on the unrecorded working volumes and on that titre.

wiki.quote: | 10 units | 200 L | 4.5 d | 12.8 d | Only works with stock on hand
Lead time Too slow 4.5 days per application on 10 units, against a 3-day forecast

group.zh: 數學模型 · 區塊 3 劑量與回本
group.en: Math Model · Block 3 dose and payback

title.zh: 最差窗口（2008）需 16.4 天前置
title.en: The worst recorded window, 2008, needed 16.4 days of lead

statement.zh: 有用的天氣預報約提前 3 天。10 台機組生產一公頃份需 4.5 天，2008 年最差的窗口需要 16.4 天前置。反應器無法追著天氣跑，只能整季連續運轉並囤積存貨。
statement.en: The useful weather forecast runs about 3 days ahead. A 10-unit fleet takes 4.5 days per hectare-application and the worst recorded window in 2008 needed 16.4 days of lead. The reactor runs continuously through the season and builds stock instead of chasing the forecast.

status_note.zh: 頁面自承儲存穩定性因此是承重假設，而且未經量測。
status_note.en: The page states that storage stability is therefore load bearing and is unmeasured.

wiki.quote: the worst recorded window in 2008 needed 16.4 days of lead

group.zh: 數學模型 · 區塊 3 劑量與回本
group.en: Math Model · Block 3 dose and payback

title.zh: 一般水田回本 64.7 年，鹽化地 2.4 年
title.en: Payback 64.7 years on ordinary paddy, 2.4 on salt-affected land

statement.en: Payback table: ordinary paddy at efficacy 0.28, 10 units at NT$30,000 gives NT$4,635 a year and 64.7 years; at efficacy 1.00, NT$7,824 and 38.3 years; at NT$3,000 per unit, 3.8 years. Salt-affected land at efficacy 0.28 with 10 units gives NT$126,967 a year and 2.4 years; 50 units 11.8 years; efficacy 1.00 with 10 units NT$444,724 and 0.7 years.

status_note.zh:
效力 0.28 的來源未說明，與區塊 1 的 0.58 不一致。待問清單第 27 題。
〔10/14 乾實驗封存核對〕回收年數全部重算吻合，前提是 NT$30,000 為每機組單價而非十台總價：普通稻田 300,000 ÷ 4,635 = 64.7 年、300,000 ÷ 7,824 = 38.3 年；鹽化地 300,000 ÷ 126,967 = 2.4 年、50 台 1,500,000 ÷ 126,967 = 11.8 年、效價 1.00 時 300,000 ÷ 444,724 = 0.7 年。頁面若寫「10 units at NT$30,000」容易被讀成總價，建議寫成每台。另外鹽化地的年值隨效價近乎線性（0.28 → 1.00 為 3.50 倍），普通稻田卻只有 1.69 倍，頁面沒有說明這個上限從何而來。效價 0.28 的出處仍然沒有，且與 Block 1 的 0.58 不一致（第 27 題）。
status_note.en:
The source of efficacy 0.28 is not given and it disagrees with Block 1's 0.58. Open question 27.
[14 Oct dry lab archive check] Every payback year reproduces, provided NT$30,000 is the price per unit and not the total for ten: ordinary paddy 300,000 / 4,635 = 64.7 years and 300,000 / 7,824 = 38.3 years; salt-affected 300,000 / 126,967 = 2.4 years, 1,500,000 / 126,967 = 11.8 years for 50 units, and 300,000 / 444,724 = 0.7 years at efficacy 1.00. '10 units at NT$30,000' reads as a total, so it is worth writing as a per-unit price. Separately, the salt-affected annual value scales almost linearly with efficacy (3.50x from 0.28 to 1.00) while ordinary paddy only moves 1.69x, and the page does not say where that cap comes from. The source of efficacy 0.28 is still missing and disagrees with Block 1's 0.58, open question 27.

group.zh: 數學模型 · 區塊 3 劑量與回本
group.en: Math Model · Block 3 dose and payback

title.zh: 一般雲林水田每作可及損失 NT$4,429
title.en: Ordinary Yunlin paddy carries NT$4,429 per crop of addressable loss

statement.zh: 以 2026 官方產地價計算，一公頃一般雲林水田每作承受 NT$4,429 的可歸因於天氣、且本酵素可作用的損失。區塊 3 另發現一期在 25 年內從未越過釋放門檻，所以一年只有一作受益。
statement.en: At the official 2026 farm-gate price, a hectare of ordinary Yunlin paddy carries NT$4,429 per crop of weather-attributable loss this enzyme could address. Block 3 also finds the first crop never crosses the release threshold in 25 years, so only one crop a year benefits.

wiki.quote: carries NT$4,429 per crop of weather-attributable loss that this enzyme could address

group.zh: 數學模型 · 區塊 3 劑量與回本
group.en: Math Model · Block 3 dose and payback

title.zh: 五年回本需要效力 12.8，物理上不可能
title.en: A 5-year payback would need efficacy 12.8

statement.zh: 把效力推到物理上限 1.0，一般水田仍需 38.3 年。要達到 5 年回本需要效力 12.8，頁面稱之為不可能而非困難的目標。
statement.en: Pushing efficacy to the physical ceiling of 1.0 still leaves 38.3 years on ordinary paddy. A 5-year payback would need an efficacy of 12.8, which the page calls impossible rather than hard.

status_note.zh: 〔10/14 乾實驗封存核對〕38.3 年重算吻合（300,000 ÷ 7,824）。但「5 年回收需要效價 12.8」這個數字無法從表上任何一組數字重建：以效價 1.00 的年值回推是 60,000 ÷ 7,824 = 7.7，以 NT$4,429 的可處理損失回推是 60,000 ÷ 4,429 = 13.6。結論方向（不可能而非困難）成立，但 12.8 這個數字需要 Ethan 說明是哪一條算式。
status_note.en: [14 Oct dry lab archive check] The 38.3 years reproduces as 300,000 / 7,824. The claim that a five-year payback needs an efficacy of 12.8 does not reproduce from any combination of the printed numbers: working back from the efficacy-1.00 annual value gives 60,000 / 7,824 = 7.7, and working back from the NT$4,429 of addressable loss gives 60,000 / 4,429 = 13.6. The direction of the conclusion, impossible rather than hard, holds, but the 12.8 itself needs Ethan to say which chain produced it.

wiki.quote: A 5-year payback would need an efficacy of 12.8

title.zh: 酵素四聚體 9.4 nm，勉強通過 10 nm 排阻極限
title.en: The 9.4 nm tetramer only just clears the 10 nm exclusion limit

statement.zh: 角質層水性孔徑 4 至 5 nm，對 9.4 nm 的活性四聚體是兩倍排阻。氣孔路徑的尺寸排阻極限約 10 nm，9.4 nm 的四聚體只是勉強通過。
statement.en: Cuticular aqueous pores are 4 to 5 nm against the 9.4 nm active tetramer, a two-fold exclusion. Along the stomatal route the size-exclusion limit is about 10 nm and the 9.4 nm tetramer clears it only just.

wiki.quote: the size-exclusion limit is about 10 nm, and the 9.4 nm tetramer clears it only just

title.zh: 稻葉氣孔密度：上表皮 186.7、下表皮 621.0 /mm²
title.en: Rice stomatal density: 186.7 adaxial, 621.0 abaxial per mm2

statement.zh: 水稻為兩面氣孔型：上表皮約每平方毫米 186.7 個、下表皮 621.0 個（品種 IR64）。噴灑落在上表皮。
statement.en: Rice is amphistomatous with about 186.7 stomata per mm2 on the upper surface and 621.0 on the lower (cultivar IR64). A spray lands on the upper one.

wiki.quote: Rice stomatal density: IR64, 186.7 mm−2 adaxial and 621.0 mm−2 abaxial

group.en: Math Model · Block 3 dose and payback

title.zh: 頁面自承四個錯誤但只列出一個
title.en: The page says four errors were caught but lists only one

statement.zh: 「Where improvements need to be made」寫有四個錯誤在草稿階段被抓到，表中只列出一個：原先寫「酵素通過綽綽有餘」，因為拿 9.4 nm 四聚體去比約 2,000 nm 的氣孔開口；真正的障礙是約 10 nm 的排阻極限。另外三個沒有任何紀錄。
statement.en: The 'Where improvements need to be made' section says four errors survived into drafts and lists one: the claim that the enzyme passes with room to spare, which compared a 9.4 nm tetramer with the roughly 2,000 nm stomatal aperture when the barrier is the 10 nm exclusion limit. The other three are not recorded anywhere.

status_note.zh: 另外三個錯誤沒有寫下來。待問清單第 28 題，問 Ethan。
status_note.en: The other three errors are not written down anywhere. Open question 28, to ask Ethan.

wiki.quote: Four errors survived into drafts of this page before we caught them.
The other three are not recorded anywhere, so they are not listed here.

title.zh: 回本以鹽害計價，噴灑排程以淹水計次
title.en: Payback is priced on salinity while the schedule is counted from waterlogging

statement.zh: 頁面自承的最大未解問題：回本數字以鹽害計價，但同一區塊的噴灑排程是從淹水旬數算出來的。鹽害是慢性的、每天都在土裡，沒有可供預報捕捉的事件，區塊 1 的指數也不帶它。要讓兩者一致必須以鹽敏感生育期重建釋放規則，約需 30 天窗口內 15 次施用，而非 9 次。
statement.en: The page states its largest open problem: the payback is priced on salinity while the spray schedule in the same block is counted from waterlogging dekads. Salinity is chronic and has no event for a forecast to catch, and Block 1 does not carry it in the index. Reconciling them means rebuilding the release rule around salt-sensitive growth stages, roughly 15 applications over a 30-day window instead of 9.

status_note.zh: 這是頁面自承的最大開放問題，尚無解法。
status_note.en: This is the page's own statement of its largest open problem and it has no resolution yet.

wiki.quote: The payback is priced on salinity. The spray schedule, in the same block, is counted from waterlogging dekads.
roughly 15 applications over a 30-day window instead of 9

title.zh: 摘要稱逆境指數為 Validated
title.en: The summary labels the stress index 'Validated'

statement.zh: 關鍵結果條狀列把逆境指數標為「Validated」。待問清單第 26 題問這個字是否要改。
statement.en: The key-results strip labels the stress index 'Validated'. Open question 26 asks whether that word should change.

status_note.zh: 需要決定是否改字；2026 盲測只有 4 of 16 縣進來，頁面自己也說四縣太少。
status_note.en: A decision is needed on the wording, given the 2026 blind test has only 4 of 16 counties in and the page itself says that is too few.

title.zh: 三項能改變估計的實驗尚未做
title.en: Three experiments that would change the estimates are outstanding

statement.zh: 頁面列出三個會大幅改變估計的實驗：量測酵素在葉面的存留時間、找出最小有效劑量、量測稻冠層的噴液捕捉率。
statement.en: The page lists three experiments that could change the estimates substantially: measuring how long the enzyme lasts on leaves, finding the minimum effective dose, and measuring spray capture on rice canopies.

title.zh: 2026-10-07 DNPH 活性測定
title.en: 2026-10-07: DNPH ACC deaminase activity assay

statement.zh: DNPH ACC deaminase 活性測定於 2026 年 10 月 7 日進行，FlexA A540 讀值，n = 1，測得反應器 permeate 7.2514 mU mL⁻¹。

status_note.zh: 樣品來自哪一批 permeate 沒有寫。待問清單第 6 題。

title.zh: 99.2% 的農場小於 2 公頃，耕作 85.3% 的農地
title.en: 99.2% of farms are under 2 hectares and work 85.3% of farmed land

statement.zh: 台灣 99.2% 的農場為兩公頃以下的小農，合計耕作全島 85.3% 的農地。同頁另一處寫「99% 的台灣農民耕作兩公頃以下」。
statement.en: In Taiwan 99.2% of farms are small-scale, under 2 hectares, yet together they work 85.3% of the island's farmed land. Elsewhere the same page says 99% of Taiwanese farmers work under 2 hectares.

status_note.zh: 同頁兩處寫 99.2% 與 99%，應統一。來源為 2020 農林漁牧業普查。
status_note.en: The page carries both 99.2% and 99% and should settle on one. The source is the 2020 census of agriculture, forestry, fishery and animal husbandry.

wiki.quote: 99.2% of farms are small-scale (under 2 hectares), yet together they work 85.3%
Since 99% of Taiwanese farmers work under 2 hectares

title.zh: 夜溫每升一度，稻作產量掉 10%
title.en: Each degree of night warming costs about 10% of rice yield

statement.zh: 菲律賓研究站 25 年的追蹤顯示，1979 至 2003 年間夜間最低溫上升速度是日間最高溫的三倍以上，夜溫每上升一度對應約 10% 的穀粒產量下降，而日間高溫本身幾乎沒有影響。
statement.en: A 25-year record at a Philippine research station found night-time minimum temperatures rose more than three times faster than daytime maximums between 1979 and 2003, with grain yield falling about 10% per degree of night warming while daytime heat alone showed almost no effect.

status_note.zh: 頁面沒有給這篇研究的完整引用（只寫 UC Davis、IRRI 與廣州、武漢的合作者）。
status_note.en: The page does not give a full citation for this study, only UC Davis, IRRI and collaborators in Guangzhou and Wuhan.

wiki.quote: a drop in 10 percent yield per each rise in degree

title.zh: 台灣升溫自 1991 年起加速到每十年 0.29 °C
title.en: Taiwan's warming has accelerated to 0.29 C per decade since 1991

statement.zh: 台灣近一世紀的平均氣溫上升約每十年 0.11 °C；自 1991 年起這個速率幾乎變成三倍，達每十年 0.29 °C。2024 年成為台灣有紀錄以來最熱的一年，台北有 63 天超過 35 °C。
statement.en: For nearly a century Taiwan's average temperature rose by about 0.11 C per decade. Since 1991 that rate has nearly tripled to 0.29 C per decade, with 2024 becoming Taiwan's hottest year on record and Taipei logging 63 days above 35 C.

wiki.quote: Since 1991, that rate has nearly tripled to 0.29ºC per decade
2024 was Taiwan's hottest year on record; with 63 days above 35°C

title.zh: 路網路徑模型：613 家公司、2,792,536 筆地籍、346 個需求節點
title.en: Routing model: 613 companies, 2,792,536 parcels, 346 demand nodes

statement.zh: 全國 GIS 路徑模型把台灣 613 家登記肥料公司連到實際農地：2,792,536 筆個別地籍，依鄉鎮市區彙整為 346 個需求節點，涵蓋約 743,500 公頃可耕地。每家公司只配送到同縣內的農地，使用實際路網距離而非直線距離。
statement.en: A nationwide GIS routing model connects Taiwan's 613 registered fertilizer companies to real farmland: 2,792,536 individual parcels aggregated by township into 346 demand nodes covering roughly 743,500 hectares of arable land. Each company is routed only to farmland inside its own county, using live road-network distance.

wiki.quote: 2,792,536 individual parcels, aggregated by township into 346 demand nodes

title.zh: 台灣肥料施用超過每公頃 300 公斤
title.en: Taiwan applies more than 300 kg of fertilizer per hectare

statement.zh: 台灣面積 36,200 平方公里，肥料施用超過每公頃 300 公斤；美國約每公頃 128 公斤，國土面積 983 萬平方公里。台灣僅約四分之一國土可供農業使用，美國約五分之二。
statement.en: Taiwan, at 36,200 square kilometres, consumes more than 300 kilograms of fertilizer per hectare against roughly 128 kilograms per hectare in the United States, a country of 9.83 million square kilometres. Only about a quarter of Taiwan's land is viable for agriculture against roughly two-fifths in the US.

status_note.zh: 同頁摘要寫「超過每公頃 300 公斤」，肥料表與影響段寫 2025 年養分強度 449 kg N+P+K/ha、約美國的 3.5 倍。兩個數字的定義（產品重量 vs 養分重量）沒有在頁面上區分。
status_note.en: The problem statement says more than 300 kg/ha while the table and the impact section give 449 kg N+P+K/ha for 2025, about 3.5x the US. The page never distinguishes product weight from nutrient weight.

wiki.quote: consumes more than 300 kilograms of fertilizer per hectare
449 kg of N+P+K per hectare in 2025 versus about 128 kg/ha in the US

title.zh: 2025 年肥料施用 792,963 公噸、養分強度 449 kg/ha
title.en: 2025 fertilizer: 792,963 tonnes, nutrient intensity 449 kg/ha

statement.zh: 圖 7 的年度肥料消費表：2025 年施用 792,963 公噸（產品重量），養分強度 449 kg N+P+K/ha，氮 133,041 t、磷 50,742 t、鉀 80,586 t，價值 NT$7,994 百萬。2011 年為 1,105,732 公噸、581 kg/ha。2014 與 2019 的養分欄標為 flagged。
statement.en: Figure 7's annual fertilizer table: 2025 applied 792,963 tonnes of product weight at a nutrient intensity of 449 kg N+P+K/ha, with 133,041 t nitrogen, 50,742 t phosphorus and 80,586 t potassium, valued at NT$7,994 million. 2011 was 1,105,732 tonnes at 581 kg/ha. The 2014 and 2019 nutrient columns are marked flagged.

status_note.zh: 2014 與 2019 的養分強度與部分養分欄在表上標為 flagged，原因沒有寫。
status_note.en: The 2014 and 2019 nutrient intensity and some nutrient columns are marked flagged in the table with no reason given.

title.zh: 保護效果：中度鹽害保住 86.3%、重度 25.3%
title.en: Protection holds 86.3% at moderate and 25.3% at severe salinity

statement.zh: ACC deaminase 前處理保住葉綠素含量，在中度鹽害（約 75 mM NaCl）維持未逆境表現的 86.3%，重度鹽害（約 100 mM NaCl）維持 25.3%，對照的是文獻預測的未保護水稻損失曲線。
statement.en: ACC deaminase pretreatment preserves chlorophyll content, holding 86.3% of unstressed performance at moderate salinity (about 75 mM NaCl) and 25.3% at severe salinity (about 100 mM NaCl), benchmarked against the literature-predicted loss curve for unprotected rice.

status_note.zh: 86.3% / 25.3% 在倉庫裡找不到可追溯的來源，頁面只寫「assay 記錄在 Wet Lab 段」。這兩個數字撐起後面所有 NT$ 與回本計算。待問清單第 29 題。
status_note.en: No traceable source for 86.3% / 25.3% was found in the repo; the page only says the assay is documented in the Wet Lab section. These two numbers carry every NT$ and payback figure after them. Open question 29.

wiki.quote: holding onto 86.3% of unstressed performance at moderate salinity

title.zh: 中度逆境每作淨效益 NT$61,786/ha
title.en: Net benefit NT$61,786 per crop at moderate stress

statement.zh: 以 2026 保價 NT$26/kg 計，中度逆境的一公頃從未保護的約 NT$60,996 收益變成受保護的 NT$122,782，每作淨效益 NT$61,786。重度逆境為 NT$21,216 對 NT$49,396，淨效益 NT$28,180。雙期作兩個數字再約翻倍。
statement.en: At the 2026 guaranteed rate of NT$26/kg, a moderately stressed hectare goes from about NT$60,996 unprotected to NT$122,782 protected, a net benefit of NT$61,786 per crop. Under severe stress it is NT$21,216 against NT$49,396, a NT$28,180 net benefit. Double-cropping roughly doubles both again.

status_note.zh: 與數學模型區塊 1 的 NT$7,539/ha（中度一期逆境代價）相差約 8.2 倍，兩頁沒有互相說明。
status_note.en: This is about 8.2x the NT$7,539/ha Math Model Block 1 puts on a moderate first-crop stressed season, and neither page reconciles the two.

wiki.quote: NT$60,996 in unprotected revenue to NT$122,782 protected, a net benefit of NT$61,786 per crop

title.zh: 土壤類型決定機組密度與回本：黏土 10 台 4.6 年，砂壤 50 台 23.0 年
title.en: Soil sets unit density and payback: clay 10 units 4.6 y, sandy loam 50 units 23.0 y

statement.zh: 每台固定 NT$30,000。黏土每公頃只需 10 台，中度逆境下約 4.6 年回本；砂壤需 50 台達成同樣覆蓋，需 23.0 年。壤土、Inceptisol、Alfisol 約 7 至 10 年。砂壤既是沿海最受鹽害的土類，也是五類中回本最慢的。以上皆假設一年一作，雙期作約使回本期減半。
statement.en: At a fixed NT$30,000 per unit, clay soils need only 10 units per hectare and break even in about 4.6 years under moderate stress, while sandy loam needs 50 units for the same coverage and takes 23.0 years. Loam, Inceptisol and Alfisol recover in roughly 7 to 10 years. Sandy loam is both the most salt-exposed coastal soil and the slowest to pay back. Every figure assumes one crop a year; double-cropping roughly halves each period.

status_note.zh: 覆蓋半徑與每公頃台數與 build/model_figures.py 的 SOILS 常數一致：砂壤 r = 8 cm / 50 台、壤土 12 cm / 22、Inceptisol 13 cm / 19、Alfisol 14 cm / 16、黏土 18 cm / 10。回本年數本身未在原始檔中核對。
status_note.en: The coverage radii and units per hectare match the SOILS constant in build/model_figures.py: sandy loam r = 8 cm and 50 units, loam 12 cm and 22, Inceptisol 13 cm and 19, Alfisol 14 cm and 16, clay 18 cm and 10. The payback years themselves were not checked against a raw file.

wiki.quote: clay soils need only 10 units/ha and break even in about 4.6 years
sandy loam needs 50 units/ha for the same coverage and takes 23.0 years

caption.zh: 依土壤質地的每公頃反應器數
caption.en: Bioreactors needed per hectare by soil texture

title.zh: 機組資本成本 NT$30,000 每台
title.en: Unit capital cost NT$30,000

statement.zh: 部署密度與回本計算都以每台反應器 NT$30,000 的資本成本為基礎；數學模型區塊 3 也引用同一數字，並註明來自 Geospatial Analysis。
statement.en: Deployment density and payback both rest on a capital cost of NT$30,000 per reactor unit. Math Model Block 3 cites the same number and attributes it to Geospatial Analysis.

status_note.zh: 這個單價的依據（報價、材料表還是估計）沒有寫在任何一頁上。
status_note.en: Neither page says whether NT$30,000 is a quote, a bill of materials or an estimate.

wiki.quote: Applying unit cost (NT$30,000) to the deployment densities calculated above
Geospatial Analysis: capital cost NT$30,000 per unit

title.zh: 減 25% 化肥每年每公頃省約 NT$3,395
title.en: 25% less fertilizer saves about NT$3,395/ha/year

statement.zh: 以 2025 年全國肥料量值推得每公斤養分 NT$30.24，每公頃每年肥料支出約 NT$13,578。南台灣乾濕交替稻作的田間試驗顯示 ACC deaminase PGPR 處理可在減少 25% 化肥下維持產量，換算每公頃每年省約 NT$3,395。對應的運輸與足跡節省很小：肥料零售商距所服務農地中位數 0.4 公里，減 25% 約等於每公頃每年省 NT$2 運費與 0.03 kg CO₂。
statement.en: From national 2025 fertilizer value and volume data the nutrient price is NT$30.24 per kg, giving about NT$13,578/ha/year in fertilizer spend. A southern-Taiwan field trial on rice under alternate wetting and drying showed ACC-deaminase PGPR treatment sustains yield at 25% less chemical fertilizer, worth roughly NT$3,395/ha/year. The matching freight saving is marginal: retailers sit a median 0.4 km from the farmland they serve, so 25% less fertilizer moved is about NT$2/ha/year and 0.03 kg CO2/ha/year.

wiki.quote: that's roughly NT$3,395/ha/year saved on fertilizer purchase

title.zh: 有機規範排除 ReLEAF，可及市場約 96% 耕地
title.en: Organic rules exclude ReLEAF; the addressable market is about 96% of land

statement.zh: 台灣有機農業促進法排除任何基因改造生物的產品進入有機驗證生產，不論是否密閉。因為 ACC deaminase 由工程菌株生產，ReLEAF 被排除在有機與友善環境耕作之外，約佔耕地 3.7%。可及市場為慣行農業，約佔耕地 96%。
statement.en: Taiwan's Organic Agriculture Promotion Act excludes any product of a genetically modified organism from certified organic production, regardless of containment. Because ACC deaminase is produced by an engineered strain, ReLEAF is excluded from organic and friendly-environment farming, about 3.7% of cultivated land. The addressable market is conventional agriculture, roughly 96%.

wiki.quote: about 3.7% of cultivated land, but a disproportionately significant one

title.zh: 砂壤的資本成本約為年營收五倍
title.en: Sandy loam capital cost is about five times annual revenue

statement.zh: 把每台 NT$30,000 套到計算出的部署密度上，每公頃資本成本在每一種土壤類型都達到或超過一整年的水稻毛收益，在砂壤（模型標示最需要機組的土類）約為年營收五倍。因此共有制而非個人持有是數字允許的唯一所有權結構。
statement.en: Applying NT$30,000 per unit to the computed deployment densities puts capital cost per hectare at or above one full year of gross paddy revenue in every soil type, and roughly five times annual revenue in sandy loam, the class the model flags as needing the most units. A shared-asset model through farmers' associations is the only ownership structure the numbers permit.

wiki.quote: roughly five times annual revenue in sandy loam

title.zh: GIS 軟體與主要資料集
title.en: GIS software and principal datasets

statement.zh: 分析使用 QGIS 3.44 LTR。主要資料來源包含中央氣象署 CODiS 觀測資料、農業部農業資料開放平臺（詳測土壤圖、縣市稻作每公頃產量、肥料管理整合資訊、臺灣地區肥料產銷量值）、2020 農林漁牧業普查、國家災害防救科技中心 TCCIP，以及世界銀行肥料消費指標。
statement.en: The analysis uses QGIS 3.44 LTR. Principal sources include Central Weather Administration CODiS observations, Ministry of Agriculture open data (detailed soil map, county rice production per hectare, fertilizer management information, Taiwan area fertilizer production and sales), the 2020 census of agriculture, the NSTC TCCIP platform, and World Bank fertilizer consumption data.

wiki.quote: QGIS geographic information system (Version 3.44 LTR)

title.zh: 土壤分類仍是地貌啟發式的佔位值
title.en: The soil classification is still a geomorphology placeholder

statement.zh: 目前的土壤分類是以地貌為基礎的啟發式規則，它把砂壤（需求最高、回本最慢的土類）指派得最廣。頁面自承這是以 TARI 地籍解析土壤調查資料取代佔位分類的最強理由。
statement.en: The current soil classification is a geomorphology-based heuristic that assigns sandy loam, the highest-need and slowest-payback class, most broadly. The page states this is the strongest argument for replacing the placeholder with parcel-resolved TARI soil survey data.

status_note.zh: 佔位分類直接決定共有制在某個鄉鎮是否划算，尚未替換。
status_note.en: The placeholder classification directly decides whether the ownership model is viable in a given township, and has not been replaced.

wiki.quote: This is the strongest argument for replacing the placeholder classification with parcel-resolved TARI soil survey data.

title.zh: 葉綠素 a+b 以 OD645、OD663 與 80% 丙酮定量
title.en: Chlorophyll a+b quantified at OD645 and OD663 in 80% acetone

statement.zh: 葉綠素 a+b 以分光光度法定量：80% 丙酮萃取後讀 645 nm 與 663 nm，依公式 Chl(a+b) = [8.02(OD663 − blank) + 20.20(OD645 − blank)] × V / 1000。結果同時以原始濃度與鮮重正規化後回報。
statement.en: Chlorophyll a+b was quantified spectrophotometrically after extraction in 80% acetone, reading 645 nm and 663 nm, using Chl(a+b) = [8.02(OD663 - blank) + 20.20(OD645 - blank)] x V / 1000. Results were reported both as raw concentration and normalised against fresh tissue weight.

wiki.quote: following extraction in 80% acetone, using the standard formula

title.zh: 未處理對照組在所有鹽度下葉綠素都低
title.en: Untreated controls show low chlorophyll at every salinity

statement.zh: 未處理對照組在所有鹽度下的葉綠素含量都偏低，顯示此實驗的萃取或生長條件偏保守而非最佳。每一組 ACCD 處理，無論施用時機，在相同鹽度下都比對應對照保留更多葉綠素。
statement.en: Untreated controls showed low chlorophyll content across all salinity levels, which suggests the extraction or growth conditions in this experiment were conservative rather than optimal. Every ACCD-treated group, regardless of timing, retained more chlorophyll than its matched control at the same salinity.

status_note.zh: 頁面沒有給這組葉綠素資料的數值、n 或檔案路徑，而 86.3% / 25.3% 應該由它推得。
status_note.en: The page gives no values, n or file path for this chlorophyll dataset, which is presumably what 86.3% / 25.3% are derived from.

wiki.quote: Every ACCD-treated group, regardless of timing, showed higher chlorophyll retention

title.zh: 三系統交叉驗證：洋菜、水耕、土壤
title.en: Cross-system validation: agar, hydroponics, soil

statement.zh: 功能性測定跨三個系統驗證：洋菜（直接生理效果，無運輸干擾，基準效力）、水耕（經根圈水的液相遞送，運輸相依效力）、土壤（吸附、降解、真實土壤基質的非均質流動，實地測試）。目前的葉綠素資料只在洋菜上收集。
statement.en: The functional assay is validated across three systems: agar for direct physiological effect with no transport confound, hydroponics for liquid-phase delivery through root-zone water, and soil for adsorption, degradation and heterogeneous flow. The chlorophyll data so far was collected on agar only.

status_note.zh: 土壤驗證尚未完成，但 GIS 的覆蓋半徑與每公頃台數在頁面上被當成量測結果而非未驗證推估。
status_note.en: Soil validation is not done, yet the GIS coverage radius and units per hectare are presented as measured results rather than untested projections.

wiki.quote: | Soil | Adsorption, degradation, heterogeneous flow through real soil matrix | Real-field testing

title.zh: 農民訪談地點與平均氣溫表
title.en: Farmer interview locations and average temperatures

statement.zh: 公開論壇訪談的農民主作物與地點：可可（南投 24.3 °C；屏東 25.9 °C）、桃與梨（花蓮中和 24.2 °C）、咖啡（關西馬武督 24.5 °C）、果樹（新竹 24 °C；苗栗 23.3 °C）、稻與水果（宜蘭 23.4 °C）、雜糧（嘉義 24.3 °C）、蔬菜（新竹 24.5 °C）、蔬果（宜蘭與台中 23.4 與 24.5 °C）。
statement.en: Farmers interviewed at the public forum, by main crop and location: cacao (Nantou 24.3 C; Pingtung 25.9 C), peaches and pears (Hualien Zhonghe 24.2 C), coffee beans (Guanxi Mawudu 24.5 C), fruit trees (Xingzhu 24 C; Miaoli 23.3 C), rice and fruits (Yilan 23.4 C), mixed grains (Chiayi 24.3 C), vegetables (Hsinzhu 24.5 C), fruits and vegetables (Yilan and Taichung 23.4 and 24.5 C).

status_note.zh: 同一張表把新竹寫成 Xingzhu 與 Hsinzhu 兩種拼法，氣溫也不同（24 與 24.5）。
status_note.en: The same table spells Hsinchu two ways, Xingzhu and Hsinzhu, with different temperatures (24 and 24.5).

wiki.quote: | Cacao | Nantou | 24.3

group.zh: 蛋白質設計 · 選擇與序列比對

title.zh: 三個保護蛋白：BoPEP4、LEA14、ACC deaminase
title.en: Three protectants: BoPEP4, LEA14 and ACC deaminase

statement.zh: 蛋白質設計選定三個保護分子：Brassica oleracea 植物誘導胜肽 4（BoPEP4）、晚期胚胎豐富蛋白 14（LEA14）、1-胺基環丙烷-1-羧酸去胺酶（ACC deaminase, ACCD）。BoPEP4 針對植物自身防禦，LEA14 針對乾旱與滲透逆境下的蛋白質損傷，ACCD 針對熱逆境。
statement.en: Protein design selected three protectants: Brassica oleracea plant elicitor peptide 4 (BoPEP4), late embryogenesis abundant protein 14 (LEA14) and 1-aminocyclopropane-1-carboxylate deaminase (ACC deaminase, ACCD). BoPEP4 targets the plant's own defences, LEA14 the protein damage drought and salt cause, and ACCD heat stress.

status_note.zh: 拼寫不一致：protein-design、sprints、methodology 寫 BoPEP4；peptide-design 與 md-simulations 寫 BoPep4。全站應擇一。
status_note.en: Spelling is inconsistent: protein-design, sprints and methodology write BoPEP4 while peptide-design and md-simulations write BoPep4. The site should settle on one.

wiki.quote: Three protectants Selection BoPEP4, LEA14 and ACC deaminase
BoPep4 is a plant elicitor peptide from Brassica oleracea

group.zh: 蛋白質設計 · 選擇與序列比對

title.zh: BoPEP4 成熟序列 GILIGSKKRPREPHSSGKPGGHN，23 殘基
title.en: BoPEP4 mature sequence GILIGSKKRPREPHSSGKPGGHN, 23 residues

statement.zh: BoPEP4 成熟序列為 GILIGSKKRPREPHSSGKPGGHN，長 23 個殘基，淨電荷 +4。全長分子量 2,409.74 Da。
statement.en: The BoPEP4 mature sequence is GILIGSKKRPREPHSSGKPGGHN, 23 residues, net charge +4, molecular weight 2,409.74 Da at full length.

source.label: MD run data, WT system sequence

wiki.quote: mature sequence GILIGSKKRPREPHSSGKPGGHN
1,612.73 Da against 2,409.74 Da

group.zh: 蛋白質設計 · 選擇與序列比對

title.zh: BoPEP4 與 AtPEP1 無間隙比對，23 位中 10 個相同
title.en: BoPEP4 aligns to AtPEP1 gapless, 10 of 23 positions identical

statement.zh: BoPEP4 與 AtPEP1 都是 23 個殘基且無間隙對齊，所以每個位置都有直接對應，殘基編號一對一轉移。十個位置相同：7、9、12、15、16、17、19、20、22、23，全部落在 C 端區。全肽相同度 10/23，殘基 7 至 23 區間為 10/17，殘基 1 至 6 為零。
statement.en: BoPEP4 and AtPEP1 are both 23 residues and align without gaps, so every position has a direct counterpart and numbering transfers one to one. Ten positions are identical: 7, 9, 12, 15, 16, 17, 19, 20, 22 and 23, all in the C-terminal region. Identity is 10 of 23 overall, 10 of 17 within residues 7 to 23 and zero across 1 to 6.

wiki.quote: Ten positions are identical to AtPEP1: 7, 9, 12, 15, 16, 17, 19, 20, 22 and 23
BoPEP4 aligns to AtPEP1 gapless, 10 of 17 ordered positions identical

group.zh: 蛋白質設計 · 選擇與序列比對

title.zh: 比對序列數：16 條、17 條與「12 of 17」三種說法
title.en: Alignment size stated three ways: 16, 17 and '12 of 17'

statement.zh: Sprints 的丙胺酸掃描段寫 Ser15 與 Ser16「在全部 16 條已特性化的 Pep 家族序列中不變」。同頁的 tandem repeat 段寫 Asn23「在已特性化的 AtPEP 集合中不變，在我們含 Brassica 的比對中為 17 條中的 12 條」。Peptide Design 頁明確寫 17 條成熟 Pep 序列（7 條 Arabidopsis、9 條 Brassica，加上 BoPep4），對齊 24 欄。
statement.en: The alanine scan section of Sprints says Ser15 and Ser16 are invariant across all 16 characterised Pep-family sequences. The tandem repeat section of the same page says Asn23 is invariant across the characterised AtPEP set and 12 of 17 in the Brassica-inclusive alignment. Peptide Design states seventeen mature Pep sequences, seven from Arabidopsis and nine from Brassica alongside BoPep4, aligned over twenty-four columns.

status_note.zh: 16 條、17 條與「12 of 17」三種寫法並存。Peptide Design 的表確實列 17 條（7 + 9 + BoPep4），Asn23 保守度 71% = 12/17，與 tandem repeat 段一致；丙胺酸掃描段的 16 條需更正。待問清單第 32 題。
status_note.en: 16, 17 and '12 of 17' all appear. The Peptide Design table does list 17 sequences (7 + 9 + BoPep4) and Asn23 conservation of 71% equals 12/17, matching the tandem section, so the alanine scan's 16 is the one to correct. Open question 32.

wiki.quote: Both are invariant across all 16 characterised Pep-family sequences
invariant across the characterised AtPEP set and 12 of 17
Seventeen mature Pep sequences, seven from Arabidopsis and nine from Brassica

group.zh: 蛋白質設計 · 選擇與序列比對

title.zh: 四個位置在 17 條序列中完全不變
title.en: Four columns are invariant across all seventeen sequences

statement.zh: 17 條成熟 Pep 序列中，只有四個位置是同一個殘基：Ser15、Ser16、Gly17 與 Gly20。其中三個在 PEPR1 上埋藏表面，第四個 Gly17 是 Pearce 測得活性下降超過四千倍的位置。
statement.en: Across the seventeen mature Pep sequences only four columns carry the same residue: Ser15, Ser16, Gly17 and Gly20. Three of the four bury surface on PEPR1 and the fourth, Gly17, is the residue Pearce measured at more than four thousandfold.

wiki.quote: Ser15, Ser16, Gly17 and Gly20 are the same residue in all seventeen

group.zh: 蛋白質設計 · 選擇與序列比對

title.zh: 保守區在 20 結束而非 23
title.en: The conserved region stops at 20, not 23

statement.zh: tandem repeat 比對顯示保守區是 15 至 17 的不變 SSG 加上位置 20 的不變 Gly；21、22、23 是可變的。BoPEP4 自己的 Gly21 在該位置屬少數殘基。先前頁面把 15 至 23 描述為保守區塊。
statement.en: The alignment supports an invariant SSG at 15 to 17 and an invariant Gly at 20, with 21, 22 and 23 variable. BoPEP4's own Gly21 is a minority residue at that position. Earlier pages described 15 to 23 as the conserved block.

status_note.zh: Sprints 說保守區在 20 結束，MD 與 methodology 仍用「保守窗 15-23」。兩種描述同時在站上。
status_note.en: Sprints says the conserved region stops at 20 while the MD and methodology pages still use a conserved window of 15-23. Both descriptions are live on the site.

wiki.quote: The conserved region stops at 20, not 23.
Our conserved window 15-23, defined by aligning sequences from the PEP receptor family

group.zh: 蛋白質設計 · 選擇與序列比對

title.zh: Asn23 在 17 條中有 12 條，保守度 71%
title.en: Asn23 appears in 12 of 17 sequences, 71% conservation

statement.zh: 七條已特性化的 AtPEP 都在末端帶 Asn，BoPEP4 也是，但九條 Brassica 序列中有五條不是：BnPep4_E5L6 為 Ser、BnPep6_DM88 為 Asp、三條 Pep1 直系同源以 His 結尾。BnPep4_E5L6 是 BoPEP4 最近的親戚，只差兩個位置。
statement.en: All seven characterised AtPEPs carry Asn at the end and so does BoPEP4, but five of the nine Brassica entries do not: BnPep4_E5L6 has Ser, BnPep6_DM88 has Asp, and the three Pep1 orthologs end in His. BnPep4_E5L6 is BoPEP4's closest relative at two differences.

wiki.quote: five of the nine Brassica entries do not: BnPep4_E5L6 has Ser
it is the last residue in twelve of the seventeen

group.zh: 蛋白質設計 · 選擇與序列比對

title.zh: BrPep4_A5G1 與 BoPEP4 只差一個殘基
title.en: BrPep4_A5G1 differs from BoPEP4 by one residue

statement.zh: BrPep4_A5G1 與 BoPEP4 只差一個殘基（Ile4），BnPep4_E5L6 差兩個。Brassica 的 Pep4 直系同源實質上是同一個分子，這是跨作物適用性主張的 in silico 支持。
statement.en: BrPep4_A5G1 differs from BoPEP4 by one residue, Ile4, and BnPep4_E5L6 by two, so the Brassica Pep4 orthologs are effectively the same molecule. This is the in-silico support under the crop-range claim.

wiki.quote: BrPep4_A5G1 differs from BoPEP4 by one residue and BnPep4_E5L6 by two
BoPep4 and B. rapa Pep4 differ at one position, Ile4.

group.zh: 蛋白質設計 · 選擇與序列比對

title.zh: 保守 PEP 基序 SSG-x2-G-x2-N 佔 15 至 23 位
title.en: The conserved PEP motif SSG-x2-G-x2-N occupies positions 15 to 23

statement.zh: BoPEP4 符合保守 PEP 基序 SSG-x2-G-x2-N（Wang 等人，2022），該基序佔位置 15 至 23。Ser15、Ser16、Gly17、Gly20、Asn23 全部具備。BoPEP4 在此窗內與 AtPEP1 相異的兩個位置（18 與 21）都落在基序的簡併位置。
statement.en: BoPEP4 conforms to the conserved PEP motif SSG-x2-G-x2-N (Wang et al., 2022), which occupies positions 15 to 23. Ser15, Ser16, Gly17, Gly20 and Asn23 are all present. The two positions where BoPEP4 differs from AtPEP1 inside this window, 18 and 21, fall in the motif's degenerate positions.

wiki.quote: BoPEP4 also conforms to the conserved PEP motif SSG-x2-G-x2-N

group.zh: 蛋白質設計 · 選擇與序列比對

title.zh: PEPR2 與 PEPR1 相同度 64%
title.en: PEPR2 is 64% identical to PEPR1

statement.zh: PEPR2 與 PEPR1 相同度 64%，其凹槽在每個錨點位置疊合到約 2 Å 以內。它保留 C 端夾鉗與 Lys7、Arg9、Ser15、Ser16、His22 的配對，但失去 Arg11 的酸性配對與 Glu12 的鹼性配對，位置 18 面對的是疏水區而非羧酸根。
statement.en: PEPR2 is 64% identical to PEPR1 and its groove superimposes to within about 2 A at every anchor position. It keeps the C-terminal clamp and the Lys7, Arg9, Ser15, Ser16 and His22 partners but loses the acidic partner of Arg11 and the basic partner of Glu12, and position 18 faces a hydrophobic patch instead of a carboxylate.

status_note.zh: PEPR2 沒有實驗結構，所有 PEPR2 數字都建立在 AlphaFold 模型上，且在對接前沒有套用逐殘基信心過濾。
status_note.en: PEPR2 has no experimental structure; every PEPR2 number rests on an AlphaFold model with no per-residue confidence filter applied before docking.

wiki.quote: PEPR2 is 64% identical to PEPR1 and its groove superimposes to within about 2 Å

group.zh: 蛋白質設計 · 選擇與序列比對

title.zh: 殘基 7 至 23 構成界面，1 至 6 不接觸
title.en: Residues 7-23 make the interface and 1-6 touch nothing

statement.zh: BoPep4 在 PEPR1 上的埋藏表面從 Lys7 才開始，殘基 1 至 6 在兩個受體上都是零埋藏，且在 2.59 Å 的晶體密度中完全未解析。接著胜肽沿一排受體羧酸根跑出一條鹼性殘基帶：Lys7 對 Glu199、Arg9 對 Asp179、Arg11 對 Asp294、Lys18 對 Glu324 與 Asp348、His22 對 Glu439，最後 Asn23 埋在口袋裡 170 Å²。
statement.en: Burial on PEPR1 starts at Lys7; residues 1 to 6 bury zero surface on either receptor and are unresolved in the 2.59 A crystal. The peptide then runs a belt of basic residues along receptor carboxylates: Lys7 to Glu199, Arg9 to Asp179, Arg11 to Asp294, Lys18 to Glu324 and Asp348, His22 to Glu439, finishing with Asn23 buried at 170 A2.

wiki.quote: Nothing is buried until Lys7.
| N23 | 170 | 4 / 0 | Asp441, Asn465, Arg487 | salt-bridge anchor

caption.en: Figure 1, the electrostatic belt

caption.zh: 圖 2 C 端夾鉗

group.zh: 蛋白質設計 · 選擇與序列比對

title.zh: 位置 18 的受體配對殘基有三種寫法
title.en: The position-18 receptor partner is named three different ways

statement.zh: Peptide Design 的逐殘基表把 Lys18 的 PEPR1 配對寫成 Glu324 與 Asp348。Molecular Dynamics 與 Sprints 的 MD 段只寫 Asp348（並以 Phe371 為第二接觸）。Sprints 的「Reading a docking score」段描述 K8Q+K18R 雙突變時寫位置 18 的錨點「從 Asp320 滑到 Glu296」。
statement.en: The Peptide Design per-residue table gives Lys18's PEPR1 partners as Glu324 and Asp348. Molecular Dynamics and the MD passages in Sprints name only Asp348, with Phe371 as a second contact. The 'Reading a docking score' section of Sprints describes the position-18 anchor on the K8Q+K18R double as having slipped off Asp320 onto Glu296.

status_note.zh: Asp348（+Glu324）對 Asp320/Glu296，是同一個位置的三種命名。可能是不同編號慣例（Peptide Design 自述來源資料有三套編號）。待問清單第 31 題。
status_note.en: Asp348 with Glu324 against Asp320 and Glu296 for the same position. It may be a numbering-convention difference, since Peptide Design says three numbering conventions coexist in the source data. Open question 31.

wiki.quote: | K18 | 85 | 2 / 2 | Glu324, Asp348 | salt-bridge anchor
a position-18 anchor that has slipped off Asp320 onto Glu296 at a broken 3.42 Å
Asp348 is the primary receptor partner of Lys18

group.zh: 蛋白質設計 · Sprints 與結果

title.zh: 丙胺酸掃描：18 個單點突變，8 個熱點
title.en: Alanine scan: 18 single-point mutants, 8 hotspots

statement.zh: 在已驗證的原生模式複合物上建 18 個單點突變（Ser6 到 C 端 Asn23），加上一個未突變基準，共 19 個系統，全部經相同的 HADDOCK 水精修 40/10/10。八個位置在兩個指標上都超過 +7：K7、R9、R11、E12、H14、K18、H22、N23，每一個都由大的正 ΔEelec 帶動，從 H14 的 +32.6 到 K18 的 +150.4，ΔEvdw 持平或有利。K18A 與 K7A 是最大的衝擊。18 個全部完成。
statement.en: Eighteen single-point mutants from Ser6 to the C-terminal Asn23 were built on the validated native-mode complex, plus an unmutated baseline, and all 19 systems went through identical HADDOCK water refinement at 40/10/10. Eight positions clear +7 on both metrics: K7, R9, R11, E12, H14, K18, H22 and N23, each carried by a large positive delta-E-elec from +32.6 at H14 to +150.4 at K18 with delta-E-vdw flat or favourable. K18A and K7A are the largest hits. All 18 completed.

status_note.zh: 〔10/14 乾實驗封存核對〕14 Oct 核對：封存裡有這次掃描的執行樹（00_Docking_Analysis/01_HADDOCK_Peptide_Receptor/18_PointMutation_Panel，含 build_panel.py、panel_manifest.tsv 與每個複合體的資料夾），但沒有彙總結果表，所以 HADDOCK 差值（+150.4、+32.6、−1.3、−2.9、+9.5）與骨架位移（1.21、1.42、1.62 Å）都無法核對。只要把那張彙總表丟進封存，這幾筆可以一次確認。

title.zh: 掃描抓不到自己的兩個對照 S15A 與 G17A
title.en: The scan misses its own two controls, S15A and G17A

statement.zh: S15A 與 G17A 是依已發表活性（分別約 100 倍與超過 4000 倍低於野生型）訂購的失能對照。丙胺酸掃描在這兩個位置分別回傳 −1.3 與 −2.9，也就是沒有懲罰。頁面據此認定該方法在別處的沉默不具證據力。
statement.en: S15A and G17A are the loss-of-function constructs ordered on published activities roughly 100-fold and more than 4000-fold below wild type. The scan returns -1.3 and -2.9 at exactly those positions, so a method that misses the two substitutions published work shows matter most has no weight in its silence elsewhere.

title.zh: N23A 只排第八，因為部分夾鉗來自主鏈
title.en: N23A ranks last of the eight hotspots

statement.zh: N23A 為 +9.5，與 Asn23 擁有最大埋藏表面 170 Å² 與四個氫鍵不相稱。資料支持的解釋是其中幾個接觸來自 C 端羧酸根與主鏈醯胺，而非 Asn 換 Ala 所移除的側鏈原子，所以部分夾鉗存活。這個區別後來決定了 C 端標籤的判斷：在位置 23 取代會保留鏈端，接在它後面不會。
statement.en: N23A is +9.5, which sits oddly against Asn23 having the largest buried surface at 170 A2 and four hydrogen bonds. The explanation the data support is that several contacts engage the C-terminal carboxylate and backbone amide rather than the side-chain atoms an Asn to Ala substitution removes, so part of the clamp survives. Substituting at position 23 keeps the chain terminus; appending to it does not.

title.zh: 甘胺酸會動、脯胺酸不會
title.en: The glycines move and the prolines do not

statement.zh: G20A 與 G21A 的主鏈偏移是全組最大，分別 1.21 與 1.42 Å，卻沒有分數效應。事前假設脯胺酸會因失去主鏈剛性而出現同樣特徵，結果失敗：P10A、P13A、P19A 落在 0.75 至 1.03 Å 的中性範圍內。K7A 是唯一會移動胜肽的突變，1.62 Å。
statement.en: G20A and G21A show the largest backbone deviations in the set, 1.21 and 1.42 A, with no score effect. The prediction that the prolines would show the same signature failed: P10A, P13A and P19A sit at 0.75 to 1.03 A, inside the neutral range. K7A is the only mutant that moves the peptide, by 1.62 A.

title.zh: 淺截短 Δ1-2 與 Δ1-3 的 AF3 信心最高
title.en: The shallow truncations score highest on AlphaFold3 confidence

statement.zh: Δ1-2 與 Δ1-3 在對 PEPR1 的 AF3 信心上勝過兩個取代，ipTM 分別 0.88 與 0.89，K18R 為 0.82、K8Q 為 0.83；Δ1-3 的界面 PAE 是全組最低的 1.62 Å。HADDOCK 方向一致，為 −207 與 −201。位置 18 在切除後仍保有其標準配對，距離 2.77 與 2.85 Å。
statement.en: Delta-1-2 and Delta-1-3 came out ahead of both substitutions on AlphaFold3 confidence against PEPR1, ipTM 0.88 and 0.89 against 0.82 for K18R and 0.83 for K8Q, with the lowest interface PAE in the set at 1.62 A for Delta-1-3. HADDOCK agreed directionally at -207 and -201. Position 18 keeps its canonical partner through the cut, at 2.77 and 2.85 A.

status_note.zh: 〔10/14 乾實驗封存核對〕對上 AF3_confidence_matrix.csv 與 two_method_matrix.csv：PEPR1 的 ipTM d1-2 0.88、d1-3 0.89，對 K18R 0.82、K8Q 0.83；全套最低的介面 PAE 是 d1-3 的 1.62 Å；HADDOCK 分別為 −207.0 與 −201.4，與頁面的「−207 與 −201」一致。頁面另外說位置 18 在切短後維持 2.77 與 2.85 Å 的接觸，這兩個距離不在封存的兩個矩陣裡，未核對。
status_note.en: [14 Oct dry lab archive check] Matches AF3_confidence_matrix.csv and two_method_matrix.csv: on PEPR1 the ipTM is 0.88 for d1-2 and 0.89 for d1-3 against 0.82 for K18R and 0.83 for K8Q; the lowest interface PAE in the set is d1-3's 1.62 A; and HADDOCK gives -207.0 and -201.4, the page's -207 and -201. The page also says position 18 keeps its partner at 2.77 and 2.85 A through the cut; those two distances are not in either archived matrix and were not checked.

wiki.quote: ipTM 0.88 and 0.89 against 0.82 for K18R and 0.83 for K8Q

title.zh: Δ1 還是 Δ1-2：被捨棄的淺截短名稱不一致
title.en: Delta-1 or Delta-1-2: the discarded shallow truncations are named inconsistently

statement.zh: Sprints 的截短梯段寫「Δ1-2 與 Δ1-3 是七月的入選者」，下一句卻寫「Δ1 與 Δ1-3 是依此理由而非結合結果被捨棄的」。Molecular Dynamics 頁寫「我們沒有追求 Δ1 與 Δ1-3 的設計」。Sprints 頁上方的 run 清單列的是「Δ1-2, Δ1-3」。Peptide Design 寫「淺截短 Δ1-2 與 Δ1-3 被撤下」。
statement.en: The truncation ladder in Sprints says Delta-1-2 and Delta-1-3 were the July finalists and then says Delta-1 and Delta-1-3 were dropped on that reasoning. Molecular Dynamics says the team did not pursue the Delta-1 and Delta-1-3 designs. The run chip list at the top of Sprints reads 'Δ1-2, Δ1-3'. Peptide Design says the shallow truncations Delta-1-2 and Delta-1-3 went.

status_note.zh: Δ1 與 Δ1-2 在三處混用，指的應是同一組被捨棄的設計。待問清單第 33 題。
status_note.en: Delta-1 and Delta-1-2 are used interchangeably in three places for what should be the same discarded design. Open question 33.
