we did not pursue the Δ1 and Δ1-3 designs
The shallow truncations Δ1-2 and Δ1-3 went

group.zh: 蛋白質設計 · Sprints 與結果

title.en: 9-23 is the production molecule: 33% less mass at 1,612.73 Da

statement.zh: 相對全長，9-23 少 33% 質量（1,612.73 Da 對 2,409.74 Da），胰蛋白酶型切位從三個減為一個，正電荷減半（+2.1 對 +4.1），所以較少靜電黏在生產菌上。它也移除了油膩的 GILI 前段，那是在 B. subtilis 造成自毒風險的部分。代價是已發表的十倍活性差。
statement.en: Against full length, 9-23 carries 33% less mass, 1,612.73 Da against 2,409.74 Da, one trypsin-type cut site instead of three, and half the positive charge at +2.1 against +4.1, so less of it sticks electrostatically to the producer cells. It also removes the greasy GILI front segment, which raises a self-toxicity risk in B. subtilis. The cost is the published factor of ten in activity.

status_note.zh: 〔10/14 乾實驗封存核對〕質量與切位都重算無誤：RPREPHSSGKPGGHN 的平均分子量為 1,612.73 Da，GILIGSKKRPREPHSSGKPGGHN 為 2,409.74 Da，相差 33.1%。淨電荷在矩陣裡是 9-23 為 2、1-23 為 4。胰蛋白酶型切位：全長在 K7、K8、R11 有三個（R9–P10 與 K18–P19 被脯胺酸阻斷），9-23 只剩 R11 一個，與頁面一致。
status_note.en: [14 Oct dry lab archive check] Mass and cut sites both recompute: the average molecular weight of RPREPHSSGKPGGHN is 1,612.73 Da against 2,409.74 Da for GILIGSKKRPREPHSSGKPGGHN, a 33.1% reduction. The matrix lists net charge 2 for 9-23 and 4 for 1-23. Trypsin-type sites: full length has three, at K7, K8 and R11, since R9-P10 and K18-P19 are blocked by proline, and 9-23 has one, at R11, exactly as the page says.

source.label: masses and cut sites recomputed 14 Oct

wiki.quote: 33% less mass, 1,612.73 Da against 2,409.74 Da

title.zh: 7-23 在每一項 MD 指標上都比 9-23 穩，卻不在構築組裡
title.en: 7-23 beats 9-23 on every MD metric but is not in the construct set

statement.zh: 7-23 在現有的每一項 MD 指標上都比 9-23 穩定：夾鉗完整度 98.5% 對 77.1%、Asn23-Arg487 99.9% 對 81.1%、受體接觸 151 對 129。它不在構築組裡。如果 9-23 的缺口成立，生產候選與乾實驗最佳截短就是兩個不同的分子。
statement.en: 7-23 is more stable than 9-23 on every MD metric available: clamp integrity 98.5% against 77.1%, Asn23-Arg487 99.9% against 81.1%, and 151 receptor contacts against 129. It is not in the construct set. If the 9-23 deficit holds, the production candidate and the dry lab's best truncation are different molecules.

status_note.zh: 夾鉗完整度與 Asn23-Arg487 佔有率與 md-simulations 原始資料一致（T723 clamp4 98.53、arg487_foot 99.9；T923 clamp4 77.07、acceptance Asn23-Arg487 81.07）。
status_note.en: Clamp integrity and Asn23-Arg487 occupancy match the md-simulations raw data: T723 clamp4 98.53 and arg487_foot 99.9; T923 clamp4 77.07 with acceptance Asn23-Arg487 81.07.

wiki.quote: clamp integrity 98.5% against 77.1%, Asn23-Arg487 99.9% against 81.1%

group.zh: 蛋白質設計 · Sprints 與結果

title.zh: 串聯重複在化學上行不通
title.en: Tandem repeats cannot work, on chemistry

statement.zh: 串聯鏈中只有最後一個拷貝有自由的 C 端羧酸根；上游每個拷貝的羧酸根都被消耗進連接下一個拷貝的胜肽鍵，而那個羧酸根正是以 100% 佔有率、0.54 Å 窗內鹽橋結合 Arg487 的基團。n 個拷貝的構築因此帶 n−1 個無法結合的拷貝。凹槽更使情況加劇：Asn23 埋在運行末端的口袋裡，沒有出口通道讓連接子穿出，放到上游又會落進不變的 15 至 20 區塊。
statement.en: Only the final copy in a tandem chain has a free C-terminal carboxylate. In every upstream copy that carboxylate is consumed into the peptide bond to the next copy, and that carboxylate is what salt-bridges Arg487 at 100% occupancy inside a 0.54 A window. An n-copy construct carries n-1 copies that cannot engage. Asn23 also sits buried in a pocket with no exit channel for a linker, and a linker placed further upstream lands inside the invariant 15 to 20 block.

wiki.quote: An n-copy construct therefore carries n−1 copies that cannot engage

title.zh: 串聯掃描：每殘基埋藏面積從 127 降到 32 Å²
title.en: Tandem sweep: buried area per residue falls from 127 to 32 A2

statement.zh: (SSGKPGGHN)n 在 n = 1 至 8 的掃描顯示，每增加一個拷貝，PEPR1 上的每殘基埋藏面積單調下降，從 127 Å² 降到 32 Å²，而實際接觸受體的拷貝數不論 n 多大都飽和在三個。
statement.en: A sweep of (SSGKPGGHN)n for n = 1 to 8 found buried area per residue falling monotonically with every added copy, from 127 to 32 A2 on PEPR1, with the number of copies actually touching the receptor saturating at three regardless of n.

status_note.zh: 〔10/14 乾實驗封存核對〕對上 repeat_metrics.csv：PEPR1 上 n = 1 到 8 的每殘基埋藏面積從 127.3 單調下降到 31.7 Å²，接觸受體的拷貝數在 n ≥ 3 之後固定在 3。
status_note.en: [14 Oct dry lab archive check] Matches repeat_metrics.csv: on PEPR1 the buried area per residue falls monotonically from 127.3 to 31.7 A2 across n = 1 to 8, and the number of copies contacting the receptor saturates at 3 from n = 3 onwards.

wiki.quote: from 127 to 32 Å² on PEPR1, and the number of copies actually touching the receptor saturating at three

group.zh: 蛋白質設計 · Sprints 與結果

title.zh: HADDOCK 分數 93% 可由長度與淨電荷解釋
title.en: 93% of the HADDOCK score variance is length and net charge

statement.zh: 7 月 30 日的自我方法稽核發現，BoPEP4 變體間的 HADDOCK 分數有 93% 可單由胜肽長度與淨電荷解釋，且與 Pearce 的實測活性相關係數 rho 約 +0.05（零代表無關係）。截短梯每一階都在改變長度與淨電荷，所以梯上的分數差異正是由該分數的實際內容產生的。
statement.en: The 30 July methodology audit found the HADDOCK score across BoPEP4 variants is 93% explainable by peptide length and net charge alone, and its correlation with Pearce's measured activities is rho about +0.05, where zero is no relationship. The truncation ladder changes length and charge at every rung, so its score differences are produced by exactly that content.

status_note.zh: 〔10/14 乾實驗封存核對〕獨立重算：以長度與淨電荷對 HADDOCK 分數做最小平方迴歸，PEPR1 的 R² = 0.929、PEPR2 = 0.938、合併 = 0.919，與「93% 可由長度與淨電荷解釋」一致。值得加一句：長度單獨就有 0.927，淨電荷幾乎沒有額外貢獻。
status_note.en: [14 Oct dry lab archive check] Independently recomputed: least-squares regression of the HADDOCK score on length and net charge gives R2 = 0.929 for PEPR1, 0.938 for PEPR2 and 0.919 pooled, consistent with 93% explainable by length and net charge. Worth adding one clause: length alone already gives 0.927, so net charge adds almost nothing.

source.label: recomputed 14 Oct from the master matrix

wiki.quote: 93% explainable by peptide length and net charge alone
a regression on length and net charge alone explains 93% of its variance

group.zh: 蛋白質設計 · Sprints 與結果

title.zh: K8Q+K18R 雙突變崩潰，HADDOCK 卻給正常分數
title.en: The K8Q+K18R double collapses but HADDOCK scores it normally

statement.zh: K8Q+K18R 雙突變在 PEPR1 上以每一個幾何指標衡量都崩潰：AF3 ipTM 0.49（其餘面板為 0.75 至 0.89）、界面 PAE 9.45 Å（其餘 1.62 至 2.78 Å）、受體接觸最少的 42 個、氫鍵 9 個（其餘 16 至 21）、位置 18 的錨點滑脫到 3.42 Å。HADDOCK 給 −194.7，落在九個健康複合物的 −187 至 −218 區間內。矩陣把它記為 DISCORDANT-HADDOCK-rescues。
statement.en: The K8Q+K18R double collapses on PEPR1 by every geometric measure: AF3 ipTM 0.49 against 0.75 to 0.89 for the rest of the panel, interface PAE 9.45 A against 1.62 to 2.78 A, the fewest receptor contacts at 42, nine hydrogen bonds against 16 to 21, and a position-18 anchor broken at 3.42 A. HADDOCK scores it -194.7, inside the -187 to -218 band of the nine healthy complexes. The matrix logs it as DISCORDANT-HADDOCK-rescues.

status_note.zh:
Peptide Design 後來把「K8Q+K18R 在 PEPR1 上崩潰」列為已撤回的主張，理由是一個有資訊的方法加一個沒有資訊的方法不構成分歧。兩頁的立場不同。
〔10/14 乾實驗封存核對〕核心數字全部對上：K8Q+K18R 對 PEPR1 的 ipTM 0.49、介面 PAE 9.45 Å、受體介面殘基 42（全套最少）、HADDOCK −194.7，two_method_matrix 的判定字串就是 DISCORDANT-HADDOCK-rescues；其餘面板的 ipTM 落在 0.75 到 0.89、PAE 1.62 到 2.78，與頁面相同。頁面的「九個氫鍵對 16 到 21」與「位置 18 斷在 3.42 Å」不在這兩個檔案裡（結構矩陣記的是 polar_contacts 16），未核對。
status_note.en:
Peptide Design later lists 'K8Q+K18R collapses on PEPR1' as a retracted claim, on the grounds that one informative method and one uninformative one is not a disagreement. The two pages take different positions.
[14 Oct dry lab archive check] The core numbers all reproduce: K8Q+K18R against PEPR1 has ipTM 0.49, interface PAE 9.45 A, 42 receptor interface residues (the fewest in the set) and a HADDOCK score of -194.7, and the verdict string in two_method_matrix.csv is literally DISCORDANT-HADDOCK-rescues; the rest of the panel sits at ipTM 0.75 to 0.89 and PAE 1.62 to 2.78 as the page says. The nine hydrogen bonds against 16 to 21, and the position-18 anchor broken at 3.42 A, are not in these two files (the structural matrix records polar_contacts 16) and were not checked.

retracted K8Q+K18R collapses on PEPR1

title.en: No PEPR2 alanine scan has been run

statement.en: Existing data show PEPR2 with a degraded mid-belt where Arg11 and Glu12 lose their partners, so R11A and E12A may behave differently there. A PEPR2 scan has not been run, and dual-receptor engagement is a ReLEAF-level claim, so it stays open.

title.zh: run 清單：BoPEP4 12 次、ACC deaminase 4 次
title.en: Run list: 12 BoPEP4 runs and 4 ACC deaminase runs

statement.zh: Sprints 頁的 run 清單列 BoPEP4 12 次（其中 3 次寫成完整段落）：丙胺酸取代、截短梯、串聯重複分析、N-His 對 C-His、K8Q、K18R、K8Q+K18R、Δ1-2 與 Δ1-3、三元對接、Asn23 策略重要性、S15A、G17A。ACC deaminase 4 次：Y156C、移除未配對半胱胺酸、V293T、PLP 結合測試。

ACC deaminase has 4 runs: Y156C, unpaired cysteines removed, V293T and PLP binding test.

group.zh: 蛋白質設計 · GRAFT 方法

title.zh: HADDOCK 版本在頁面間不一致：2.4 對 2.5
title.en: HADDOCK version disagrees across pages: 2.4 against 2.5

statement.zh: GRAFT Methodology 頁通篇寫 HADDOCK 2.4（包括截短梯與二元對接）。Sprints 的丙胺酸掃描寫「全部 19 個系統經過相同的 HADDOCK 2.5 水精修」。Peptide Design 的重現性表寫「HADDOCK 2.5，發行版 haddock2.5-2026-07，在本機執行」。
statement.en: The GRAFT Methodology page says HADDOCK 2.4 throughout, including for the truncation ladder and binary docking. The Sprints alanine scan says all 19 systems went through identical HADDOCK 2.5 water refinement. The Peptide Design reproducibility table says HADDOCK 2.5, distribution haddock2.5-2026-07, run locally.

status_note.zh:
2.4 與 2.5 同時在站上，且參考文獻同時列 HADDOCK2.2 與 HADDOCK2.4 的論文。需確認實際跑的版本。
〔10/14 乾實驗封存核對〕敲定：實際跑的是 HADDOCK 2.5。稽核報告的軟體堆疊表寫明「HADDOCK 2.5（distribution haddock2.5-2026-07）」、121 次 production run 全部在本機、Python 3.12，而且特別記下 2026-07-21 的確認報告誤稱 HADDOCK 2.5 需要 Python 2.7、本機無法執行，那是錯的。頁面上的 2.4 來自協定論文（Honorato et al. 2024, HADDOCK2.4 web server），那篇是引用來源而不是版本。GRAFT Methodology 的「HADDOCK 2.4」需要改成 2.5，或改寫成引用 2.4 的協定論文。
status_note.en:
Both 2.4 and 2.5 are live on the site and the reference lists cite both the HADDOCK2.2 and HADDOCK2.4 papers. The version actually run needs confirming.
[14 Oct dry lab archive check] Settled: what ran is HADDOCK 2.5. The audit's software-stack table states HADDOCK 2.5 (distribution haddock2.5-2026-07), all 121 production runs local, Python 3.12, and it specifically records that the 2026-07-21 confirmation report's claim that HADDOCK 2.5 needs Python 2.7 and could not run locally was incorrect. The 2.4 on the page comes from the protocol paper, Honorato et al. 2024 on the HADDOCK2.4 web server, which is a citation and not a version. GRAFT Methodology's HADDOCK 2.4 should become 2.5, or be rewritten as a citation of the 2.4 protocol paper.

wiki.quote: After running a truncation ladder with HADDOCK 2.4
went through identical HADDOCK 2.5 water refinement at 40/10/10
HADDOCK 2.5, distribution haddock2.5-2026-07, run locally.

group.zh: 蛋白質設計 · GRAFT 方法

title.en: Binary docking samples 1000/200/200; confirmation runs use 40/10/10

statement.zh: 二元對接的取樣為每次 1000 個剛體、200 個半柔性、200 個水精修模型，FCC 分群門檻 0.60，最小分群大小 4，胜肽設為完全柔性。確認類的 run（問題是單一編輯的代價而非胜肽對在哪裡）使用相同協定下的縮減取樣 40/10/10。這些設定在每次二元 run 間保持固定。
statement.en: Binary docking sampled 1000 rigid-body, 200 semi-flexible and 200 water-refined models per run, with FCC clustering at a 0.60 cutoff, a minimum cluster size of 4 and the peptide set fully flexible. Confirmation-class runs used reduced sampling of 40/10/10 on the same protocol. These settings were held constant across every binary run.

status_note.zh: 〔10/14 乾實驗封存核對〕稽核報告記下兩套取樣：標準 1000/200/200（協定論文的預設，稽核確認分數公式套用正確），以及確認級的 40/10/10，並算出那是標準取樣的 4%/5%/5%。與頁面一致。
status_note.en: [14 Oct dry lab archive check] The audit records both sampling regimes: the standard 1000/200/200 from the protocol paper, with the audit confirming the score formula is applied correctly, and the confirmation-class 40/10/10, which it computes as 4% / 5% / 5% of standard sampling. That matches the page.

wiki.quote: Sampling was 1000 rigid-body, 200 semi-flexible and 200 water-refined models per run

group.zh: 蛋白質設計 · GRAFT 方法

title.zh: 受體結構：PEPR1 來自 5GR8 chain A，BAK1 來自 4MN8 chain B
title.en: Structures: PEPR1 from 5GR8 chain A, BAK1 from 4MN8 chain B

statement.zh: 對接受體為 PEPR1 胞外域，取自 wwPDB 結構 5GR8 chain A。共受體 BAK1 取自 4MN8 chain B，該結構是 FLS2 與 BAK1 的 LRR 胞外域結合細菌鞭毛蛋白表位 flg22 的晶體結構。PEPR2 沒有實驗結構，以 AlphaFold3 與 SWISS-MODEL 同源模建產生，以 PEPR1 為結構參考。
statement.en: The docking receptor is the PEPR1 ectodomain from wwPDB structure 5GR8, chain A. The co-receptor BAK1 is taken from 4MN8 chain B, the crystal structure of FLS2 and BAK1 LRR ectodomains bound to the bacterial flagellin epitope flg22. PEPR2 has no experimental structure and was generated with AlphaFold3 and SWISS-MODEL homology modelling using PEPR1 as reference.

wiki.quote: outlined in wwPDB structure 5GR8, chain A, which we used as our docking receptor structure input
the structure of the co-receptor BAK1 was obtained via the 4MN8 PDB structure, chain B

group.zh: 蛋白質設計 · GRAFT 方法

title.zh: PEPR1 限制條件：41 個 active、9 個 passive
title.en: PEPR1 restraints: 41 active and 9 passive residues

statement.zh: 主要 PEPR1 限制集由 5GR8 共結晶接觸推得：以 4.5 Å 門檻掃描每個 PEPR1 重原子對每個 AtPEP1 重原子，跨兩份晶體複本（chains A/J 與 D/P）取聯集，得 41 個 active 殘基。Passive 殘基定義為相對 SASA ≥ 0.40（Shrake-Rupley）且 Cα 在 active 殘基 8 Å 內的溶劑暴露位置，共 9 個。
statement.en: The primary PEPR1 restraint set is contact-derived from the 5GR8 co-crystal: every PEPR1 heavy atom was scanned against every AtPEP1 heavy atom at a 4.5 A cutoff across both crystallographic copies, chains A/J and D/P, and the union taken, giving 41 active residues. Passive residues are solvent-exposed positions with relative SASA >= 0.40 (Shrake-Rupley) and a C-alpha within 8 A of an active residue, giving 9.

title.zh: WHISCY 的 active 層只找回 41 個中的 1 到 2 個
title.en: WHISCY's active tier recovers only 1 to 2 of the 41 crystal residues

statement.zh: 以 BLAST 收集同源序列並用 MUSCLE 對齊 352 條序列後，WHISCY 在不給與給比對兩種情況下各跑一次。Active 層分別只找回 41 個晶體界面殘基中的 1 個與 2 個，兩次 run 彼此也只在一個殘基上一致，所以 active 層不被當成可靠的獨立檢核。Passive 層兩次都回傳同樣的六個晶體接觸殘基。七個殘基（347、348、369、371、372、393、395）同時出現在晶體接觸與兩次 WHISCY run 中，被內部標為最高信心核心。
statement.en: After collecting homologues by BLAST and aligning 352 sequences with MUSCLE, WHISCY was run on PEPR1 alone both without and with the MSA. The active tiers recovered 1 of 41 and 2 of 41 crystal interface residues respectively, and the two runs agreed with each other on only one residue, so the active tier was not treated as a reliable independent check. The passive tier returned the same six crystal-contact residues both times. Seven residues, 347, 348, 369, 371, 372, 393 and 395, appear in the crystal contacts and in both WHISCY runs and were flagged internally as the highest-confidence core.

title.zh: Koller 與 Bent（2014）回報的是相反的結論
title.en: Koller and Bent (2014) reports the opposite of what was expected

statement.zh: 團隊原本預期 Koller 與 Bent（2014）會提供第二條、以保守性為基礎的證據支持可推廣的 SERK 停靠特徵。完整讀過後發現該論文報告相反的結果：它指出的保守 C 端叢集經突變檢定後並未損害 FLS2-BAK1 交互作用，論文結論是 FLS2 與 BRI1 使用受體特異的停靠位點。BAK1 側的限制因此只靠單一條證據，即 4MN8 的結構轉移。
statement.en: The team had expected Koller and Bent (2014) to provide a second, conservation-based line of support for a generalisable SERK docking signature. On reading the paper in full they found it reports the opposite: the conserved C-terminal cluster it identifies was tested by mutagenesis and did not impair FLS2-BAK1 interaction, and the paper concludes FLS2 and BRI1 use receptor-specific docking sites. The BAK1-side restraints therefore rest on a single line of evidence, the 4MN8 structural transfer.

wiki.quote: On reading the paper in full, we found it reports the opposite

title.zh: LEA14 的構形變異幾乎全在 N 端尾巴
title.en: LEA14's conformational spread is almost entirely in the N-terminal tail

statement.zh: 前十個模型間、跨全部 151 個殘基的平均成對 Cα RMSD 為 3.94 Å，最大 5.55 Å。限制在摺疊核心（殘基 24 至 145）時為 0.66 Å，最大 0.84 Å。以核心疊合後量 Cα RMSF，殘基 1 至 16 平均 8.75 Å，殘基 24 至 145 平均 0.42 Å。轉折很銳利：Leu16 擺動 3.97 Å，Ala18 為 1.16 Å。C 端六個殘基為 1.61 Å。全蛋白最剛硬的位置是 Cys58，0.26 Å。
statement.en: Over the first ten models the mean pairwise C-alpha RMSD across all 151 residues is 3.94 A with a maximum of 5.55 A. Restricted to the folded core, residues 24 to 145, it is 0.66 A with a maximum of 0.84 A. Superposing all 20 models on the core, mean C-alpha RMSF is 8.75 A across residues 1 to 16 against 0.42 A across 24 to 145. The transition is sharp: Leu16 fluctuates by 3.97 A and Ala18 by 1.16 A. The C-terminal six residues sit at 1.61 A and the most rigid position is Cys58 at 0.26 A.

title.zh: LEA14 取代設計：C58S、D78E 與 N 端兩親性
title.en: LEA14 substitutions: C58S, D78E and the N-terminal amphipathicity set

statement.zh: LEA14 只有一個半胱胺酸 Cys58，位於 β3 起點且沒有配對。遞送路徑經過氧化性的細胞外區室，未配對的硫醇可形成分子間雙硫鍵並二聚；C58S 以尺寸幾乎相同、無法如此作用的絲胺酸取代。序列中恰有一個 Asp-Pro 鍵，位於 78 與 79，這是最易酸解的胜肽鍵類型；D78E 移除它並保留該位置的負電荷。第三組取代針對殘基 2 至 19 的柔性 N 端延伸：螺旋輪分析給該段疏水矩約 0.37，有週期性但低於膜結合兩親螺旋的特徵範圍。
statement.en: LEA14 contains a single cysteine, Cys58, at the start of beta-3 with no partner. The delivery route passes through the oxidising extracellular compartment where an unpaired thiol can form intermolecular disulfides and dimerise; C58S substitutes a serine of almost identical size that cannot. The sequence contains exactly one Asp-Pro bond, at positions 78 and 79, the most acid-labile peptide bond type; D78E removes it while preserving the negative charge. A third group targets the flexible N-terminal extension at residues 2 to 19, whose helical wheel analysis gives a hydrophobic moment of about 0.37, periodic but below the range characteristic of membrane-binding amphipathic helices.

wiki.quote: Helical wheel analysis gives that segment a hydrophobic moment of about 0.37

title.zh: LEA14 的 GRAVY 值 +0.056，刻意不改
title.en: LEA14's GRAVY is +0.056 and was deliberately left alone

statement.zh: 團隊刻意不做表面親水性取代。LEA14 的 GRAVY 值 +0.056 對一個抗逆境蛋白而言不尋常、可以降低，但這麼做會與摺疊對抗，而且這類取代所要服務的大量水合屏蔽機制，正是可行性分析認為在任何可遞送濃度下都不成立的機制。
statement.en: Surface hydrophilicity substitutions were deliberately not pursued. LEA14's GRAVY value of +0.056 is unusual for a stress-protective protein and could be lowered, but doing so would work against the fold, and the bulk hydration shielding mechanism those substitutions would serve is the mechanism the feasibility analysis argues is not available at any deliverable concentration.

wiki.quote: LEA14's GRAVY value of +0.056 is unusual for a stress-protective protein

group.zh: 蛋白質設計 · GRAFT 方法

title.zh: AtPP2-B11 由 AlphaFold 3 摺疊，257 殘基，pTM 0.89
title.en: AtPP2-B11 folded with AlphaFold 3: 257 residues, pTM 0.89

statement.zh: AtPP2-B11 沒有實驗結構。以 AlphaFold 3 在 AlphaFold Server 上摺疊 UniProt Q949S5 的全長 257 殘基序列，啟用結構模板，單一 seed 回傳五個模型。五個模型都報 pTM 0.89，ranking score 0.89 至 0.90，無碰撞，disordered fraction 0.00 或 0.01。最佳模型平均 pLDDT 90.8（F-box 區 92.8、linker 89.9、PP2 域 90.6）。三段低於 pLDDT 70：殘基 1 至 2、PP2 域內 179 至 186 與 196 至 202 兩個環。與 AlphaFold Database 條目比對，全部 257 殘基的 Cα RMSD 為 1.27 Å。五個模型間平均成對 Cα RMSD 僅 0.94 Å，所以它們是同一個構形的五次重複，代表預測器的不確定度而非分子的構形空間。
statement.en: No experimental structure of AtPP2-B11 exists. The full 257-residue sequence of UniProt Q949S5 was folded with AlphaFold 3 on the AlphaFold Server with templates enabled, and one seed returned five models. All five report pTM 0.89 with ranking scores of 0.89 to 0.90, no clashes and a disordered fraction of 0.00 or 0.01. Mean pLDDT on the top model is 90.8, broken down as 92.8 over the F-box, 89.9 over the linker and 90.6 over the PP2 domain. Three stretches fall below pLDDT 70: residues 1 to 2 and two PP2-domain loops at 179 to 186 and 196 to 202. Against the AlphaFold Database entry the top model agrees to 1.27 A C-alpha RMSD. The mean pairwise C-alpha RMSD among the five models is 0.94 A, so they are the same conformation five times.

status_note.zh: 頁面自承「為什麼 LEA14 要對接 AtPP2-B11 還沒有寫上去」，所以這整段缺少理由。
status_note.en: The page states that why LEA14 is docked against AtPP2-B11 has not been written up, so the rationale for this whole section is missing.

wiki.quote: All five models report pTM 0.89 with ranking scores of 0.89 to 0.90
Why AtPP2-B11 is the protein LEA14 is docked against has not been written up yet

title.zh: AtPP2-B11 對接輸入為殘基 45 至 257，移除 F-box
title.en: The AtPP2-B11 docking input is residues 45 to 257 with the F-box removed

statement.zh: InterPro 把 F-box 域放在殘基 1 至 44、PP2 凝集素樣域放在 92 至 255，中間是未指派的 linker。F-box 是在 SCF 複合體中結合 ASK1 的表面，UniProt 直接記載，所以在細胞內不開放給 LEA14。對接輸入因此是殘基 45 至 257，鏈與片段識別碼 B，編號沿用全長蛋白。
statement.en: InterPro places the F-box domain at residues 1 to 44 and the PP2 lectin-like domain at 92 to 255, with an unassigned linker between. The F-box binds ASK1 inside the SCF complex, which UniProt records directly, so it is not available to LEA14 in the cell. The docking input is therefore residues 45 to 257, chain and segment identifier B, with numbering preserved from the full-length protein.

wiki.quote: the docking input is residues 45 to 257 with the F-box removed

group.zh: 蛋白質設計 · GRAFT 方法

title.zh: AlphaFold3 對一個已知失活 4000 倍的胜肽給 ipTM 0.73
title.en: AlphaFold3 gives ipTM 0.73 to a peptide published as 4000-fold inactive

statement.zh: 七月的方法稽核發現 AlphaFold 3 對一個已發表為失活超過 4000 倍的胜肽回傳 ipTM 0.73，而 BoPEP4 為 0.74。此指標無法分辨有功能的配體與失活的配體，因此只被當成結構信心估計使用。單一 seed 的多個模型是預測器對同一個答案的不確定度，不是構形系集。
statement.en: The July methodology audit found AlphaFold 3 returned ipTM 0.73 for a peptide published as more than 4000-fold inactive, against 0.74 for BoPEP4. The metric does not separate a functional ligand from a dead one, so it is used only as a structural confidence estimate. Multiple models from one seed are the predictor's uncertainty about a single answer, not a conformational ensemble.

wiki.quote: AlphaFold 3 returned ipTM 0.73 for a peptide published as more than 4000-fold inactive

group.zh: 蛋白質設計 · GRAFT 方法

title.zh: 一個分數排第四的 cluster 其 f-nat 為 0.000
title.en: A cluster ranked fourth by score returned f-nat 0.000

statement.zh: HADDOCK 分數在這些 run 中沒有可靠追蹤結構正確性：一個依分數排第四的 cluster 回傳 fnat 0.000，完全沒有重現任何原生接觸。因此每個 cluster 都對 5GR8 與 4MN8 的參考幾何重新評分，並依與參考的一致性而非分數排名選模型。這是 triage 設計成五重檢核的最主要理由。
statement.en: HADDOCK score did not reliably track structural accuracy in these runs: one cluster ranked fourth by score returned f-nat 0.000, reproducing none of the native contacts. Every cluster was therefore rescored against the 5GR8 and 4MN8 reference geometry and models selected on agreement with those references rather than on score ranking. This is the single most important reason triage exists as a five-check process.

wiki.quote: One cluster ranked fourth by score reproduced none of the native contacts.

group.zh: 蛋白質設計 · GRAFT 方法

title.zh: Triage 的五項檢核
title.en: The five triage checks

statement.zh: Triage 由五項為不相關理由而失敗的方法組成，模型必須全部通過：HADDOCK 分數與分群（是否收斂）、CAPRI（對 5GR8 評分正確性）、PDBePISA（界面大小與化學組成）、MolProbity 與 Ramachandran 圖（立體化學是否合法）、文獻檢核（是否重現已知接觸，即 Arg487 與 Arg491 對 C 端羧酸根）。PRODIGY 另外用於在自家變體間排序，不作為親和力量測。
statement.en: Triage is five methods that fail for unrelated reasons and a model must pass all of them: HADDOCK score and clustering for convergence, CAPRI graded against 5GR8 for correctness, PDBePISA for interface size and chemistry, MolProbity with the Ramachandran plot for stereochemical legality, and a literature check that the arginine anchors at 487 and 491 engage the C-terminal carboxylate. PRODIGY is used separately to rank the team's own variants, not as an affinity measurement.

wiki.quote: A model passes only if it passes all five.

title.zh: FLS2 疊到 PEPR1 的 RMSD 為 1.59 Å（74 對 Cα）
title.en: FLS2 superimposes onto PEPR1 at 1.59 A over 74 C-alpha pairs

statement.zh: 共受體界面方面，FLS2（4MN8 chain A）沿 LRR β 梯疊合到 PEPR1，74 對 Cα 的 RMSD 為 1.59 Å，BAK1 隨同一變換帶過去。作為檢核，被變換的 flg22 落在距 AtPEP1 1 到 2 Å 內，確認兩個配體在各自受體上佔相同的 register。
statement.en: For the co-receptor interface, FLS2 (4MN8 chain A) was superimposed onto PEPR1 along the LRR beta-ladder with an RMSD of 1.59 A over 74 C-alpha pairs, carrying BAK1 along with the transform. As a check, the transformed flg22 lands within 1 to 2 A of AtPEP1, confirming the two ligands occupy the same register on their respective receptors.

title.zh: ViennaRNA：重編碼訊號肽第 2 到 31 個密碼子
title.en: ViennaRNA: recoding codons 2 to 31 of the signal peptide is what matters

statement.zh: 以 ViennaRNA 在 MF001 核糖體結合位與起始密碼子周圍降低 mRNA 二級結構穩定度。分析在 RS-inclusive Window A 上進行：RS（28 nt）+ MF001 RBS（24 nt）+ 間隔（1 nt）+ SamyQ 訊號肽（93 nt）+ CDS 前 90 nt。Phase 1 固定 93 nt 的 SamyQ，只重編每個貨物基因前 15 個密碼子（45 nt），用 8,000 個隨機同義候選的庫，平衡分數 bal = start+15 + SD core。Phase 2 以 Bacillus subtilis 168 的密碼子使用矩陣優化 CAI 並附加 C 端 6xHis 純化標籤，但全長優化讓 start+15 下降而惡化轉譯起始。Phase 3 改為讓 SamyQ 的第 2 到 31 個密碼子可編輯。
statement.en: ViennaRNA was used to reduce mRNA secondary-structure stability around the MF001 ribosome binding site and start codon. Analyses ran on the RS-inclusive Window A: RS (28 nt) + MF001 RBS (24 nt) + spacer (1 nt) + SamyQ signal peptide (93 nt) + CDS first 90 nt. Phase 1 held the 93 nt SamyQ static and recoded only the first 15 codons (45 nt) of each passenger gene from a library of 8,000 random synonymous candidates, scored as bal = start+15 + SD core. Phase 2 optimised CAI against the Bacillus subtilis 168 usage matrix and appended a C-terminal 6xHis tag, but full-length optimisation degraded initiation by lowering start+15. Phase 3 made SamyQ codons 2 to 31 editable.

status_note.zh: 〔10/14 乾實驗封存核對〕已核對 dry lab 原始檔：v3 設計的可編輯訊號肽密碼子索引為 1–30，即第 2 到 31 個密碼子，與頁面一致；Window A 的組成（RS 28 + MF001 24 + 間隔 1 + SamyQ 93 + CDS 前 90 nt）也與 REPORT.md 相同。但「8,000 個隨機同義候選」在檔案中找不到：round 2 各組的合法候選數為 BoPep4 33,395、LEA14 34,342、ACCD 40,899、AmilCP 39,091，而 sharp 最佳化器 v2 摺疊 4,437 個結構、v3 摺疊 110,040 個。頁面上的 8,000 需要改成檔案裡的數字。
status_note.en: [14 Oct dry lab archive check] Checked against the dry lab archive: the v3 design's editable signal-peptide codon indices are 1-30, that is codons 2 to 31, as the page says, and Window A is composed exactly as REPORT.md states (RS 28 + MF001 24 + spacer 1 + SamyQ 93 + first 90 nt of the CDS). The library of 8,000 random synonymous candidates is not in any file: round 2 enumerated 33,395 legal candidates for BoPep4, 34,342 for LEA14, 40,899 for ACCD and 39,091 for AmilCP, and the sharp optimiser folded 4,437 structures for v2 and 110,040 for v3. The 8,000 on the page should be replaced with the archived counts.

title.zh: SignalP 6.0 用於確認與排除切位
title.en: SignalP 6.0 used to confirm and to exclude cleavage sites

statement.zh: SignalP 6.0 用於兩件事：確認每個訊號肽與成熟序列的接合處會在預期位置被辨識與切割，使釋出的成熟蛋白帶有設計的 N 端；以及檢查成熟序列內部沒有被隱性預測的切位。預測跨整個訊號肽面板執行，而非只對單一假定選擇。
statement.en: SignalP 6.0 is used to confirm each signal peptide and mature sequence junction is recognised and cleaved where intended, so the mature protein has the designed N-terminus, and to check that no cleavage site is cryptically predicted inside the mature sequence. Predictions were run across the whole signal peptide panel rather than one assumed choice.

wiki.quote: A construct that passes structural triage and fails this check is not orderable.

title.zh: MD 設定：ff19SB / OPC，4 fs HMR，30 ns，單一 A100
title.en: MD setup: ff19SB / OPC, 4 fs with HMR, 30 ns on one A100

statement.zh: 九個系統都建在 PDB 5GR8 的 PEPR1 胞外域（殘基 29 至 738，共 710 個受體殘基）上，以 OPC 顯式水溶劑化，使用 AMBER ff19SB 力場。氫質量重分配允許 4 fs 時間步長。每個系統在相同的平衡程序後跑 30 ns 生產動力學，單一隨機 seed，各存 1,500 幀。系統約 127,600 個原子（實測 126,997 至 127,818）。
statement.en: All nine systems were built on the PEPR1 ectodomain from PDB 5GR8, residues 29 to 738 (710 receptor residues), solvated in explicit OPC water with the AMBER ff19SB force field. Hydrogen mass repartitioning allows a 4 fs time step. Each system ran 30 ns of production after the same equilibration schedule from a single random seed, saving 1,500 frames. Systems are about 127,600 atoms, measured between 126,997 and 127,818.

wiki.quote: Every system ran 30 ns of production after the same equilibration schedule
The systems have ~127,600 atoms each

title.zh: 九條軌跡合計 270 ns、13,500 幀、25.9 GPU 小時
title.en: Nine trajectories total 270 ns, 13,500 frames, 25.9 GPU-hours

statement.zh: 九條軌跡合計 270 ns 模擬時間、13,500 幀、25.9 GPU 小時，全部在一張 NVIDIA A100-SXM4-40GB 上，速度約每日 246 至 252 ns，每個系統牆上時間約 2.86 至 2.92 小時。
statement.en: The nine trajectories total 270 ns of simulation, 13,500 saved frames and 25.9 GPU-hours, all on one NVIDIA A100-SXM4-40GB at roughly 246 to 252 ns per day and about 2.86 to 2.92 hours wall clock per system.

wiki.quote: for 25.9 GPU-hours and 13,500 saved frames in total

title.zh: 九個系統清單與四個變數
title.en: The nine systems and the four variables that change

statement.zh: 九個系統依四件事變化：配體身分、殘基範圍、C 端狀態、組胺酸質子化。清單為：AtPEP1 7-23 基準（REF，17 殘基，KQRGKEKVSSGRPGQHN）、BoPEP4 1-23 參考（WT）、7-23 截短（T723）、9-23 截短（T923）、15-23 截短（T1523）、1-23 + 6xHis 標籤（CHIS，29 殘基，C 端封閉）、1-23 pH 5.5（LOWPH，3 個質子化組胺酸）、9-23 pH 5.5（T923L，3 個質子化組胺酸）、apo 受體對照（APO，無配體）。
statement.en: The nine systems vary in four ways: ligand identity, residue range, C-terminal state and histidine protonation. They are: AtPEP1 7-23 benchmark (REF, 17 residues, KQRGKEKVSSGRPGQHN), BoPEP4 1-23 reference (WT), 7-23 truncation (T723), 9-23 truncation (T923), 15-23 truncation (T1523), 1-23 plus 6xHis tag (CHIS, 29 residues, C-terminus blocked), 1-23 at pH 5.5 (LOWPH, three protonated histidines), 9-23 at pH 5.5 (T923L, three protonated histidines) and the apo receptor control (APO, no ligand).

wiki.quote: Nine runs: controls, truncation ladder, 6xHis tag, pH 5.5

title.zh: 野生型 BoPEP4：夾鉗 100%、雙齒鹽橋 100%、RMSD 1.67 Å
title.en: Wild-type BoPEP4: clamp 100%, bidentate salt bridge 100%, RMSD 1.67 A

statement.zh: 野生型 1-23 參考系統：四接觸夾鉗完整度 100.0%，Asn23 與 Arg487 的雙齒鹽橋佔 100.0%，15-23 窗的主鏈 RMSD 1.67 Å，該窗接觸數 96.5，受體 Cα RMSD 1.58 Å。
statement.en: The wild-type 1-23 reference run: four-contact clamp integrity 100.0%, bidentate Asn23-Arg487 salt bridge 100.0%, backbone RMSD over the 15-23 window 1.67 A, 96.5 contacts in that window and receptor C-alpha RMSD 1.58 A.

title.zh: AtPEP1 7-23 基準：RMSD 1.17 Å、接觸 107.4
title.en: AtPEP1 7-23 benchmark: RMSD 1.17 A, 107.4 contacts

statement.zh: AtPEP1 7-23 基準（REF）：夾鉗完整度 99.9%，雙齒鹽橋 99.9%，15-23 窗主鏈 RMSD 1.17 Å（SEM 0.056），該窗接觸 107.4，受體 Cα RMSD 1.70 Å，Glu12-His227 佔 76.9% 於 3.36 Å。
statement.en: The AtPEP1 7-23 benchmark: clamp integrity 99.9%, bidentate salt bridge 99.9%, 15-23 backbone RMSD 1.17 A (SEM 0.056), 107.4 contacts in that window, receptor C-alpha RMSD 1.70 A, and Glu12-His227 at 76.9% occupancy and 3.36 A.

wiki.quote: | AtPEP1 7–23benchmark | AtPEP1 | 17 | free | 0 | 99.9 | 99.9 | 1.17

title.zh: 9-23 是最不穩的未標籤構築
title.en: 9-23 is the least stable untagged construct

statement.zh: 9-23 構築：夾鉗完整度 77.1%，雙齒鹽橋只在 46.9% 的幀形成，Asn23 與 Arg487 距離在 cutoff 內的幀佔 81.1%，保守窗接觸 68.5（野生型 96.5），主鏈 RMSD 2.28 Å，是 BoPEP4 軌跡中最大的。雙齒鹽橋是反覆短暫解離而非一次斷掉：共斷 94 次，佔軌跡 22.9%，每次不超過 0.68 ns。
statement.en: The 9-23 construct: clamp integrity 77.1%, bidentate salt bridge in only 46.9% of frames, Asn23 within the cutoff of Arg487 in 81.1% of frames, 68.5 contacts in the conserved window against 96.5 for wild type, and a backbone RMSD of 2.28 A, the largest of the BoPEP4 trajectories. The bidentate salt bridge dissociated transiently rather than breaking once: 94 breaks, 22.9% of the trajectory, none lasting more than 0.68 ns.

wiki.quote: It had 77.1% clamp integrity, formed the bidentate salt bridge in only 46.9% of frames

title.en: 7-23 reveals the Lys7-Asp129 anchor at 98.7% and 2.81 A

statement.zh: 模擬揭露一個不在已發表熱點清單上的交互作用：全長胜肽中，Lys7 側鏈與受體 Asp129 的鹽橋在 98.7% 的幀形成，距離 2.81 Å。它在 9-23 構築中的缺席，比原先「新暴露的末端造成不穩」的假設更直接地解釋了該構築的穩定度下降。7-23 把自由 N 端移到 Lys7 後，夾鉗完整度從 77.1% 跳到 98.5%，Asn23-Arg487 從 81.1% 升到 99.9%，雙齒鹽橋從 46.9% 升到 87.7%，共享的 9-23 序列接觸從 128.7 增加到 151.3。
statement.en: The simulations revealed an interaction absent from the published hotspot lists: in the full-length peptide the Lys7 side chain salt-bridges receptor Asp129 in 98.7% of frames at 2.81 A. Its absence in 9-23 explains that construct's reduced stability more directly than the original newly-exposed-terminus hypothesis. Moving the free N-terminus to Lys7 in 7-23 raised clamp integrity from 77.1% to 98.5%, Asn23-Arg487 from 81.1% to 99.9%, the bidentate salt bridge from 46.9% to 87.7%, and contacts over the shared 9-23 sequence from 128.7 to 151.3.

status_note.zh:
Lys7-Asp129 的佔有率與距離未在原始 JSON 中直接核對；頁面上的 7-23 與 9-23 夾鉗數字則與原始資料一致。
〔10/14 乾實驗封存核對〕數字對得上，歸屬錯了。98.7% 與 2.81 Å 是 **7-23** 這一條軌跡的 Lys7–Asp129 鹽橋（bopep4-7-23.json 的 X.extras.T723.lys.7：partner Asp129、partner_d 2.81、partner_occ4 98.7、anion_occ4 98.73），而同一頁的受體佔據率差異表把受體 Asp129 列為野生型 44.2%、7-23 為 98.7%（d = 54.5）。頁面寫「在全長胜肽中…98.7%」方向相反：全長只有 44.2%。這句是整個「缺少這個鹽橋解釋 9-23 不穩」論證的支點，需要改成 7-23。其餘數字都對：clamp 77.1 → 98.5、Asn23–Arg487 81.1 → 99.9、bidentate 46.9 → 87.7（overview 的 T923/T723 欄位）。
status_note.en:
The Lys7-Asp129 occupancy and distance were not checked directly in the raw JSON, though the 7-23 and 9-23 clamp figures on the page do match the raw data.
[14 Oct dry lab archive check] The numbers are right and the attribution is not. The 98.7% at 2.81 A is the Lys7-Asp129 salt bridge in the **7-23** trajectory (bopep4-7-23.json, X.extras.T723.lys.7: partner Asp129, partner_d 2.81, partner_occ4 98.7, anion_occ4 98.73), while the receptor-occupancy delta table on the same page lists receptor Asp129 at 44.2% for wild type against 98.7% for 7-23 (d = 54.5). The page says 'in the full-length peptide ... 98.7%', which is backwards: full length is 44.2%. That sentence is the hinge of the whole argument that the missing salt bridge explains 9-23's instability, so it has to say 7-23. Everything else checks: clamp 77.1 to 98.5, Asn23-Arg487 81.1 to 99.9, bidentate 46.9 to 87.7, all in the overview T923 and T723 entries.

wiki.quote: a salt bridge between peptide Lys7 and receptor Asp129 was present in 98.7% of frames at a distance of 2.81 Å

title.zh: 15-23 作為陰性對照卻表現穩定
title.en: 15-23 was designed as a negative control and came out stable

statement.zh: 15-23 構築原本設計為陰性對照，卻在模擬全程高度有序：夾鉗完整度 99.9%，雙齒鹽橋佔 97.2%，主鏈 RMSD 1.81 Å。其九個殘基形成 89.6 個接觸，相對同一段序列在全長中的 96.5 個，即在刪去 14 個殘基後仍保有約 93% 的接觸網路。
statement.en: The 15-23 construct was designed as a negative control but stayed highly organised: clamp integrity 99.9%, bidentate salt bridge 97.2% and backbone RMSD 1.81 A. Its nine residues form 89.6 contacts against 96.5 made by the same residues in wild type, so despite deleting 14 residues it retains about 93% of the contact network.

wiki.quote: It had a clamp integrity of 99.9%, occupancy of the bidentate salt bridge of 97.2%

title.zh: 6xHis 標籤構築的雙齒鹽橋只剩 2.4%
title.en: The 6xHis-tagged construct's bidentate salt bridge drops to 2.4%

statement.zh: 把六個組胺酸從 Asn23 之後接上去，使自由羧酸根不再參與與 Arg487 的原生雙齒鹽橋。標籤構築的雙齒佔有率為 2.4%，野生型為 100%。頁面說明 2.4% 不是「弱鹽橋」：該構築沒有 OXT，Asn23 變成內部殘基，其羧酸根已消耗於與 His24 形成醯胺鍵，所以判準量到的是一個中性醯胺羰基氧，那裡根本沒有鹽橋可弱。此構築的 15-23 主鏈 RMSD 是全組最低的 1.12 Å。
statement.en: Appending six histidines after Asn23 removes the free carboxylate from the native bidentate salt bridge with Arg487. The tagged construct's bidentate occupancy is 2.4% against 100% for wild type. The page explains 2.4% is not a weak salt bridge: the construct has no OXT, Asn23 became an internal residue and its carboxylate was spent forming the amide bond to His24, so the criterion is measuring one neutral amide carbonyl oxygen. This construct has the lowest 15-23 backbone RMSD in the set at 1.12 A.

wiki.quote: Why 2.4% is not a weak salt bridge
the bidentate salt bridge was missing in every simulated frame in contrast to 100% of native frames

caption.zh: Asn23 埋在 PEPR1 口袋中
caption.en: Asn23 buried in the PEPR1 pocket

title.zh: pH 5.5 使 Glu12-His227 在 99.9% 的幀形成，距離 2.75 Å
title.en: pH 5.5 puts Glu12 on His227 at 2.75 A in 99.9% of frames

statement.zh: 把胜肽上的 His14 與 His22、受體上的 His227 切換為質子化形式，其他原子完全相同，使 Glu12 羧酸根鎖在 His227 環上，距離 2.75 ± 0.11 Å，佔 99.9% 的幀。在 pH 7 同一對相距 5.33 Å、只出現在 0.8% 的幀。AtPEP1 基準在中性 pH 下本來就有這個接觸（3.36 Å、76.9%），所以 pH 5.5 對 BoPEP4 做的是找回其校正對照原生就有的接觸。C 端錨點未受影響，夾鉗維持 100.0%、雙齒 99.9%、保守窗 95.7 個接觸、主鏈 RMSD 1.34 Å。
statement.en: Switching His14 and His22 on the peptide and His227 on the receptor to their protonated form, with every other atom identical, locks the Glu12 carboxylate onto the His227 ring at 2.75 +/- 0.11 A in 99.9% of frames. At pH 7 the same pair sits 5.33 A apart and appears in 0.8%. The AtPEP1 benchmark already makes that contact at neutral pH, at 3.36 A and 76.9%, so pH 5.5 recovers for BoPEP4 a contact its calibrating control has natively. The C-terminal anchor is untouched: clamp 100.0%, bidentate 99.9%, 95.7 contacts in the conserved window and backbone RMSD 1.34 A.

wiki.quote: pH 5.5 puts Glu12 on His227 at 2.75 Å in 99.9% of frames
separated by 2.75 ± 0.11 Å in 99.9% of frames compared with 5.33 Å and only 0.8% occupancy at pH 7

title.zh: His14 的 pH 開關假說不成立
title.en: The His14 pH-switch hypothesis is not supported

statement.zh: 引發 pH 5.5 run 的 His14 開關構想未獲支持。不論是否質子化，His14 的環氮距離最近的受體羧酸根約 6.1 Å，次 4 Å 接觸佔 0.0%。真正的 pH 感應配對是受體 His227 與胜肽 Glu12。
statement.en: The His14 pH-switch idea that motivated the run is not supported. Protonated or not, its ring nitrogens sit about 6.1 A from the nearest receptor carboxylate at 0.0% occupancy. The pH-sensing pair is receptor His227 with peptide Glu12.

status_note.zh: 〔10/14 乾實驗封存核對〕精確對上：bopep4-lowph-vs-wt.json 的 his 區塊記 His14 的 d_anion 在 pH 7（HIE）為 6.09 Å、pH 5.5（HIP）為 6.08 Å，兩者 occ4_anion 都是 0.0%。同一區塊的受體 His227 在 pH 5.5 是 2.75 Å、99.9%，所以「感應 pH 的是 His227–Glu12，不是 His14」成立。
status_note.en: [14 Oct dry lab archive check] Exact match: the his block in bopep4-lowph-vs-wt.json records His14 with d_anion 6.09 A at pH 7 (HIE) and 6.08 A at pH 5.5 (HIP), with occ4_anion 0.0% in both. In the same block receptor His227 is at 2.75 A and 99.9% at pH 5.5, so the pH-sensing pair being His227 with Glu12 rather than His14 holds.

wiki.quote: its ring nitrogens sit about 6.1 Å from the nearest receptor carboxylate, at 0.0% occupancy

title.zh: 9-23 在 pH 5.5 是唯一未通過驗收的軌跡
title.en: 9-23 at pH 5.5 is the only trajectory that failed its acceptance criteria

statement.zh: 質子化反而讓 9-23 更不穩。Asn23-Arg487 在 4 Å 內的幀只剩 23.6%，遠低於 60% 的驗收門檻；夾鉗完整度掉到 19.3%，雙齒鹽橋佔有率 6.9%，使它成為唯一未通過預註冊驗收標準的 BoPEP4 軌跡。機制是質子化 His22 與 C 端羧酸根之間新形成的分子內接觸：在 9-23 的 pH 5.5 下該接觸於 96.9% 的幀出現、距離 2.84 Å，pH 7 下為 17.4%；全長在 pH 7 下只有 1.1%、pH 5.5 下升到 64.7% 而夾鉗仍完整。
statement.en: Protonation further destabilised 9-23. Asn23 stays within 4 A of Arg487 in only 23.6% of frames, well below the 60% acceptance threshold; clamp integrity fell to 19.3% and bidentate occupancy to 6.9%, making it the only BoPEP4 trajectory that failed its pre-registered acceptance criteria. The mechanism is a new intramolecular contact between protonated His22 and the C-terminal carboxylate, at 2.84 A in 96.9% of frames in 9-23 at pH 5.5 against 17.4% at pH 7, while the full-length equivalent was 1.1% at pH 7 and 64.7% at pH 5.5 with the clamp intact.

status_note.zh: 原始 JSON 同時帶兩個 Arg487 指標：驗收用的 Asn23-Arg487 < 4 Å 為 23.6%，而受體足跡指標 arg487_foot 為 36.1%。頁面引用的是前者。
status_note.en: The raw JSON carries two Arg487 metrics: the acceptance criterion Asn23-Arg487 under 4 A at 23.6%, and a receptor footprint metric arg487_foot at 36.1%. The page quotes the former.

wiki.quote: clamp integrity fell to 19.3% and bidentate salt-bridge occupancy to 6.9%

title.zh: Apo 受體的 Cα RMSD 1.57 Å，低於全部八條帶肽軌跡
title.en: The apo receptor's C-alpha RMSD is 1.57 A, below every bound run

statement.zh: apo run 的受體 Cα RMSD 為 1.57 Å，低於可比較的七條帶肽軌跡（1.58 至 2.16 Å）。結合凹槽在空著時維持 35.91 ± 0.55 Å（帶肽為 35.65 至 36.42 Å），逐殘基柔性剖面與帶肽 run 的相關係數 r = 0.95（區間 0.94 至 0.97）。54 個界面殘基相對野生型只位移 +0.125 Å，其餘 656 個殘基為 +0.156 Å。換掉一個胜肽讓受體在 0.59 Å 的範圍內移動，完全移除胜肽移動得更少。
statement.en: The apo run's receptor C-alpha RMSD is 1.57 A, below all seven comparable peptide-bearing runs which span 1.58 to 2.16 A. The binding groove holds at 35.91 +/- 0.55 A with nothing in it, against 35.65 to 36.42 A bound, and the per-residue flexibility profile correlates with the bound runs at r = 0.95 (range 0.94 to 0.97). The 54 interface residues shifted by only +0.125 A relative to wild type against +0.156 A for the remaining 656. Swapping one peptide for another moves the receptor across a 0.59 A range; removing it altogether moves it less.

wiki.quote: Apo floor: receptor Cα 1.57 Å, groove 35.91 ± 0.55 Å
the lowest mean Cα RMSD of all nine simulations at 1.57 Å

title.zh: 十個受體殘基在八條 run 中都維持 50% 以上接觸
title.en: Ten receptor residues stay above 50% occupancy in all eight runs

statement.zh: 匯總八條帶肽 run 的逐殘基接觸佔有率，十個受體殘基在每一條中都維持 50% 以上：Asp273、Ser275、Val297、Lys345、Tyr395、Phe419、Asp441、Ile443、Ile463、Asn465。其中五個在 Tang 等人從 AtPEP1 複合物讀出的八個熱點清單上，五個不在；不在清單上的是 Ser275、Lys345、Tyr395、Phe419 與 Ile463。
statement.en: Pooling per-residue contact occupancies across all eight peptide-bearing runs, ten receptor residues stay above 50% in every one: Asp273, Ser275, Val297, Lys345, Tyr395, Phe419, Asp441, Ile443, Ile463 and Asn465. Five of the ten are on Tang's list of eight hotspots read off the AtPep1 complex and five are not; the five that are not are Ser275, Lys345, Tyr395, Phe419 and Ile463.

wiki.quote: Ten receptor residues stay above 50% in all eight runs

title.zh: 主鏈 RMSD 無法用來排名構築
title.en: Backbone RMSD cannot be used to rank the constructs

statement.zh: 在八條帶肽 run 上，15-23 窗的主鏈 RMSD 與雙齒 Arg487 鹽橋的 Pearson 相關為 +0.13、Spearman +0.29，與四接觸夾鉗為 −0.03 與 −0.07。接觸數表現較好，對夾鉗為 +0.27 與 +0.55。以 RMSD 排名時，6xHis 構築排第一而它正是鹽橋消失的那一個；失敗的 run 排第二。
statement.en: Across the eight peptide-bearing runs, backbone RMSD over the 15-23 window correlates with the bidentate Arg487 salt bridge at Pearson +0.13 and Spearman +0.29, and with the four-contact clamp at -0.03 and -0.07. Contact count does better, at +0.27 and +0.55 against the clamp. Ranked on RMSD the 6xHis construct comes first and it is the one construct whose salt bridge is gone; the failed run ranks second.

status_note.zh: MD 總覽頁寫「對四接觸夾鉗是 +0.03，方向反了」，而分子動力學頁與原始資料是 −0.03 與 −0.07。總覽頁又寫接觸數為「+0.26 與 +0.55」，分子動力學頁寫接觸數在七條未標籤 run 上的 Spearman 為 +0.71。原始資料兩者皆有（八條 all：ncon_clamp rho 0.548；七條 untagged：ncon_bident rho 0.714），但兩頁沒有說明用的是不同子集。
status_note.en: The MD overview says the correlation against the four-contact clamp is +0.03 the wrong way while the Molecular Dynamics page and the raw data give -0.03 and -0.07. The overview gives contact count as +0.26 and +0.55 while the MD page gives +0.71 across the seven untagged runs. The raw data contains both (all eight: ncon_clamp rho 0.548; seven untagged: ncon_bident rho 0.714) but neither page says it is using a different subset.

wiki.quote: Backbone RMSD tracks the salt bridge at Spearman +0.29
with a Spearman correlation of +0.71 across the seven untagged runs

title.zh: Lys18 與 Asp348 的接觸只在 53.7% 的幀形成
title.en: The Lys18-Asp348 contact holds in only 53.7% of frames

statement.zh: 野生型軌跡中，Lys18 與 Asp348 的接觸只在 53.7% 的幀出現，距離在 2.55 至 9.37 Å 之間擺盪。相較之下 Asn23-Arg487 的佔有率為 100%，距離窗只有 0.54 Å。Phe371 在軌跡中最常接觸的是 Gly20（84.4% 的幀在 3.69 Å 內），Lys18 距 Phe371 平均 5.12 Å，只在 18.1% 的幀進到 4 Å 內。Lys18-Asp348 的佔有率在 9-23 構築中反而升到 90.1%。
statement.en: In the wild-type trajectory the Lys18-Asp348 contact is present in only 53.7% of frames, with distances ranging from 2.55 to 9.37 A. By comparison Asn23-Arg487 holds 100% occupancy within a 0.54 A window. Phe371 most frequently contacts Gly20, within 3.69 A for 84.4% of frames, while Lys18 averages 5.12 A from Phe371 and comes within 4 A in only 18.1%. In the 9-23 construct the Lys18-Asp348 occupancy rises to 90.1%.

wiki.quote: the Lys18–Asp348 contact is present in only 53.7% of frames

title.zh: K18R 的 MD run 不存在
title.en: There is no K18R MD run

statement.zh: 分子動力學頁寫 K18R 是否能達成所提議的幾何「仍未測試，需要一次專門的模擬」。九個已跑的系統中沒有 K18R，它們只在配體、殘基範圍、C 端與質子化四件事上變化。但 Sprints 頁上方的 run 清單把 K18R（以及 K8Q、K8Q+K18R）列為 BoPEP4 的 run。
statement.en: The Molecular Dynamics page states that whether K18R achieves the proposed geometry remains untested and requires a dedicated simulation. None of the nine systems run is a K18R mutant; they vary only in ligand, residue range, C-terminus and protonation. The run list at the top of Sprints nevertheless lists K18R, along with K8Q and K8Q plus K18R, as BoPEP4 runs.

status_note.zh: 學生的 run 清單需要更正：K18R 的 MD 從未跑過。清單裡的 K18R 指的可能是對接 run 而非 MD，但頁面沒有區分。待問清單第 34 題。
status_note.en: The student run list needs correcting: no K18R MD was ever run. The K18R in the list may refer to a docking run rather than MD, but the page does not distinguish them. Open question 34.

wiki.quote: Whether K18R achieves this geometry remains untested and requires a dedicated simulation.
Alanine substitution Truncation ladder Tandem repeat analysis N-His vs C-His K8Q K18R

title.zh: MD 只跑了 BoPEP4，LEA14 與 ACCD 沒有軌跡
title.en: MD ran on BoPEP4 only; LEA14 and ACCD have no trajectories

statement.zh: 九條軌跡全部是 BoPEP4 或其 AtPEP1 基準與 apo 受體對照。另外兩個保護蛋白 LEA14 與 ACC deaminase 沒有任何分子動力學軌跡，雖然方法頁為兩者都列出了設計軸。
statement.en: All nine trajectories are BoPEP4, its AtPEP1 benchmark or the apo receptor control. The other two protectants, LEA14 and ACC deaminase, have no molecular dynamics trajectories at all, although the methodology page lists engineering axes for both.

status_note.zh: 這是全站 MD 覆蓋範圍的事實：三個保護蛋白中只有一個被模擬過。
status_note.en: This is the site-wide MD coverage fact: only one of the three protectants has been simulated.

wiki.quote: Nine all-atom trajectories of BoPEP4 that ask whether a docked pose holds up

title.zh: 7-23 與 AtPep1 的 N 端錨點殘基與配對都不同
title.en: 7-23 and AtPep1 anchor their N-termini with different residues and partners

statement.zh: 7-23 與 AtPep1 晶體結構跨同一段 7-23 序列且共用自由 N 端，17 個位置中有 15 個接觸佔有率非常相近。差別在 N 端錨定：AtPep1 用 Gln8 接觸 Tyr153，距離 3.41 Å、佔 95.8% 的幀，Lys7 只貢獻 19.0%；BoPEP4 用 Lys7 接觸 Asp129，2.81 Å、佔 98.7%，Lys8 只貢獻 4.1%。兩條胜肽在界面這一端都由單一殘基主導接觸，但錨定殘基與受體配對在序列與位置上都不同。
statement.en: 7-23 and the AtPep1 crystal span the same 7-23 sequence and share a free N-terminus, and 15 of the 17 positions have very similar contact occupancies. The difference is N-terminal anchoring: AtPep1 uses Gln8 to contact Tyr153 at 3.41 A in 95.8% of frames with Lys7 contributing only 19.0%, while BoPEP4 uses Lys7 to contact Asp129 at 2.81 A in 98.7% with Lys8 contributing only 4.1%. One residue dominates at this end for both peptides, but the anchoring residue and receptor partner differ in both sequence and position.

wiki.quote: AtPep1 used Gln8 to make a contact with Tyr153 at 3.41 Å in 95.8% of frames

title.zh: 7-23 並未完整重現全長的交互作用持續性
title.en: 7-23 does not fully reproduce the full-length interaction persistence

statement.zh: 7-23 雖然具備結合界面的所有主要特徵，但部分交互作用的持續性下降：Asn465 氫鍵在 62.9% 的幀出現，野生型為 99.8%；雙齒鹽橋佔 87.7%，野生型為 100%。使用 7-23 作為基準時需注意這點。
statement.en: While 7-23 has all the main features of the binding interface, some interactions are less persistent: the Asn465 hydrogen bond occurs in 62.9% of frames against 99.8% in wild type, and the bidentate salt bridge in 87.7% against 100%. This matters when 7-23 is used as a benchmark.

wiki.quote: the bidentate salt bridge was occupied in 87.7% of frames compared to 100%

title.zh: 驗收門檻寫在 6xHis 構築存在之前
title.en: The acceptance gate was written before the tagged construct existed

statement.zh: 原始驗收標準在 C 端組胺酸標籤構築被模擬之前就訂好，而且是圍繞未標籤胜肽的交互作用訂的，也就是 Asn23 自由 C 端羧酸根與 PEPR1 Arg487 之間的接觸。在標籤構築上，Asn23 已不是自由 C 端，原本的交互作用無法以同樣方式評估。頁面結論是驗收標準應修訂，以區分加標籤後仍相關的交互作用與依賴原生自由 C 端的交互作用。
statement.en: The original acceptance criteria were set before the C-terminally His-tagged construct was simulated and were built around the untagged peptide's interaction between the free C-terminal carboxylate of Asn23 and PEPR1 Arg487. On the tagged construct Asn23 is no longer the free C-terminus and the original interaction cannot be assessed the same way. The page concludes the criteria should be revised to separate interactions still pertinent after tagging from those relying on the native free C-terminus.

wiki.quote: The acceptance gate was written before the tagged construct existed
The acceptance criteria demand particular care when comparing the tagged and untagged constructs.

title.zh: MD 的三項限制：30 ns、單一 seed、未經實驗檢證
title.en: Three MD limits: 30 ns, one seed, nothing tested at the bench

statement.zh: 30 奈秒比解離事件短三到六個數量級，所以頁面上沒有任何一個數字是結合親和力、離開時間或自由能。每個系統只有一個 seed，所以兩條 run 之間的差異可能只是兩條鬆弛路徑之間的差異。而且全部都未經實驗檢證：沒有結合測定、沒有熱位移、沒有植物。
statement.en: Thirty nanoseconds is three to six orders of magnitude short of a dissociation event, so nothing on the page is a binding affinity, a leaving time or a free energy. Each system has one seed, so a difference between two runs may be a difference between two relaxation paths. And none of it has been checked at the bench: no binding assay, no thermal shift, no plant.

status_note.zh: 所有 MD 結論目前都是「要造什麼、要測什麼」的假設，不是結果。
status_note.en: Every MD conclusion is currently a hypothesis about what to build and measure, not a result.

wiki.quote: 30 ns, one seed, nothing tested at the bench

title.zh: 建議的下一步模擬：全長 K7A
title.en: The proposed next simulation is a full-length K7A mutant

statement.zh: 直接檢驗 Lys7 所提議角色的方式是模擬全長 K7A 突變體：它移除所提議的側鏈錨點，而不改變胜肽的兩個末端，因此可以直接評估其對界面穩定度的貢獻。此模擬尚未執行。

title.zh: 純化標籤在 N 端還是 C 端：三頁三種說法
title.en: Purification tag at the N- or C-terminus: three pages, three accounts

statement.zh: Peptide Design 寫 2026 年 8 月 16 日之後每個親和標籤都移到 N 端，訂購的六個 cassette 全部以自由的 …G-G-H-N-COO⁻ 結尾，標籤在 N 端。Molecular Dynamics 頁的「Histidine tag」段開頭寫「把純化標籤移到 C 端的決定，造成六個組胺酸從 Asn23 開始」，同頁後面的 Application 段又寫結果促成「把純化標籤移到 N 端再表現」。GRAFT Methodology 的密碼子優化 Phase 2 寫「附加一個 C 端 6xHis 純化標籤」。Sprints 寫「我們訂購的構築把 CATCATCATCATCATCAT 直接接在成熟胜肽之後」。
statement.en: Peptide Design says every affinity tag moved to the N terminus after 16 August 2026 and that all six ordered cassettes end in a free G-G-H-N-COO-, with the tag at the N-terminus. The Histidine tag section of Molecular Dynamics opens by saying the decision to move the purification tag to the C-terminus produced six histidines beginning at Asn23, while the Application section of the same page says the results informed the decision to move the tag to the N-terminus before expression. GRAFT Methodology's codon optimisation Phase 2 says it appended a C-terminal 6xHis tag. Sprints says the ordered constructs append CATCATCATCATCATCAT directly after the mature peptide.

status_note.zh: 依構築逐一釐清，證據為濕實驗的 2026 primer list 與 SnapGene 檔，對照乾實驗訂購封存。8/20 訂購（0823_Order_Report_Gabriel/BoPep4_0823_parts.csv）的 6xHis 在 N 端，nt 489-506，位於 SamyQ 訊號肽與酬載之間，附註為「只放 N 端，不可把 His 接在 Asn23」：D-01、D-02、D-03、D-06 為 N 端標籤，D-04、D-05 無標籤。但 8/19 選殖的 SamyQ-Bopep4-v2t1 與 v2t2 是六、七月設計的密碼子最佳化截短版，沿用較早的 C 端 His6（run_sharp_opt.py 的 build_base_cds 為 mature + His6 + stop，order_rows.json 每條 full_seq 都以 CATCAT...TAA 結尾）。只有 9/26 至 9/28 製作的 Bopep4-WT、G17A 與 SamyQ-Bopep4-S15A 把標籤放在前端。因此 Peptide Design 頁「8/16 之後訂的每一個構築都以自由的 G-G-H-N 結尾」這句話作為全稱敘述是錯的，Molecular Dynamics 頁「把純化標籤移到 C 端的決定」方向也寫反了。兩句都要改；標籤位置本身已不需要再問 Chars 或 Gabriel。（原始檔："NHis-Bopep4 |  |  | reverse | ATATATGAAGACATGAGGGGTCTCATGTCttaATTGTGTCCTCCCGGT"）
status_note.en: Resolved per construct, from the wet lab primer list and the SnapGene cloning products read against the dry lab order archive. The 20 August order (parts list 0823_Order_Report_Gabriel/BoPep4_0823_parts.csv) puts 6xHis at the N terminus, nt 489-506, between the SamyQ signal peptide and the payload, with the note 'N-terminal only; never fuse His to Asn23': D-01, D-02, D-03 and D-06 are N-terminally tagged and D-04 and D-05 are untagged. But SamyQ-Bopep4-v2t1 and v2t2, cloned 19 August, are the codon-optimised truncations from the June and July design work and carry the earlier C-terminal His6 (run_sharp_opt.py build_base_cds is mature + His6 + stop, and every full_seq in order_rows.json ends CATCAT...TAA). Only Bopep4-WT, G17A and SamyQ-Bopep4-S15A, made 26 to 28 September, put the tag upstream. So the Peptide Design sentence that every construct ordered after 16 August ends in a free G-G-H-N is false as a universal claim, and the Molecular Dynamics sentence about a decision to move the tag to the C terminus has the direction backwards. Both sentences need editing; the tag positions themselves are no longer an open question for Chars or Gabriel. Raw file reads: "NHis-Bopep4 |  |  | reverse | ATATATGAAGACATGAGGGGTCTCATGTCttaATTGTGTCCTCCCGGT"

title.zh: C 端標籤構築在 30 個姿勢中都達不到任何一個夾鉗接觸
title.en: The C-terminally tagged construct reaches none of the clamp contacts in 30 poses

statement.zh: 一個三十姿勢面板在八個構築上執行，每個受體共用一組野生型衍生的限制，取樣提高到 100/30/30，分群回到 5.0 Å，所有工程附加部分不加限制。結果是類別性的：除了 C 端加標籤的那一個以外，每個構築都達到四個晶體學夾鉗接觸中的至少三個；加標籤的那一個在三十個姿勢中一個都沒達到，Asn23 距離它的四個配對 47 至 57 Å。面板自己的陰性對照顯示這個測試有多寬鬆：已知的非結合者 15-23 也達到四個中的三個。
statement.en: A thirty-pose panel was run on the eight constructs with one shared wild-type-derived restraint set per receptor, sampling raised to 100/30/30, clustering restored to 5.0 A and every engineering addition left unrestrained. Every construct reaches at least three of the four crystallographic clamp contacts except the C-terminally tagged one, which reaches none of them in any of its thirty poses, with Asn23 sitting 47 to 57 A from all four partners. The panel's own negative control shows how permissive the test was: the documented non-binder 15-23 also reaches three of four.

wiki.quote: which reaches none of them, in none of its thirty poses, with Asn23 sitting 47 to 57 Å

title.zh: 加標籤構築分數 −155.7，優於未加標籤的野生型 −125.9
title.en: The tagged construct scores -155.7, better than untagged wild type at -125.9

statement.zh: 已在製造中的構築埋藏 2,261 Å² 並得分 −155.7，優於未加標籤的野生型 BoPep4 的 −125.9，同時一個承載功能的四個接觸都沒有形成。重現性檢核把三個構築各重跑兩個額外隨機 seed：三個 seed 的夾鉗完整度完全相同，包括那個失敗構築每次都是 0 of 4；而對接分數移動了 13 到 36 個單位。在其中一個 seed 上，加標籤構築得分 −181.9，是整個研究中最好的分數，也優於晶體學陽性對照，卻仍然一個接觸都沒有。
statement.en: The construct already in flight buries 2,261 A2 and scores -155.7, better than untagged wild-type BoPep4 at -125.9, while making none of the four contacts that carry function. A reproducibility check re-ran three constructs at two further random seeds: clamp integrity was identical across all three seeds for all three constructs, including the failure which repeated at 0 of 4 every time, while the docking score moved by 13 to 36 units. At one seed the tagged construct scored -181.9, the best score in the entire study and better than the crystallographic positive control, while still making none of the four contacts.

status_note.zh:
頁面結論：此專案曾回報過的每一個分數差異都小於這個 seed 展幅。
〔10/14 乾實驗封存核對〕頁面引用的 −181.9 對上了：scores_repC.csv 的 BoPep4_WT_Chis_PEPR1_s2（seed 4242）為 −181.927，而同一組的晶體正對照 AtPep1_WT_PEPR1 是 −180.749，所以「全研究最佳分數、而且勝過晶體正對照」成立。另外兩個數字沒有在封存的分數表裡出現：面板 seed 917 的 BoPep4_WT_Chis_PEPR1 是 −173.1、未帶標籤的 BoPep4_WT_PEPR1 是 −144.8，不是頁面寫的 −155.7 與 −125.9。那兩個值可能來自 30 姿態面板的彙總（analyze_panel_v1.py.bak 顯示這個分析改寫過），需要有人提供那份彙總表。
status_note.en:
The page concludes that every score difference the project had ever reported is smaller than that seed spread.
[14 Oct dry lab archive check] The -181.9 the page quotes checks out: BoPep4_WT_Chis_PEPR1_s2 at seed 4242 in scores_repC.csv is -181.927, and the crystallographic positive control in the same set, AtPep1_WT_PEPR1, is -180.749, so the best score in the study and better than the positive control both hold. The other two numbers are not in the archived score tables: at the panel seed 917 BoPep4_WT_Chis_PEPR1 is -173.1 and untagged BoPep4_WT_PEPR1 is -144.8, not the page's -155.7 and -125.9. Those may come from a 30-pose panel summary, since analyze_panel_v1.py.bak shows this analysis was rewritten; someone has to supply that summary table.

title.zh: 兩端的自由空間不對稱：N 端 111 格、C 端加共受體後 2 格
title.en: Terminus asymmetry: 111 free grid points at the N-terminus, 2 at the C-terminus with BAK1

statement.zh: 以 2.4 Å 主鏈淨空探針在受體結構上做 flood fill：N 端在 PEPR1 單獨與 PEPR1 + BAK1 下都是 111 個自由格點、6.5 Å 到體相溶劑、約 1.9 個殘基。C 端在 PEPR1 單獨下是 45 個格點、10.4 Å、3.0 個殘基；加上 BAK1 後掉到 2 個格點、20.9 Å、6.2 個殘基，也就是逃逸路徑比必須穿過它的六殘基標籤還長。共受體位置來自以 SERK 家族模板與 AlphaFold3 建的三元模型，因為 PEPR1-BAK1 沒有晶體結構。
statement.en: A flood fill over the receptor structure with a 2.4 A backbone-clearance probe gives the N-terminus 111 free grid points, a 6.5 A path to solvent and about 1.9 residues, identical with and without BAK1. The C-terminus has 45 points, 10.4 A and 3.0 residues with PEPR1 alone, falling to 2 points, 20.9 A and 6.2 residues with BAK1, so the escape path becomes longer than the six-residue tag that has to fit through it. The co-receptor position comes from a ternary model built on SERK-family templates and AlphaFold3, because no PEPR1-BAK1 crystal exists.

status_note.zh: 〔10/14 乾實驗封存核對〕距離與殘基數都對，但數量的名稱錯了。exit_channel.json 與 exit_channel_ternary.json 記的是：N 端 reach 6.5 Å、1.9 個殘基、n_seeds 111、free_points_explored 694；C 端單獨 PEPR1 為 10.4 Å、3.0 殘基、n_seeds 45、1,136 點；加上 BAK1 後為 20.9 Å、6.2 殘基、**n_seeds 2**、1,055 點。也就是頁面寫的「111 個與 2 個 free grid points」其實是 seed 數，不是自由格點數（自由格點是 694 與 1,055）。探針 2.4 Å、格距 1.0 Å 與頁面一致。需要改寫那一句的名稱。
status_note.en: [14 Oct dry lab archive check] The distances and residue counts are right but the quantity is misnamed. exit_channel.json and exit_channel_ternary.json record the N terminus at reach 6.5 A, 1.9 residues, n_seeds 111 and free_points_explored 694; the C terminus with PEPR1 alone at 10.4 A, 3.0 residues, n_seeds 45 and 1,136 points; and with BAK1 at 20.9 A, 6.2 residues, **n_seeds 2** and 1,055 points. So the page's 111 and 2 'free grid points' are seed counts, not free grid points, which are 694 and 1,055. The 2.4 A probe and 1.0 A grid match the page. That sentence needs renaming.

title.zh: 文獻已做過這個實驗：三個帶天然 C 端延伸的 AtPep
title.en: The literature has already run the experiment on three AtPeps

statement.zh: AtPep2、AtPep4 與 AtPep5 都帶有超過保守天冬醯胺的天然 C 端延伸。三者中有兩個完全無法結合 PEPR1，第三個能結合但無法招募共受體，而截除延伸可在三者中都恢復活性。這是七個加標籤 cassette 所面對的基礎機率。
statement.en: AtPep2, AtPep4 and AtPep5 all carry natural C-terminal extensions past the conserved asparagine. Two of the three fail to bind PEPR1 at all, the third binds and cannot recruit the co-receptor, and truncating the extension restores activity in all three. That is the base rate the seven tagged cassettes were drawing from.

title.zh: 對接與 Pearce 實測活性的 Spearman ρ = +0.05
title.en: Docking against Pearce's measured activities gives Spearman rho +0.05

statement.zh: Pearce 2008 在 9-23 骨架上量過一組丙胺酸類似物的半飽和活性，其中十六個落在同一個 9-23 骨架上，所以長度與埋藏面積基本固定，取代是唯一的大變數。十六個全部對接後與實測活性的 Spearman ρ 為 +0.05，p > 0.8。Pearce 量到災難性的三個類似物在十六個中排第 7、8、9 名。G17A 比對接排名前六的任何類似物都低 1,600 倍以上活性，卻被評為比它們全部都好的結合者。原始報告引用的 +0.237 把野生型參考點納入了自己的相關計算，移除該自我參照點後為 +0.05。
statement.en: Pearce 2008 measured half-maximal activity for an alanine scan on the 9-23 scaffold, and sixteen of those analogues sit on that same scaffold, so length and buried surface are essentially constant and the substitution is the only large variable. Docking all sixteen against measured activity gives Spearman rho +0.05 with p > 0.8. The three analogues Pearce measured as catastrophic rank 7th, 8th and 9th out of sixteen. G17A, more than 1,600-fold less active than any analogue the docking ranked in its top six, scores as a better binder than all of them. The source report's quoted +0.237 included the wild-type reference point in its own correlation; removing it gives +0.05.

status_note.zh: 〔10/14 乾實驗封存核對〕稽核報告本文就是來源，字面寫 ρ ≈ +0.05（p > 0.05）、涵蓋 16 個等長類似物，並說明「移除那個完全一致的極端點後，ρ 由 +0.237 降到 +0.05」，與頁面的說法一致。我用封存的 15 列 alanine scan 自行重算，得到 PEPR1 ρ = −0.15、PEPR2 ρ = −0.04：同樣是「與零無法區分」的結論，但不是同一組數字，所以引用時寫「與零無法區分」比寫 +0.05 安全。
status_note.en: [14 Oct dry lab archive check] The audit report itself is the source: it states rho approx +0.05 (p > 0.05) over the 16 equal-length analogues and explains that removing the one perfectly concordant extreme point drops rho from +0.237 to +0.05, which is what the page says. Recomputing independently on the 15 archived alanine-scan rows gives rho = -0.15 for PEPR1 and -0.04 for PEPR2: the same conclusion, indistinguishable from zero, but not the same digits, so 'indistinguishable from zero' is the safer phrasing to quote.

title.zh: 改成每埋藏 Å² 的分數後，斷崖消失
title.en: Switch to score per buried A2 and the cliff disappears

statement.zh: 在十七個階上，對接分數與胜肽長度的相關係數 r = −0.96，與埋藏表面積 r = −0.98。把分數除以它埋藏的面積後，整個序列落在 −72 至 −87 之間，任何位置都沒有階梯，Arg9 也不例外。組裡最短的片段、一個文獻記載的非結合者，反而有全部階中最有利的每殘基分數。原本把斷崖報在 Arg9，是因為門檻設在 Arg9 所在的位置：分數約每殘基 −7.4，−160 的門檻等於十五個殘基的長度門檻，而十五個殘基就是 9-23。
statement.en: Across the seventeen rungs the docking score correlates with peptide length at r = -0.96 and with buried surface area at r = -0.98. Dividing the score by the area it buries puts the whole series between -72 and -87 with no step at any position, Arg9 included. The shortest fragment in the set, a documented non-binder, has the most favourable score per residue of any rung. The cliff was reported at Arg9 because the cut-off was set where Arg9 is: at about -7.4 per residue, a -160 cut-off is a length threshold at fifteen residues, and fifteen residues is 9-23.

status_note.zh: 〔10/14 乾實驗封存核對〕重算同一個矩陣：分數對長度的迴歸係數是每個殘基 −7.44（PEPR1），與頁面說的「約 −7.4 per residue」一致；17 段的 score/BSA 落在每 1,000 Å² −71.8 到 −86.0 之間，沒有任何位置出現階梯；最短的 17-23（已知非結合者）每殘基 −12.2，比全長的 −8.6 更「有利」。長度單獨就解釋 92.7% 的分數變異。
status_note.en: [14 Oct dry lab archive check] Recomputed on the same matrix: regressing score on length gives -7.44 per residue for PEPR1, matching the page's roughly -7.4 per residue; score divided by buried area for the 17 rungs lies between -71.8 and -86.0 per 1,000 A2 with no step at any position; and the shortest fragment 17-23, a documented non-binder, is the most favourable per residue at -12.2 against -8.6 for full length. Length alone explains 92.7% of the score variance.

wiki.quote: the docking score correlates with peptide length at r = −0.96 and with buried surface area at r = −0.98
The cliff was reported at Arg9 because the threshold was set where Arg9 is.

group.zh: 胜肽設計 · 構築與稽核

title.zh: 斷崖位置以 9 至 14 的範圍陳述，兩個方法相差五個殘基
title.en: The cliff is stated as a range of 9 to 14, the two methods five residues apart

statement.zh: 對接把斷崖放在 9-23，AlphaFold3 放在 14-23，相差五個殘基。「C 端約十五個殘基承載活性、N 端六到八個可捨棄」這個主張成立：AlphaFold3、本團隊的對接、Pearce 的刪除序列與 Cui 2024 都同意。但斷崖的精確位置不成立，站上以 9 到 14 的範圍陳述並列出兩個方法的答案，濕實驗的片段組也選成橫跨這個範圍。
statement.en: Docking places the cliff at 9-23 and AlphaFold3 at 14-23, five residues apart. The claim that the C-terminal fifteen or so residues carry the activity and the N-terminal six to eight are dispensable holds, with AlphaFold3, the team's docking, Pearce's deletion series and Cui 2024 all agreeing. The precise position does not hold, so the wiki states it as a range of 9 to 14 with both methods named, and the wet-lab fragment set spans that range.

status_note.zh: 〔10/14 乾實驗封存核對〕兩個方法的斷點就在矩陣裡：HADDOCK/verdict 在 10-23 從 binder 轉為 weak（9-23 仍是 binder），AF3 的 ipTM 在 14-23 從 0.87 掉到 0.54、PAE 跳到 8.85。兩者相差五個殘基，9 到 14 的區間敘述正確。
status_note.en: [14 Oct dry lab archive check] Both methods' cliffs are in the matrix: the HADDOCK verdict turns from binder to weak at 10-23 with 9-23 still a binder, while AF3's ipTM falls from 0.87 to 0.54 at 14-23 with the PAE jumping to 8.85. That is five residues apart, so stating it as a 9 to 14 range is right.

wiki.quote: Our docking places it at 9-23 and AlphaFold3 places it at 14-23, five residues apart.

group.zh: 胜肽設計 · 構築與稽核

title.zh: 方法稽核撤回五項主張，其中一項在 DNA 出貨後
title.en: The audit retracted five claims, one after the DNA had shipped

statement.zh: 稽核把十四項主張分為成立 4 項、附條件 3 項、撤回 5 項、未決 2 項。撤回的五項是：K18R 是優於野生型的親和力候選、K8Q 是對受體中性的分泌把手、K8Q+K18R 在 PEPR1 上崩潰、對接獨立確認 AlphaFold3 的姿勢、對接重現 Pearce 2008 的活性趨勢。K18R 已經進入一筆 DNA 訂單，在預定出貨的當天早上（2026 年 8 月 16 日）被抽掉。
statement.en: The audit sorts fourteen claims into 4 that hold, 3 qualified, 5 retracted and 2 open. The five retracted are: K18R is an affinity lead over wild type; K8Q is a receptor-neutral secretion handle; K8Q+K18R collapses on PEPR1; docking independently confirms the AlphaFold3 poses; and our docking reproduces the Pearce 2008 activity trend. K18R had already gone into a DNA order and was pulled out of it on the morning of 16 August 2026, the day it was due to ship.

wiki.quote: Five were withdrawn. The one that hurt was K18R, which had already gone into a DNA order
Removed from the order the morning it was due to ship.

group.zh: 胜肽設計 · 構築與稽核

title.zh: K18R 被撤回兩次，理由不同
title.en: K18R was withdrawn twice, for different reasons

statement.zh: K18R 在 2026 年 7 月 30 日以「分數排名主張」被撤回，2026 年 8 月 16 日第二次撤回：BoPep4 自己的 Lys18 已經做出 Tang 指派給 AtPep1 Arg18 的兩個接觸，距離 2.62 與 4.17 Å，對晶體的 2.50 與 4.09 Å。在四個構築中的三個，它比重新對接的精胺酸更接近芳香環。離胺酸胺基在芳香環上方是陽離子-π 接觸。這個取代原本要補的缺口在團隊自己的模型裡看不到。
statement.en: K18R was withdrawn on 30 July 2026 as a score-ranking claim and withdrawn a second time on 16 August 2026: BoPep4's own Lys18 already makes both contacts Tang assigns to AtPep1's Arg18, at 2.62 and 4.17 A against the crystal's 2.50 and 4.09 A, and in three of four constructs it approaches the aromatic ring more closely than a re-docked arginine does. A lysine amine over an aromatic ring is a cation-pi contact. The gap the substitution existed to close was not visible in the team's own models.

status_note.zh: 分子動力學頁的立場不同：它說 K18R 仍是可行的設計假設，只是不應被描述成「恢復一個已經大致形成的接觸」。Peptide Design 則把整個點突變軸退役。
status_note.en: The Molecular Dynamics page takes a different position, saying K18R remains a plausible design hypothesis that should merely not be described as restoring an already-formed contact, while Peptide Design retires the entire point-mutation axis.

wiki.quote: Withdrawn 2026-07-30 as a score-ranking claim, then withdrawn a second time on 2026-08-16
This does not rule out K18R as a viable design.

group.zh: 胜肽設計 · 構築與稽核

title.zh: 稽核發現後續五個 campaign 的限制取自被測試的姿勢本身
title.en: The five later campaigns derived their restraints from the pose being tested

statement.zh: 稽核對照表：創始 campaign 8 次 run 的限制取自 5GR8 晶體界面、胜肽起始座標穿線在晶體主鏈上、剛體取樣 800、以 5.0 Å RMSD 分群、分析單位是帶大小與展幅的 cluster、有 AtPep1 重新對接 0.77 Å 的陽性對照。後續五個 campaign 的 113 次 run 則是限制取自被測試的姿勢本身、起始座標就是該結合姿勢、剛體取樣 40、以 FCC 0.60 分群、分析單位是單一最高分結構、沒有陽性對照。以該方式建的 run 無法拒絕自己的輸入，而下游報告把它描述成「基於物理的獨立確認」，它不是。
statement.en: The audit comparison: the founding campaign's 8 runs derived restraints from the 5GR8 crystal interface, threaded the peptide on the crystal backbone, sampled 800 rigid-body models, clustered at 5.0 A RMSD, analysed clusters with a size and a spread, and had AtPep1 re-docked at 0.77 A as a positive control. The five later campaigns' 113 runs derived restraints from the pose being tested, started from that bound pose, sampled 40 rigid-body models, clustered with FCC at 0.60, analysed one top-scoring structure, and had no positive control. A run built that way cannot reject its own input, yet it was described downstream as independent physics-based confirmation.

status_note.zh: 〔10/14 乾實驗封存核對〕對上稽核報告：創始 campaign 的 8 次 run 由 5GR8 晶體介面導出限制條件並以 0.77 Å 的 AtPep1 再對接作為正對照；之後的 campaign 共 113 次 run（8 + 113 = 121，稽核寫「113 of the 121 runs」）改成從被測的結合姿態出發、取樣 40 個剛體模型、FCC 0.60 分群、只報告一個最高分結構、沒有正對照。
status_note.en: [14 Oct dry lab archive check] Matches the audit: the founding campaign's 8 runs derived restraints from the 5GR8 crystal interface and had AtPep1 re-docked at 0.77 A as a positive control, while the later campaigns' 113 runs (8 + 113 = 121, and the audit says '113 of the 121 runs') start from the pose being tested, sample 40 rigid-body models, cluster with FCC at 0.60, report one top-scoring structure and have no positive control.

wiki.quote: A run built that way cannot reject its own input.

group.zh: 胜肽設計 · 構築與稽核

title.zh: 對接紀錄：121 次生產 run、44 次共摺疊工作
title.en: Docking record: 121 production runs and 44 co-folding jobs

statement.zh: 重現性表：對接為 HADDOCK 2.5（發行版 haddock2.5-2026-07）在本機執行，七個 campaign 共 121 次生產 run。能量引擎為 CNS 1.3（HADDOCK patch 版，為 arm64 Darwin 從原始碼重建），OPLS 非鍵參數，最終精修用 TIP3P 顯式水。限制為 ambiguous interaction restraints，全程 2.0 2.0 0.0，開啟交叉驗證（noecv，兩個分割）。共摺疊為 AlphaFold3，每個工作 5 個 seed，共 44 個工作，門檻在執行前訂定：ipTM ≥ 0.60、界面最小 PAE ≤ 5 Å、零碰撞。RNA 摺疊為 ViennaRNA 2.7.2，37 °C 分配函數，236 nt 視窗。結構處理用 PyMOL 2.x 與 Biopython。
statement.en: The reproducibility table: docking is HADDOCK 2.5 (distribution haddock2.5-2026-07) run locally, 121 production runs across seven campaigns. The energy engine is CNS 1.3, HADDOCK-patched and rebuilt from source for arm64 Darwin, with OPLS non-bonded parameters and TIP3P explicit water in final refinement. Restraints are ambiguous interaction restraints at 2.0 2.0 0.0 throughout with cross-validation on (noecv, two partitions). Co-folding is AlphaFold3 with 5 seeds per job across 44 jobs, gated before running at ipTM >= 0.60, interface minimum PAE <= 5 A and zero clashes. RNA folding is ViennaRNA 2.7.2, partition function at 37 C over a 236 nt window. Structure handling uses PyMOL 2.x and Biopython.

status_note.zh:
「七個 campaign」與稽核表的「創始 campaign + 後續五個」（共六個）不一致，雖然 8 + 113 = 121 相符。
〔10/14 乾實驗封存核對〕逐項對上稽核報告：HADDOCK 2.5（haddock2.5-2026-07）、本機執行、七個 campaign 共 121 次 production run、AlphaFold3 每個 job 5 個 seed 共 44 個 job、門檻 ipTM ≥ 0.60、介面最小 PAE ≤ 5 Å、零碰撞；ViennaRNA 2.7.2、37 °C、236 nt 窗口也與密碼子封存的 REPORT.md 相符。CNS 1.3 的來源在 Haddock/cns_v1.3_r9。
status_note.en:
Seven campaigns disagrees with the audit table's founding campaign plus five later ones, which is six, although 8 + 113 = 121 does add up.
[14 Oct dry lab archive check] Item by item against the audit: HADDOCK 2.5 (haddock2.5-2026-07), run locally, 121 production runs across seven campaigns, AlphaFold3 with 5 seeds per job across 44 jobs, gated at ipTM >= 0.60, interface minimum PAE <= 5 A and zero clashes. ViennaRNA 2.7.2 at 37 C over a 236 nt window also matches REPORT.md in the codon archive. CNS 1.3 is present as Haddock/cns_v1.3_r9.

title.zh: 六個 cassette 於 2026-08-20 送合成
title.en: Six cassettes went to synthesis on 2026-08-20

statement.zh: 訂單於 2026 年 8 月 20 日下訂。D-01 BoPep4_9-23_NHis，691 bp，SamyQ31 + HHHHHH + RPREPHSSGKPGGHN，切位 +1 殘基 H，活性候選。D-02 BoPep4_G17A_1-23_NHis，715 bp，失能對照（Pearce 量得 G17A 低於野生型四千倍以上），+1 為 H。D-03 BoPep4_WT_1-23_NHis，715 bp，全長陽性參考，+1 為 H。D-04 BoPep4_9-23_native，673 bp，同一候選但無標籤，+1 為 R，是本批中最不利的切位脈絡。D-05 BoPep4_WT_1-23_native，697 bp，就是天然分子，+1 為 G，是 +1 問題的內部對照。D-06 BoPep4_S15A_1-23_NHis，715 bp，分級對照中間階（Pearce 量得 S15A 約低一百倍），+1 為 H。沒有插入 spacer，所以每個加標籤構築都有一個未加標籤的雙胞胎，標籤比較是單變數的。
statement.en: The order was placed on 20 August 2026. D-01 BoPep4_9-23_NHis, 691 bp, SamyQ31 plus HHHHHH plus RPREPHSSGKPGGHN, cleavage +1 residue H, the activity lead. D-02 BoPep4_G17A_1-23_NHis, 715 bp, dead control (Pearce measured G17A at more than four thousandfold down), +1 H. D-03 BoPep4_WT_1-23_NHis, 715 bp, full-length positive reference, +1 H. D-04 BoPep4_9-23_native, 673 bp, the same lead with no tag, +1 R, the least favourable cleavage context in the batch. D-05 BoPep4_WT_1-23_native, 697 bp, exactly the natural molecule, +1 G, the internal control for the +1 question. D-06 BoPep4_S15A_1-23_NHis, 715 bp, the graded control middle rung (Pearce measured S15A at about a hundredfold down), +1 H. No spacer was inserted, so each tagged construct has an untagged twin and the tag comparison is single-variable.

status_note.zh: 〔10/14 乾實驗封存核對〕六個 cassette 逐一對上 8/23 的零件清單：D-01 BoPep4_9-23_NHis 691 bp、D-02 BoPep4_G17A_1-23_NHis 715、D-03 BoPep4_WT_1-23_NHis 715、D-04 BoPep4_9-23_native 673、D-05 BoPep4_WT_1-23_native 697、D-06 BoPep4_S15A_1-23_NHis 715，長度由各段相加得出（395 + 93 + 18 + payload + 3 + 137）。六條共用同一段 PcpcG2-veg + B0015 + MF001 上游與 B0015 下游，His 標籤在 N 端，且沒有插入 spacer，所以帶標籤與不帶標籤確實是單一變數的配對。
status_note.en: [14 Oct dry lab archive check] All six cassettes reproduce from the 23 August parts list: D-01 BoPep4_9-23_NHis at 691 bp, D-02 BoPep4_G17A_1-23_NHis at 715, D-03 BoPep4_WT_1-23_NHis at 715, D-04 BoPep4_9-23_native at 673, D-05 BoPep4_WT_1-23_native at 697 and D-06 BoPep4_S15A_1-23_NHis at 715, with the lengths summing from the parts (395 + 93 + 18 + payload + 3 + 137). All six share the same PcpcG2-veg + B0015 + MF001 upstream and B0015 downstream, the His tag is N-terminal, and no spacer was inserted, so the tagged and untagged pairs really are single-variable.

wiki.quote: D-01BoPep4_9-23_NHis691 bp
The order placed on 20 August is the design endpoint.

title.zh: D-01、D-06、D-02 覆蓋四個數量級的預期效應
title.en: D-01, D-06 and D-02 span four orders of magnitude of expected effect

statement.zh: D-01、D-06 與 D-02 是這批訂單的重點：同一骨架上的野生型、S15A 與 G17A，依 Pearce 的量測分別約 1 倍、約 100 倍與超過 4,000 倍下降，共四個數量級的預期效應。拿掉 D-06 這組就塌成一個二元開關，能證明胜肽有作用但無法證明平台能排序變體。
statement.en: D-01, D-06 and D-02 are the point of the order: wild type, S15A and G17A on one backbone, at about 1x, about 100x and more than 4,000x down in Pearce's measurements, four orders of magnitude of expected effect. Drop D-06 and the set collapses into a binary switch that can show the peptide works but cannot show the platform ranks variants.

wiki.quote: four orders of magnitude of expected effect

group.zh: 胜肽設計 · 構築與稽核

title.zh: 殘餘風險在切位 +1 殘基
title.en: The residual risk sits at the cleavage +1 residue

statement.zh: 訊號肽酶 I 偏好切口後緊接小殘基。六個構築中有四個在該位置呈現組胺酸，D-04 呈現精胺酸後接脯胺酸，只有 D-05 呈現理想的甘胺酸。D-05 因此是內部對照：如果它分泌而加標籤的不分泌，+1 殘基就是原因，胜肽本身無罪。冷凍庫裡已有更便宜的答案，因為序列確認過的 AmilCP 構築使用同一個訊號肽且是發色蛋白，其分泌可從上清液以肉眼判讀。
statement.en: Signal peptidase I prefers small residues immediately after the cut. Four of the six constructs present a histidine there, D-04 presents an arginine followed by a proline, and only D-05 presents the ideal glycine. D-05 is therefore the internal control: if it secretes and the tagged constructs do not, the +1 residue is the cause and the peptide is exonerated. A cheaper answer already exists in the freezer, since the sequence-verified AmilCP construct uses the same signal peptide and is a chromoprotein whose secretion can be read by eye off the supernatant.

wiki.quote: only D-05 presents the ideal glycine

group.zh: 胜肽設計 · 構築與稽核

title.zh: 密碼子優化：BoPep4 的瓶頸從 0.067 升到 0.528
title.en: Codon optimisation raised the BoPep4 bottleneck from 0.067 to 0.528

statement.zh: 目標是從 ViennaRNA 鹼基對矩陣在 37 °C 算出的兩個區域的未配對機率：起始密碼子起算的十五個鹼基，以及 Shine-Dalgarno 核心。參考基因是在此底盤中可運作的 ho1，值為 0.681。第一版最佳化器對每個貨物以這兩個分數之和排序約 50,000 個同義抽樣，回傳的設計起始可及性 0.911、Shine-Dalgarno 核心 0.050，比它取代的野生型序列更被遮蔽。排序改為瓶頸 J = min(start+15, SD core)，隨機抽樣改為對實際與起始區配對的密碼子做確定性下降。BoPep4 的瓶頸因此從 0.067 升到 0.528，密碼子適應指數 0.78。只針對密碼子使用最佳化會得到適應指數 0.87 至 0.89 而瓶頸約 0.054，也就是核糖體結合位基本完全被遮蔽。
statement.en: The objective is the unpaired probability of two regions from the ViennaRNA base-pair matrix at 37 C: the fifteen bases from the start codon, and the Shine-Dalgarno core. The reference is ho1, a gene that works in this chassis, at 0.681. The first optimiser ranked roughly 50,000 synonymous draws per payload by the sum of those two scores and returned a design with start accessibility 0.911 and a Shine-Dalgarno core of 0.050, more occluded than the wild type it replaced. Ranking moved to the bottleneck J = min(start+15, SD core) and the random draw was replaced with a deterministic descent. On BoPep4 the bottleneck went from 0.067 to 0.528 at a codon adaptation index of 0.78. Optimising for codon usage alone gives an adaptation index of 0.87 to 0.89 and a bottleneck near 0.054, with the ribosome binding site essentially fully occluded.

status_note.zh: 〔10/14 乾實驗封存核對〕整條敘述都對上了原始檔。ho1 參考 0.6809；野生型 J = 0.0666（start+15 0.3957、SD core 0.0666）；v2 最佳 J = 0.5280，start+15 0.7569，CAI 0.7786；第一版最佳化器「start+15 0.911、SD core 0.050」就是 round 2 BoPep4 的第 1 名變體；「只優化密碼子使用」對應 max-CAI 起始序列 CAI 0.879、J 0.0543（野生型 CAI 0.886）。唯一沒對上的是「約 50,000 次同義抽樣」：檔案裡的合法候選數是 33,395 到 40,899，sharp 最佳化器則是確定性下降、v2 共摺疊 4,437 個結構並認證為局部最佳。
status_note.en: [14 Oct dry lab archive check] Every number in this statement reproduces from the archive. ho1 reference 0.6809; wild type J = 0.0666 (start+15 0.3957, SD core 0.0666); the v2 best J = 0.5280 at start+15 0.7569 and CAI 0.7786; the first optimiser's start accessibility 0.911 with an SD core of 0.050 is round 2's top-ranked BoPep4 variant; and optimising codon usage alone is the max-CAI base sequence at CAI 0.879 with J = 0.0543 (wild type CAI 0.886). The one clause that does not reproduce is the roughly 50,000 synonymous draws: the archived legal-candidate counts are 33,395 to 40,899, and the sharp optimiser is a deterministic descent that folded 4,437 structures for v2 and certified a local optimum.

title.zh: SamyQ 訊號肽：n 區電荷 +4、疏水核心均值 1.65
title.en: SamyQ signal peptide: n-region charge +4, hydrophobic core mean 1.65

statement.zh: 一組 B. subtilis Sec 訊號肽依已知決定因子排序：n 區電荷、h 區疏水性與長度、−3/−1 切割規則，序列取自已驗證的 UniProt 條目。SamyQ 這個已在 cassette 中的訊號肽落在有利區，n 區電荷 +4、疏水核心均值 1.65、乾淨的 A-X-A 切位。AprE 是最接近的替代方案，AmyE 最弱。篩選只決定把哪三個放進濕實驗面板，不取代濕實驗。
statement.en: A panel of B. subtilis Sec signal peptides was ranked on n-region charge, h-region hydrophobicity and length, and the -3/-1 cleavage rule, from verified UniProt sequences. SamyQ, the signal peptide already in the cassette, lands in the favourable zone with an n-region charge of +4, a hydrophobic core mean of 1.65 and a clean A-X-A cleavage site. AprE is the best-matched alternative and AmyE the weakest. The screen chose which three to put in a wet-lab panel and does not replace one.

status_note.zh: 〔10/14 乾實驗封存核對〕訊號肽篩選的輸出檔（l1_sp_results.json）不在這份專案封存裡，它留在已不存在的運算工作區（~/software/haddock-runs/...），所以 n 區電荷 +4 與疏水核心 1.65 無法核對。封存裡有的是設計簡報：AprE 屬於 B. subtilis 最強的分泌訊號肽之一、AmyE 是標準高分泌對照，與頁面的排序方向一致；AprE 換肽版本也真的跑過 sharp 最佳化（J = 0.715）。14 Oct 已搜尋兩個專案資料夾，不必重搜。
status_note.en: [14 Oct dry lab archive check] The signal-peptide screen output (l1_sp_results.json) is not in this archive; it stayed in the compute workspace (~/software/haddock-runs/...) which no longer exists on this machine, so the n-region charge of +4 and the hydrophobic core mean of 1.65 cannot be checked. What the archive does hold is the design brief, where AprE is among the strongest B. subtilis secretion signal peptides and AmyE is the canonical high-secretion benchmark, consistent with the ordering on the page, and the AprE swap was genuinely run through the sharp optimiser (J = 0.715). Both project folders were searched on 14 October; there is no need to search again.

wiki.quote: an n-region charge of +4, a hydrophobic core mean of 1.65 and a clean A-X-A cleavage site
