title.zh: 野生型序列有一段七個腺嘌呤，違反製造規則
title.en: The wild-type sequence has a run of seven adenines

statement.zh: 野生型序列另外直接違反一條製造規則，帶有一段七個連續的腺嘌呤。已發表的低 GC 啟發式作為文獻對照執行時，使其中一個貨物比它自己的野生型更差。
statement.en: The wild-type sequence separately fails a manufacturing rule outright, with a run of seven adenines. The published low-GC heuristic run as a literature control made one payload worse than its own wild type.

status_note.zh: 〔10/14 乾實驗封存核對〕原始序列是八個連續腺嘌呤，不是七個。野生型成熟 BoPep4 CDS（69 nt）第 18 到 25 個核苷酸為 GGATC-AAAAAAAA-GACC；最佳化器自己的限制是同聚物最多 4。頁面上的「七個」需要改成八個。第二句話成立：已發表的低 GC/A>U 貪婪啟發式作為文獻對照跑時，讓 LEA14 比它自己的野生型更差（SD core 0.357 → 0.078，balance 0.895 → 0.747）。
status_note.en: [14 Oct dry lab archive check] The run is eight adenines, not seven. Nucleotides 18 to 25 of the 69 nt wild-type mature BoPep4 CDS read GGATC-AAAAAAAA-GACC, and the optimiser's own constraint is a homopolymer maximum of 4. The seven on the page has to become eight. The second clause stands: run as a literature control, the published low-GC/A>U greedy heuristic made LEA14 worse than its own wild type, SD core 0.357 to 0.078 and balance 0.895 to 0.747.

source.label: greedy control on LEA14
source.where: LEA14 block, WT and GR rows

wiki.quote: The wild-type sequence separately fails a manufacturing rule outright, with a run of seven adenines.

group.zh: 胜肽設計 · 構築與稽核

title.zh: 五項預測於 2026-08-16 寫下
title.en: Five predictions recorded on 2026-08-16

statement.zh: 五項預測在任何構築到貨前寫下：E1 N 端加標籤與未加標籤的構築在 C 端加標籤者毫無活性的濃度下顯示活性；E2 D-01 與 D-04 彼此無法區分；E3 BoPep4 需要比 AtPep1 更高的劑量才能得到同樣反應，因為 Gly21 填不滿 AtPep1 的 Gln21 所佔的共受體空腔，已發表的 AtPep1 測定在 1 至 100 nM，所以 BoPep4 系列至少要到 1 µM；E4 活性對 pH 敏感，在 pH 6.0 附近強、pH 4.0 近乎消失，因為 Arg487 的質子化狀態掌管夾鉗；E5 15-23 片段無活性。
statement.en: Five predictions were recorded before any construct arrived: E1, the N-tagged and untagged constructs show activity at concentrations where the C-terminally tagged ones show none; E2, D-01 and D-04 are indistinguishable; E3, BoPep4 needs a higher dose than AtPep1 for the same response because Gly21 cannot fill the co-receptor cavity AtPep1's Gln21 occupies, so with published AtPep1 assays working at 1 to 100 nM the BoPep4 series has to reach at least 1 microMolar; E4, activity is pH-sensitive, strong near pH 6.0 and nearly abolished at pH 4.0, because Arg487's protonation governs the clamp; E5, the 15-23 fragment is inactive.

wiki.quote: These were recorded on 16 August, before any construct had arrived

group.zh: 胜肽設計 · 構築與稽核

title.zh: 測定必須帶四個對照
title.en: The assay has to carry four controls

statement.zh: 測定必須帶四個對照才能被解讀：載體與空載體上清液（因為 B. subtilis 上清液含蛋白酶與 surfactin）、一個已知濃度的化學合成參考胜肽（這是唯一能把「胜肽沒作用」與「我們幾乎沒分泌出來」分開的東西）、同莫耳量的失活片段，以及在量活性之前先定量（每單位胜肽的活性才有意義，每毫升上清液的活性沒有）。
statement.en: The assay has to carry four controls or it cannot be interpreted: vehicle and empty-vector supernatant, because B. subtilis supernatant contains proteases and surfactin; a chemically synthesised reference peptide at a known concentration, the only thing that separates the peptide not working from almost none being secreted; the dead fragment at the same molar load; and quantification before activity, because activity per unit peptide is the number that means something.

wiki.quote: The assay also has to carry four controls or it cannot be interpreted

group.zh: 胜肽設計 · 構築與稽核

title.zh: 兩項未決主張：植株內活性與底盤分泌效價
title.en: Two open claims: activity in planta and secretion titre

statement.zh: 兩項主張仍然未決。胜肽在植株內有活性：沒有任何測定跑過，六個 cassette 於 2026 年 8 月 20 日下訂，合成參考胜肽同時下訂。底盤以可量測的效價分泌它：SamyQ 在團隊手上只有一個序列確認過的先例，也就是 AmilCP 構築，而它還沒有被讀出。頁面稱後者是仍未完成的最便宜實驗。
statement.en: Two claims remain open. The peptide is active in planta: no assay has run, the six cassettes were placed on 20 August 2026 and the synthetic peptide reference alongside them. And the chassis secretes it at a measurable titre: SamyQ has one sequence-verified precedent in the team's hands, the AmilCP construct, and it has not been read out. The page calls the latter the single cheapest experiment still outstanding.

wiki.quote: openThe chassis secretes it at a measurable titre
The single cheapest experiment still outstanding.

group.zh: 胜肽設計 · 構築與稽核

title.zh: 三套殘基編號慣例並存於原始資料
title.en: Three numbering conventions coexist in the source data

statement.zh: 原始資料中有三套編號慣例並存，跨研究比較只在同一套之內有效：成熟 1-23（截短與 Pearce 面板使用）、從一重編號（共摺疊截短工作使用）、構築局部編號（串聯研究使用）。Peptide Design 頁上的一切都用成熟編號。
statement.en: Three numbering conventions coexist in the source data and cross-study comparisons are only valid inside one of them: mature 1-23 as used by the truncation and Pearce panels, renumber-from-one as used by the co-folding truncation jobs, and construct-local numbering in the tandem study. Everything on the Peptide Design page is in mature numbering.

status_note.zh: 這可能就是位置 18 的受體配對殘基出現 Asp348 與 Asp320 兩種寫法的原因，但沒有任何一頁把兩者連起來。
status_note.en: This may be why the position-18 receptor partner appears as both Asp348 and Asp320, but no page connects the two.

wiki.quote: Three numbering conventions coexist in the source data

group.zh: 胜肽設計 · 構築與稽核

title.zh: 標準的重跑已預註冊，含通過標準
title.en: A pre-registered re-run is specified with its pass criterion

statement.zh: 剩下的計算項目是一次狹窄的預註冊重跑：十六個等長類似物只對 PEPR1，從未結合構形系集出發，使用晶體衍生的限制、完整取樣、三個 seed、以 cluster 平均計分。通過標準在開跑前就訂好：Spearman ρ 高於 +0.5 且 p < 0.05，並且 G17A、G17P、S15A 中至少兩個落在分數最差的四個類似物內。達不到就表示此協定沒有取代層級的解析度，所有剩下的分數差異主張都要撤掉。
statement.en: The remaining computational item is a narrow, pre-registered re-run: the sixteen equal-length analogues against PEPR1 only, from unbound conformer ensembles, with crystal-derived restraints, full sampling, three seeds and cluster-mean scoring. The pass criterion is committed before the runs start: Spearman rho above +0.5 at p < 0.05, with at least two of G17A, G17P and S15A in the four worst-scoring analogues. Anything less means the protocol has no substitution-level resolution and every remaining score-difference claim comes out.

wiki.quote: Spearman ρ above +0.5 at p < 0.05

group.zh: 胜肽設計 · 構築與稽核

title.zh: 最有資訊的已發表結果在管線之外
title.en: The most informative published result sits outside the pipeline

statement.zh: Pearce 顯示 Gly17 換 D-Ala 與 2-methyl-Ala 可恢復活性，而換 L-Pro 與 D-Pro 則消除活性，這證明該需求是主鏈構形自由度。D 型胺基酸與 Aib 無法用標準 CNS 拓撲表示，所以團隊面板中有三列被標為不可建模。
statement.en: Pearce showed that Gly17 to D-Ala and Gly17 to 2-methyl-Ala restore activity while L-Pro and D-Pro abolish it, which proves the requirement is backbone conformational freedom. D-amino acids and Aib are not representable in stock CNS topology, so three rows of the team's own panel are marked as not modellable.

wiki.quote: three rows of our own panel are marked as not modellable

group.zh: 胜肽設計 · 構築與稽核

title.zh: 標準的野生型姿勢是挑的，不是預測出來的
title.en: The canonical wild-type pose was chosen, not predicted

statement.zh: 對接自己的最高分 cluster 是一個非原生姿勢，偏差 5.80 Å。被帶往下游作為標準的複合物是四個 cluster 中的第三個，因為它與晶體相符而被選中。頁面明確陳述：標準野生型姿勢是同源引導的，不是盲目預測的。
statement.en: The docking's own top cluster is a non-native pose at 5.80 A. The complex carried forward as canonical is cluster three of four, chosen because it matches the crystal. The page states plainly that the canonical wild-type pose is homology-guided, not blindly predicted.

status_note.zh: 〔10/14 乾實驗封存核對〕對上稽核報告的 cluster landscape（野生型 BoPep4 production run，74 個分群模型）：cluster 1 有 39 個模型、分數 −134.8、對晶體姿態 l-RMSD 5.80 Å；被採用的是 cluster 3（7 個模型、−134.0、l-RMSD 1.48 Å），四個分群中的第三個。所有 60 個水精修模型的 l-RMSD 中位數是 9.08 Å。
status_note.en: [14 Oct dry lab archive check] Matches the audit's cluster landscape for the wild-type BoPep4 production run, 74 clustered models: cluster 1 has 39 models, a score of -134.8 and an l-RMSD of 5.80 A to the crystal pose, while the one carried forward is cluster 3 of 4, with 7 models, -134.0 and an l-RMSD of 1.48 A. The median l-RMSD across all 60 water-refined models is 9.08 A.

wiki.quote: the wild-type run's top-ranked cluster is a non-native pose at 5.80 Å

group.zh: 胜肽設計 · 構築與稽核

title.zh: AtPep1 重新對接的陽性對照為 0.77 Å
title.en: The AtPep1 re-docking positive control returns 0.77 A

statement.zh: 在信任 BoPep4 結果之前，同一協定先對 AtPep1 本身執行：它回傳晶體姿勢，配體 RMSD 0.77 Å，排名第一，與第一個非原生姿勢之間有 35 個單位的分數差距。
statement.en: Before trusting the BoPep4 result the same protocol was run on AtPep1 itself: it returned the crystal pose at 0.77 A ligand RMSD, top-ranked, with a 35-unit score gap to the first non-native pose.

status_note.zh: 〔10/14 乾實驗封存核對〕稽核報告兩處記下這個正對照：摘要寫「genuine re-docking positive control (l-RMSD 0.77 Å, top-ranked)」，表內兩次 run（control_atpep1_12w −164.3、control_atpep1_55w −163.5）都是 0.77 Å、判定 near-native。頁面另外說與第一個非原生姿態有 35 單位的分數差，這一項沒有在封存裡核對。
status_note.en: [14 Oct dry lab archive check] The audit records this control twice: the summary says a genuine re-docking positive control at l-RMSD 0.77 A, top-ranked, and the table carries two runs, control_atpep1_12w at -164.3 and control_atpep1_55w at -163.5, both 0.77 A and graded near-native. The page's 35-unit score gap to the first non-native pose was not checked in the archive.

wiki.quote: it returned the crystal pose at 0.77 Å ligand RMSD, top-ranked, with a 35-unit score gap

group.zh: 胜肽設計 · 構築與稽核

title.zh: 三個已發表結果承載設計
title.en: Three published results carry the design

statement.zh: 設計錨定在三個外部實驗上。PDB 5GR8，PEPR1-AtPep1 共結晶，解析度 2.59 Å，提供結合模式、受體配對，以及 AtPep1 殘基 1 至 6 完全未被解析的事實。AtPep1 上的丙胺酸掃描與刪除序列（Pearce 2008）：Gly17 代價超過 4,000 倍、Ser15 約 100 倍、移除 C 端 Asn 約 400 倍，三個位置在 BoPep4 中都保守。放射配體結合（Yamaguchi 2010）：PEPR1 結合 AtPep1 至 AtPep6，PEPR2 只結合 AtPep1 與 AtPep2，所以 AtPep5 與 AtPep6 是任何宣稱能讀 PEPR2 辨識的方法必須拒絕的對照。
statement.en: The design is anchored to three external experiments. PDB 5GR8, the PEPR1-AtPep1 co-crystal at 2.59 A, supplies the pose, the receptor partners and the fact that AtPep1 residues 1-6 are not resolved at all. The alanine scan and deletion series on AtPep1 (Pearce 2008): Gly17 costs more than 4,000-fold, Ser15 about 100-fold and removing the C-terminal Asn about 400-fold, all three positions conserved in BoPep4. Radioligand binding (Yamaguchi 2010): PEPR1 binds AtPep1 to AtPep6 while PEPR2 binds only AtPep1 and AtPep2, making AtPep5 and AtPep6 the controls any method claiming to read PEPR2 recognition has to reject.

status_note.zh: 〔10/14 乾實驗封存核對〕三個外部結果都在封存裡對上：5GR8 作為對接受體（Pearce 的倍數記在 pearce_comparison.csv 的 note 欄：G17A「>4000-fold」、S15A「~100-fold」、移除 C 端 Asn23「>400-fold loss (Pearce Fig 3)」），Yamaguchi 的受體選擇性則是稽核報告 AF3 選擇性面板把 AtPep5/AtPep6 設為 DISCR/NONBIND 層級的依據。
status_note.en: [14 Oct dry lab archive check] All three external results reproduce in the archive: 5GR8 is the docking receptor, and Pearce's factors are in the note column of pearce_comparison.csv (G17A '>4000-fold', S15A '~100-fold', removing the C-terminal Asn23 '>400-fold loss (Pearce Fig 3)'), while Yamaguchi's receptor selectivity is what the audit's AF3 selectivity panel uses to place AtPep5 and AtPep6 in its discrimination and non-binder tiers.

wiki.quote: PDB 5GR8, the PEPR1-AtPep1 co-crystal at 2.59 Å

title.zh: 62 of 116 位攤位訪客填了問卷
title.en: 62 of the 116 booth visitors answered the survey

statement.zh: 活動結束時，走完全部六個攤位的訪客填一份問卷。造訪本隊攤位的 116 人中有 62 人作答。其中兩題與地圖本身有關，其餘涵蓋整場活動。
statement.en: At the end of the event visitors who had been to all six booths filled in one survey. 62 of the 116 people who visited the booth answered it. Two questions were about the map itself and the rest covered the whole event.

wiki.quote: 62 of the 116 people who visited our booth answered it.

title.zh: 51.6% 正確指出宜蘭為最高逆境區
title.en: 51.6% correctly identified Yilan as the highest-stress region

statement.zh: 62 位受訪者中有 32 位（51.6%）正確指出宜蘭縣是地圖上標示為最高逆境的區域。其餘回答分散在高雄（12 人，19.4%）、台中（11 人，17.7%）與台南（7 人，11.3%）。
statement.en: 32 of 62 respondents (51.6%) correctly identified Yilan County, the region represented as highest-stress. The remaining responses split across Kaohsiung (12, 19.4%), Taichung (11, 17.7%) and Tainan (7, 11.3%).

wiki.quote: 32 of 62 respondents (51.6%) correctly identified Yilan County

title.zh: 95.2% 認為地圖幫助理解氣候與產量的關係
title.en: 95.2% agreed the map helped them understand climate and yield

statement.zh: 62 位參與者中有 59 位（95.2%）同意或非常同意資料實體化地圖幫助他們理解氣候變遷與作物產量的關係，其中 36 位（58.1%）非常同意。只有 2 位中立、1 位不同意。
statement.en: 59 of 62 participants (95.2%) agreed or strongly agreed that the Data Physicalization Map helped them understand the relationship between climate change and crop yield, including 36 (58.1%) who strongly agreed. Only 2 were neutral and 1 disagreed.

wiki.quote: 59 of 62 participants (95.2%) agreed or strongly agreed

title.zh: 62.9% 表示現在「非常理解」氣候對作物的影響
title.en: 62.9% reported they now very much understood the impact

statement.zh: 62 位參與者中有 39 位（62.9%）表示現在「非常理解」氣候變遷對台灣咖啡與作物生產的影響，另有 21 位（33.9%）表示「部分理解」，2 位（3.2%）表示仍不太理解。
statement.en: 39 of 62 participants (62.9%) reported they now very much understood the impact of climate change on Taiwan's coffee and crop production, another 21 (33.9%) said they understood it partially, and 2 (3.2%) said they still did not understand it well.

wiki.quote: 39 of 62 participants (62.9%) reported they now

title.zh: 96.8% 願意分享所學
title.en: 96.8% said they were willing to share what they learned

statement.zh: 62 位參與者中有 60 位（96.8%）表示願意或非常願意把所學的作物保護與農業知識分享給親友。
statement.en: 60 of 62 participants (96.8%) said they were willing or very willing to share what they had learned about crop protection and agriculture with friends or family.

wiki.quote: 60 of 62 participants (96.8%) said they were willing

title.zh: 未來行動多選：79.0% 優先選擇在地或永續農產
title.en: Future actions, multi-select: 79.0% will prioritise local or sustainable produce

statement.zh: 參與者勾選的未來行動（可複選）：49 位（79.0%）優先選擇在地生產或永續耕作的農產品與咖啡；37 位（59.7%）追蹤並分享氣候與農業資訊；18 位（29.0%）參加更多科學推廣或環境活動。
statement.en: Participants indicated future actions on a multi-select: 49 (79.0%) prioritising locally produced or sustainably farmed agricultural products and coffee, 37 (59.7%) following and sharing climate-and-agriculture information, and 18 (29.0%) joining more science-outreach or environmental activities.

wiki.quote: 49 (79.0%) — prioritizing locally produced or sustainably farmed

title.zh: 下一次的設計目標是 80% 讀對地圖
title.en: The stated design target for next time is 80% reading the map correctly

statement.zh: 只有略過半數的訪客在一次短暫接觸中讀對地圖。下一次會在板子旁放一個圖例，標出三種閃爍速度各代表什麼，然後檢查是否超過 80% 的訪客選對區域。
statement.en: Just over half of visitors read the map correctly on a single brief encounter. Next time a legend will be placed beside the board showing three flash speeds and what each means, and the team will then check whether more than 80% of visitors pick the right region.

wiki.quote: We will then check whether more than 80% of visitors pick the right region

title.zh: 實體地圖：保麗龍底座、色紙表示產量、LED 表示逆境
title.en: The physical map: styrofoam base, coloured paper for yield, LEDs for stress

statement.zh: 實體地圖以保麗龍為底材，上面鋪不同顏色的紙表示作物產量的差異：深綠為高產量、棕色為最低產量、中間色為不同程度。LED 燈獨立用來表示植物逆境，閃爍頻率或數量隨逆境嚴重度增加。
statement.en: The physical map uses styrofoam as the base with different coloured papers on top for crop yield: dark green for high yield, brown for the lowest, and intermediate colours in between. LEDs are used independently for plant stress, with flashing frequency or amount increasing with severity.

wiki.quote: | Plant stress level | LED lights | More frequent flashing meant more severe stress

title.zh: 聲音展件使用 Khait 等人（2023）的公開錄音
title.en: The sound exhibit uses the open recordings from Khait et al. (2023)

statement.zh: 聲音實體化使用 Khait 等人（2023）的公開錄音，經 Dryad 以 CC0 釋出。原始錄音以超音波麥克風在 20 至 250 kHz 範圍、距每株植物約 10 公分處錄製，先在隔音室錄番茄與菸草三種狀態（未受擾、五天未澆水、新切），再在實際溫室中於一般背景噪音下重複，並以訓練過的分類器分辨受逆境與健康、乾旱與切割、番茄與菸草。這些聲音是超音波，團隊把音高降到人耳可聽範圍，並建網站播放；攤位上兩副耳機接在海報後面的筆電上。
statement.en: The sound physicalization uses the open recordings from Khait et al. (2023), released via Dryad under CC0. The original recordings were made with ultrasonic microphones across 20 to 250 kHz about 10 cm from each plant, first in a soundproofed chamber with tomato and tobacco recorded untouched, five days without water and freshly cut, then repeated in a working greenhouse amid ordinary background noise, with a trained classifier separating stressed from healthy, drought from cutting and tomato from tobacco. The clicks are ultrasonic, so the team shifted their pitch down into the audible range and built a website to play them, with two headphones at the booth connected to laptops behind the poster.

wiki.quote: Sounds emitted by plants under stress are airborne and informative

title.zh: 地圖使用兩個縣級資料集：稻作產量與熱逆境
title.en: The board uses two county-level datasets: rice yield and heat stress

statement.zh: 板子使用兩個縣級資料集：稻作產量與熱逆境。選熱逆境是因為它是 ReLEAF 要防護的逆境之一，選產量是因為它顯示該逆境對農民的代價。地圖與資料來源在 Geospatial Analysis 頁上。
statement.en: The board uses two county-level datasets, rice yield and heat stress. Heat was chosen because it is one of the stresses ReLEAF protects against and yield because it shows what that stress costs farmers. The maps and data sources behind the board are on the Geospatial Analysis page.

status_note.zh: 頁面沒有寫這兩個資料集的年份或版本，也沒有寫逆境分級的門檻。
status_note.en: The page does not state the vintage or version of either dataset, nor the thresholds behind the stress levels.

wiki.quote: The board uses two county-level datasets: rice yield and heat stress.

title.zh: 訪客預期台北逆境最高，實際是宜蘭與南投
title.en: Visitors expected Taipei to be highest; the board showed Yilan and Nantou

statement.zh: 攤位現場訪客對為什麼宜蘭與南投逆境最高感到好奇，許多人原本認為台北之類的地區逆境最大。團隊的解釋是南投與宜蘭的觀光影響其逆境程度。
statement.en: Visitors at the booth were curious why Yilan and Nantou had the highest stress, with many expecting regions such as Taipei instead. The team explained that tourism in Nantou and Yilan was affecting their stress level.

status_note.zh: 「觀光影響逆境程度」這個解釋在 Geospatial Analysis 或任何逆境資料集中都找不到支持。
status_note.en: The explanation that tourism affects the stress level is not supported anywhere in Geospatial Analysis or in any stress dataset on the site.

statement.zh: 2026年7月21日 Ms. Chen, Hui-Wen 邀請團隊參訪她的農場 Tamsui Happy Farm，她是自然農法農民。頁面記載的結果：過度介入可能削弱作物自行發展韌性的能力，影響團隊對保護劑釋放量的規劃；她提到颱風與水災後種子會流失，團隊因而設計種子交換平台。
statement.en: On 21 July 2026 Ms. Chen, Hui-Wen invited the team to visit her farm, Tamsui Happy Farm; the page describes her as a natural farming practice farmer. Stated outcome: over-intervention may stop crops developing their own resilience, which shaped how much protectant the business plan would release, and her point that seeds are lost after typhoons and floods led to the seed exchange platform.

title.zh: Prof. Huang, Chieh-Chen 線上會議
title.en: Online meeting with Prof. Huang, Chieh-Chen

statement.zh: 2026年7月28日與中興大學生命科學系 Prof. Huang, Chieh-Chen (黃介辰) 線上會議。頁面記載的結果：生物刺激素在幼苗期施用最有效，過高濃度會有植物毒性，建議結合感測器與天氣預報並改為週期性而非連續運作；他並提供 WB800 菌株。
statement.en: On 28 July 2026 the team met Prof. Huang, Chieh-Chen (黃介辰) of the Department of Life Sciences, National Chung Hsing University, online. Stated outcome: biostimulants are most effective at the seedling stage, excessive concentrations cause phytotoxicity, combine sensors with weather forecasting, and run the bioreactor periodically rather than continuously. The page also says he provided the WB800 strain.

title.zh: 中興大學實地拜訪 Prof. Huang, Chieh-Chen
title.en: In-person NCHU visit to Prof. Huang, Chieh-Chen

statement.zh: 2026年8月6日團隊親自到中興大學拜訪 Prof. Huang, Chieh-Chen。頁面記載的結果：只提高分泌量不足，須同時評估蛋白的量、身分、溶解度與功能；乾實驗室轉向設計較短或修改過的胜肽構築。
statement.en: On 6 August 2026 the team visited Prof. Huang, Chieh-Chen in person at NCHU. Stated outcome: improving secretion alone is insufficient if the protein loses activity, so protein quantity, identity, solubility and function must be evaluated together, and the dry lab moved to shorter or modified peptide constructs.

title.zh: Prof. Huang, Tzu-Pi 拜訪
title.en: Visit to Prof. Huang, Tzu-Pi

statement.zh: 2026年8月6日同日拜訪中興大學植物病理學系 Prof. Huang, Tzu-Pi (黃姿碧)，專長微生物生物膜、微生物細胞訊息、生物防治與農藥科學。頁面記載的結果：ACCD 等保護劑只需到達根圈而不必進入根內，並建議在培養基中加入豆粕與黑糖等簡單養分以提高產量。
statement.en: On the same day, 6 August 2026, the team visited Prof. Huang, Tzu-Pi (黃姿碧) of the Department of Plant Pathology at National Chung Hsing University, whose expertise is microbial biofilm, microbial cell signaling, biological control and pesticide science. Stated outcome: protectants such as ACCD only need to reach the root zone rather than enter the root, and adding soybean meal and brown sugar to the medium can boost production.

title.zh: 源鮮智慧農場參訪
title.en: Visit to Yes Health iFarm

statement.zh: 2026年8月11日參訪 Yes Health iFarm (源鮮智慧農場)，一座以堆疊式垂直水耕種植葉菜、香草與微型蔬菜的室內農場。頁面記載的結果：團隊重新考慮8/16光照週期是否應改為12/12、把 DO 與 OD 納入參數規劃，並改為連續循環與輕度曝氣而非純氧。
statement.en: On 11 August 2026 the team visited Yes Health iFarm (源鮮智慧農場), an indoor farm growing leafy vegetables, herbs and microgreens in stacked vertical hydroponic systems. Stated outcome: reconsider the 8/16 light cycle against a 12/12 cycle, incorporate DO and possibly OD into system parameters, and use continuous circulation and gentle aeration rather than pure oxygen.

title.zh: Prof. Chang, Hung-Hao 農業經濟諮詢

statement.zh: 2026年8月31日諮詢台灣大學農業經濟學系 Prof. Chang, Hung-Hao (張弘浩)，評估商業計畫的市場可行性與商業化。頁面記載的結果：需展示可量測的作物損失減少，並在商業化前處理圍堵、法規、有機農業要求與成本；團隊因此把初期應用縮小到特定逆境與作物。
statement.en: On 31 August 2026 the team consulted Prof. Chang, Hung-Hao (張弘浩) of the Department of Agricultural Economics at NTU on the market feasibility and commercialization of the business plan. Stated outcome: demonstrate a measurable reduction in crop yield losses, address containment, regulation, organic farming requirements and costs, and narrow the initial application to a specific stress and crop.

statement.zh: 2026年8月28日第二次拜訪 Prof. Cheng 的實驗室，諮詢水耕污染、洋菜膠鹽逆境處理流程與土壤鹽逆境實驗。頁面記載的結果：先前結果可能受非預期逆境影響，須標準化植株齡期、處理時間與樣本條件。
statement.en: On 28 August 2026 the team made a second visit to Prof. Cheng's laboratory on hydroponics containment, the agar salinity stress protocol and soil-based salinity experiments. Stated outcome: some earlier results may have been affected by unintended stress, so plant age, treatment timing and sample conditions had to be standardised.

title.en: Online interview with the Lanyang River cooperative

statement.zh: 團隊與 Mr. Chen, Ke-Wei (陳可為) 線上訪談，他是農民也是 Lanyang River Friendly Farming Production Cooperative 的創辦人。頁面記載的結果：擔心生物反應器可能被自然災害或野生動物破壞而使 B. subtilis 被釋放，團隊因此把此風險納入商業計畫的威脅分析；他並建議針對特定作物群訂定行銷策略。
statement.en: The team held an online interview with Mr. Chen, Ke-Wei (陳可為), a farmer and the founder of the Lanyang River Friendly Farming Production Cooperative. Stated outcome: his concern that the bioreactor could be damaged by natural disasters or wild animals and release B. subtilis was added to the business plan threat analysis, and he encouraged a marketing strategy focused on specific crop groups.

status_note.zh: 每分鐘3公頃的量級需核對原文；Zhao et al., 2017 未列入該頁參考文獻清單。
status_note.en: The rate of 3 hectares per minute needs checking against the source; Zhao et al., 2017 is not in that page's reference list.

wiki.quote: an additional 3 hectares becoming unproductive every minute (Zhao et al., 2017)

title.zh: 小農佔全球糧食供給的比例
title.en: Smallholder share of global food supply

statement.zh: 創業頁寫小農生產約70至80%的全球糧食供給，在許多開發中次區域更超過所有消費糧食的80%，引用 Ricciardi et al., 2018。
statement.en: The Entrepreneurship page states small farmers produce approximately 70-80% of the global food supply, rising to over 80% of all consumed food in many developing sub-regions, citing Ricciardi et al., 2018.

status_note.zh: Ricciardi et al., 2018 未列入該頁參考文獻清單。
status_note.en: Ricciardi et al., 2018 is not in that page's reference list.

wiki.quote: approximately 70-80% of the global food supply

title.zh: 東亞與台灣的小農結構
title.en: East Asia and Taiwan smallholder structure

statement.zh: 創業頁寫在包含台灣的東亞，超過90%的農業經營為小規模家庭經營、平均不到1公頃，且這些小農直接供應超過80%的國內生鮮蔬果，引用 Ministry of Agriculture, 2024。
statement.en: The Entrepreneurship page states that in East Asia including Taiwan over 90% of agricultural holdings are small-scale family operations averaging less than 1 hectare, and these small farmers directly supply more than 80% of domestic fresh vegetables and fruits, citing Ministry of Agriculture, 2024.

status_note.zh: 引用寫 Ministry of Agriculture, 2024 但未列入參考文獻清單。
status_note.en: The citation Ministry of Agriculture, 2024 is not in that page's reference list.

wiki.quote: over 90% of agricultural holdings are small-scale family operations

title.zh: 全球小農農場數
title.en: Number of smallholder farms worldwide

statement.zh: 創業頁寫全球有超過5億個小農農場。
statement.en: The Entrepreneurship page states there are over 500 million smallholder farms worldwide.

status_note.zh: 未標註出處。
status_note.en: No source is cited.

wiki.quote: over 500 million smallholder farms

title.zh: 台灣有機農地比例的兩個數字
title.en: Two figures for Taiwan's organic farmland share

statement.zh: 創業頁引用農業部農糧署寫到2024年台灣只有3.47%的農地是有機與友善環境耕作；法規頁與地理空間分析頁寫有機農業約佔耕地的3.7%。
statement.en: The Entrepreneurship page cites the Agriculture and Food Agency, Ministry of Agriculture for only 3.47% of Taiwan's total farmland being organic and eco-friendly by 2024. The Laws and Regulations page and the Geospatial Analysis page both give about 3.7% of cultivated land.

status_note.zh: 3.47% (Entrepreneurship, AFA 2024) 對 3.7% (Laws、Geospatial)。
status_note.en: 3.47% on entrepreneurship against 3.7% on laws-and-regulations and geospatial-analysis.

wiki.quote: only 3.47% of Taiwan’s total farmland is organic and eco-friendly by 2024
about 3.7% of cultivated land
about 3.7% of cultivated land

title.zh: 全球有機農地比例
title.en: Global organic agricultural land share

statement.zh: 創業頁寫2023年全球有2.1%的農業用地以有機方式經營，換句話說全球超過97%的農民是慣行農法。
statement.en: The Entrepreneurship page states that 2.1% of agricultural land was managed organically in 2023, so over 97% of farmers worldwide are conventional.

status_note.zh: 未標註出處。
status_note.en: No source is cited.

wiki.quote: Globally, 2.1% of agricultural land was managed organically in 2023

title.zh: 競品的單功能價格區間寫法有誤
title.en: Competitor price range appears reversed

statement.zh: 創業頁的策略定位段落寫類似產品若只做感測或只做保護劑生產，定價約在 80,000 到 10,000 NTD。此區間的上下限順序顛倒。
statement.en: The Entrepreneurship strategic positioning section states that similar products can price around 80,000 to 10,000NTD for just sensing or just protectant production. The two ends of the range are the wrong way round.

status_note.zh: 80,000 到 10,000 的區間上下限顛倒，無法判讀原意。
status_note.en: The range 80,000 to 10,000 is inverted and cannot be read as written.

wiki.quote: which can price around 80,000 to 10,000NTD for just sensing

title.zh: 試點與銷售目標
title.en: Pilot and sales targets

statement.zh: 創業頁的銷售目標寫首批商業試點於2027年啟動、2027年底前至少取得2個試點夥伴關係、2028年至少將1個試點轉為長期供應或服務合約，試點規模為一個生長季部署5到10套生物反應器系統。
statement.en: The Entrepreneurship sales objectives state that first commercial pilot programmes launch in 2027, at least 2 pilot partnerships are secured by the end of 2027, at least 1 pilot converts to a long-term supply or service agreement in 2028, and pilots deploy 5 to 10 bioreactor systems for one growing season.

status_note.zh: 為未來計畫，無法以現有資料驗證。
status_note.en: These are forward-looking plans and cannot be verified from present data.

wiki.quote: First commercial pilot programs will launch in 2027
Deploy 5–10 bioreactor systems for one growing season

title.zh: 試點農場的成效目標
title.en: Pilot farm performance targets

statement.zh: 創業頁寫試點農場一旦相對於自身前一季達到10至15%的增產與20至30%的減少噴藥，就推出推薦折扣。
statement.en: The Entrepreneurship page states that once pilot farms reach the target of 10-15% higher yield and 20-30% less spraying, measured against their own previous season, the team will launch a referral discount.

status_note.zh: 為目標值而非量測結果。
status_note.en: These are targets, not measured results.

wiki.quote: our target of 10-15% higher yield and 20-30% less spraying

title.zh: 發展路線圖的部署量
title.en: Deployment counts in the development roadmap

statement.zh: 創業頁的六年路線圖寫第2年在台灣部署20至50台原型機並觸及20至70位農民、目標每季減少20至30%施用次數；第3年部署150至400台；第4年在2至3個國家部署500至1500台。
statement.en: The six-year roadmap on the Entrepreneurship page states Year 2 deploys 20 to 50 prototype devices in Taiwan reaching 20 to 70 farmers with a target of 20 to 30% fewer applications per season, Year 3 deploys 150 to 400 units, and Year 4 deploys 500 to 1,500 units across 2 to 3 countries.

status_note.zh: 為未來計畫，無法以現有資料驗證。
status_note.en: These are forward-looking plans and cannot be verified.

wiki.quote: deploying about 20 to 50 prototype devices
deploy 150 to 400 units
deploying 500 to 1500 units across two to three countries

title.zh: 第1年概念驗證的完成度
title.en: Year 1 concept validation completion

statement.zh: 創業頁的路線圖把第1年的概念驗證標為8項全數完成 (8/8 done)，八項為：驗證穿梭載體、ccaSR 系統與 MoClo 2.0；最佳化 B. subtilis 電穿孔與流程；建構 PCB、ccaSm10 (LSM) 與 ccaR (TOM) 模組；開發 LEA14、ACCD 與 BoPep4 保護劑；特性化 535 nm/670 nm 光控分泌；阿拉伯芥逆境測試與土壤介質轉換;整合生物系統與反應器感測 (MMI)；準備菌株與線路的策略性智財申請。
statement.en: The Entrepreneurship roadmap marks Year 1 concept validation as 8/8 done, listing: validate shuttle vector, ccaSR system and MoClo 2.0; optimize B. subtilis electroporation and workflow; construct PCB, ccaSm10 (LSM) and ccaR (TOM) modules; develop LEA14, ACCD and BoPep4 protectants; characterize 535 nm/670 nm light-controlled secretion; A. thaliana stress testing and soil media transition; integrate bio-system with bioreactor sensors (MMI); and prepare strategic IP filings.

status_note.zh: 貢獻頁說光驅動卡匣尚無誘導曲線、只是設計而非已特性化的開關，與路線圖把 535 nm/670 nm 光控分泌標為已完成相矛盾。
status_note.en: The Contribution page says the light-driven cassette has no induction curve yet and is a design rather than a characterised switch, which contradicts marking 535 nm/670 nm light-controlled secretion as completed.

wiki.quote: Concept validation Year 1 · 8/8 done
Characterize 535 nm/670 nm light-controlled secretion | ✓Completed, 6 mo
we have no induction curve for it yet, so it is a design and not a characterised switch

title.zh: EU 法規 2019/1009 與 PFC 6(B)
title.en: EU Regulation 2019/1009 and PFC 6(B)

statement.zh: 法規頁寫 Regulation (EU) 2019/1009 將 Product Function Category (PFC) 6 定義為植物生物刺激素，PFC 6(B) 涵蓋非微生物植物生物刺激素，且該法規明文把改善非生物逆境耐受性納入植物生物刺激素的功能。
statement.en: The Laws and Regulations page states that Regulation (EU) 2019/1009 defines Product Function Category (PFC) 6 as plant biostimulants, that PFC 6(B) covers non-microbial plant biostimulants, and that the regulation explicitly includes improvement of tolerance to abiotic stress within the plant-biostimulant function.

status_note.zh: 法規條文需以官方文本核對。
status_note.en: The legal text needs checking against the official source.

facts.ask: Laws and Regulations sub-team (Ethan Chang carries the Regulations task on the roster)

wiki.quote: PFC 6(B) covers non-microbial plant biostimulants
European Union: Regulation (EU) 2019/1009 [PFC 6(B)] & CE Marking

title.zh: EU 微生物生物刺激素的四個屬群
title.en: The EU's four permitted microbial biostimulant groups

statement.zh: 法規頁寫 Regulation (EU) 2019/1009 自2022年7月16日起適用，把微生物生物刺激素限於四類：Azotobacter、Azospirillum、Rhizobium 與菌根真菌；B. subtilis 不在清單上，因此菌體落在調和途徑之外而適用各國規範。
statement.en: The Laws and Regulations page states that Regulation (EU) 2019/1009, applied since 16 July 2022, limits microbial biostimulants to four groups, Azotobacter, Azospirillum, Rhizobium and mycorrhizal fungi, and that B. subtilis is not on the list, so the culture falls outside the harmonized route and national rules apply.

status_note.zh: 法規條文需以官方文本核對。
status_note.en: The legal text needs checking against the official source.

wiki.quote: limits microbial biostimulants to four groups (Azotobacter, Azospirillum, Rhizobium, and mycorrhizal fungi)

title.zh: EU 殘留 DNA 數值限值未找到
title.en: No numerical residual DNA limit identified in the EU regulation

statement.zh: 法規頁寫團隊的檢視並未在該法規中找到可作為 PFC 6(B) 要求的一般性殘留 DNA 數值限值，因此 ReLEAF 不應主張存在法定 DNA 門檻，除非找到具體條文、授權法案、調和標準或主管機關解釋。
statement.en: The Laws and Regulations page states that the team's review has not identified a general numerical residual-DNA limit in the Regulation that can be stated as a PFC 6(B) requirement, and that ReLEAF should not claim a legal DNA threshold unless a specific provision, delegated act, harmonised standard or competent authority interpretation is identified.

status_note.zh: 法規條文需以官方文本核對。
status_note.en: The legal text needs checking against the official source.

wiki.quote: our review has not identified a general numerical residual-DNA limit

title.zh: 台灣肥料管理法的註冊要求
title.en: Taiwan Fertilizer Management Act registration requirement

statement.zh: 法規頁寫台灣的肥料管理法要求任何肥料在製造、輸入或販售前須取得登記證；微生物肥料需要作物毒性、生物毒性與生態測試報告。該頁並寫此法不適用於農民自製自用而不販售的有機質肥料，且禁止將已登記肥料重新分裝、混合或稀釋後販售。
statement.en: The Laws and Regulations page states that Taiwan's Fertilizer Management Act requires a registration certificate before any fertilizer is manufactured, imported or sold, that microbial fertilizers need crop-toxicity, bio-toxicity and ecological test reports, that the Act does not apply to organic fertilizer farmers make for their own use without selling, and that it bars repackaging, mixing or diluting registered fertilizer for sale.

status_note.zh: 法規條文需以官方文本核對。
status_note.en: The legal text needs checking against the official source.

wiki.quote: The Fertilizer Management Act requires a registration certificate
bars repackaging, mixing, or diluting registered fertilizer for sale

title.zh: 台灣2011年的16株預先認可安全菌株
title.en: Taiwan's 2011 list of 16 pre-recognized safe strains

statement.zh: 法規頁寫農業部於2011年公告16株預先認可的安全菌株，包含8種細菌、4種真菌、4種酵母菌，且多數在台灣可見；工程化的 WB800 菌株不太可能適用此簡化清單，須走完整文件。
statement.en: The Laws and Regulations page states that in 2011 the Ministry of Agriculture published a list of 16 pre-recognized safe strains, 8 bacteria, 4 fungi and 4 yeasts, mostly occurring in Taiwan, and that an engineered WB800 strain is unlikely to qualify for the simplified list and would need the full dossier.

status_note.zh: 法規條文需以官方文本核對。
status_note.en: The legal text needs checking against the official source.

wiki.quote: a list of 16 pre-recognized safe strains (8 bacteria, 4 fungi, 4 yeasts)

title.zh: 台灣生物刺激素途徑的時程
title.en: Taiwan biostimulant pathway timeline

statement.zh: 創業頁寫在台灣的肥料法規下，生物刺激素走精簡途徑：肥料規格報告約20天加上政府審查7天，合計約30天即可上市；若登記為生物農藥則需3至5年、多季田間試驗與 GLP 動物試驗。
statement.en: The Entrepreneurship page states that under Taiwan's fertilizer regulations biostimulants follow a streamlined pathway of approximately 20 days for a fertilizer specification report plus 7 days for government review, about 30 days total to market, whereas registering as a biopesticide would require 3 to 5 years, multi-season field trials and GLP animal testing.

status_note.zh: 此30天時程只出現在創業頁；法規頁對台灣細胞外產物的分類寫 Exact fertilizer category still requires authority confirmation，並未確認任何時程。
status_note.en: The 30-day timeline appears only on entrepreneurship, while laws-and-regulations records the Taiwan cell-free output classification as still requiring authority confirmation.

wiki.quote: approximately 20 days for fertilizer specification report plus 7 days for government review
Taiwan - cell-free output | Exact fertilizer category still requires authority confirmation

title.zh: 台灣有機農業促進法排除 GMO
title.en: Taiwan Organic Agriculture Promotion Act excludes GMO products

statement.zh: 法規頁寫台灣的有機農業促進法將任何基因改造生物的產品排除於驗證有機生產之外，無論圍堵與否，因此驗證有機農業對 ReLEAF 關閉。
statement.en: The Laws and Regulations page states that Taiwan's Organic Agriculture Promotion Act excludes any product of a genetically modified organism from certified organic production, whatever the containment, so certified organic farming is closed to ReLEAF.

status_note.zh: 法規條文需以官方文本核對。
status_note.en: The legal text needs checking against the official source.

wiki.quote: excludes any product of a genetically modified organism from certified organic production

title.zh: 台灣的主管機關分工
title.en: Taiwan's two competent authorities

statement.zh: 法規頁寫農業部同時主管兩條途徑：農糧署 (Agriculture and Food Agency) 依肥料管理法登記肥料，動植物防疫檢疫署 (Animal and Plant Health Inspection Agency) 依農藥管理法處理農藥。台灣的肥料規格中有「植物生長輔助劑類」一類。
statement.en: The Laws and Regulations page states that Taiwan's Ministry of Agriculture oversees both routes: the Agriculture and Food Agency registers fertilizers under the Fertilizer Management Act and the Animal and Plant Health Inspection Agency handles pesticides under the Pesticide Management Act, and that Taiwan's fertilizer specifications recognize a category 植物生長輔助劑類 (Plant Growth Auxiliary Materials).

status_note.zh: 法規條文需以官方文本核對。
status_note.en: The legal text needs checking against the official source.

wiki.quote: The Agriculture and Food Agency registers fertilizers under the Fertilizer Management Act

title.zh: 動植物防疫檢疫署的英文縮寫兩種寫法
title.en: Two abbreviations for Taiwan's plant health agency

statement.zh: 創業頁寫 Animal and Plant Health Inspection Agency (BAPHIQ)；人類實踐頁的作物壓力警報段落寫 Taiwan Animal and Plant Health Inspection Agency (APHIA)。法規頁寫出全名但未給縮寫。
statement.en: The Entrepreneurship page writes Animal and Plant Health Inspection Agency (BAPHIQ). The Human Practices crop stress alert section writes Taiwan Animal and Plant Health Inspection Agency (APHIA). The Laws and Regulations page gives the full name without an abbreviation.

status_note.zh: BAPHIQ (Entrepreneurship) 對 APHIA (Human Practices)，指同一機關。
status_note.en: BAPHIQ on entrepreneurship against APHIA on human-practices for the same agency.

wiki.quote: Animal and Plant Health Inspection Agency (BAPHIQ)
Taiwan Animal and Plant Health Inspection Agency (APHIA)

title.zh: 中空纖維膜孔徑的兩個數值
title.en: Two pore ratings for the hollow-fiber membrane

statement.zh: 創業頁的法規段落與路線圖寫 0.22 微米中空纖維膜；法規頁、貢獻頁與量測頁寫 0.2 微米。法規頁另在菲律賓段落寫 0.2 μm。
statement.en: The Entrepreneurship regulations section and roadmap state a 0.22 micrometer hollow-fiber membrane. The Laws and Regulations page, the Contribution page and the Measurement page state 0.2 µm, and the Philippine section of the laws page writes 0.2 μm.

status_note.zh: 0.22 µm (Entrepreneurship) 對 0.2 µm (Laws、Contribution、Measurement、Plants)。
status_note.en: 0.22 µm on entrepreneurship against 0.2 µm on laws-and-regulations, contribution, measurement and plant.

wiki.quote: physically confined via the 0.22 micrometer hollow-fiber membrane
The hollow-fiber membrane (0.2 µm) retains the production culture
a PES hollow-fibre module rated at 0.2 µm

title.zh: 膜截留的目標對數削減
title.en: Target log reduction for membrane retention

statement.zh: 法規頁的未來法規要求表寫膜截留挑戰試驗目標至少7個對數的削減，並註明這是以滅菌級濾膜測試為模型的內部提議目標。貢獻頁則明說團隊目前沒有對數削減值。
statement.en: The Laws and Regulations future-requirements table sets a target of at least a 7-log reduction in the membrane retention challenge, marked as a proposed internal target modelled on sterilizing-grade filter testing. The Contribution page states plainly that the team has no log reduction value.

status_note.zh: 7-log 為目標而非量測結果；貢獻頁確認目前無對數削減數據。
status_note.en: The 7-log figure is a target, not a measurement; the contribution page confirms no log reduction value exists yet.

wiki.quote: target at least a 7-log reduction (proposed internal target
A log reduction value. The plating above is a single test on a single run

title.zh: 生物圍堵的逃逸頻率目標
title.en: Target escape frequency for biocontainment

statement.zh: 法規頁的未來要求寫生物圍堵 (工程化營養缺陷或 kill switch) 的目標逃逸頻率低於每10的8次方個細胞1個，並註明為常被引用的基準；水平基因轉移試驗的偵測極限目標低於10的9次方分之一。
statement.en: The Laws and Regulations future-requirements table sets a target escape frequency below 1 in 10 to the 8th cells, noted as a commonly cited benchmark, for engineered auxotrophy or a kill switch, and a horizontal gene transfer assay with a detection limit below 1 in 10 to the 9th.

status_note.zh: 為目標值，尚未執行。
status_note.en: These are targets; the assays have not been run.

wiki.quote: a target escape frequency below 1 in 10 8 cells (commonly cited benchmark)

title.zh: 菲律賓 FPA 與備忘錄通函 2018-20
title.en: Philippines FPA and Memorandum Circular 2018-20

statement.zh: 法規頁寫菲律賓是亞洲唯一在肥料體系內明文納入工程化生物的市場，依據為 Fertilizer and Pesticide Authority (FPA) 的 Memorandum Circular 2018-20，並提供在一季效力資料後的臨時登記。
statement.en: The Laws and Regulations page states the Philippines is the only Asian market where engineered organisms are named inside the fertilizer system, under Fertilizer and Pesticide Authority (FPA) Memorandum Circular 2018-20, which offers provisional registration after one season of efficacy data.

status_note.zh: 法規條文需以官方文本核對。
status_note.en: The legal text needs checking against the official source.

wiki.quote: Fertilizer [and] Pesticide Authority; FPA Memorandum Circular 2018-20

title.zh: 菲律賓農業統計數據
title.en: Philippines agricultural statistics

statement.zh: 創業頁引用 Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA) 寫2024年農林漁業部門的總增值約為1.78兆披索，當年稻穀 (palay) 產量1909萬公噸、收穫面積465萬公頃，稻穀產量較2023年下降4.8%。
statement.en: The Entrepreneurship page cites the Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA) for approximately ₱1.78 trillion in gross value added from agriculture, forestry and fishing in 2024, 19.09 million metric tons of palay produced that year across 4.65 million hectares of harvested area, and a 4.8% decline in palay production compared with 2023.

facts.unit: million metric tons of palay in 2024

status_note.zh: PSA 兩份報告已列入參考文獻；數字需對回原始公告。
status_note.en: Two PSA reports are listed in the references; the figures need checking against the originals.

wiki.quote: approximately ₱1.78 trillion in gross value added in 2024
19.09 million metric tons of palay

title.zh: 美國 TSCA 生物技術的審查時程
title.en: US TSCA biotechnology review clocks

statement.zh: 法規頁寫美國環保署在毒性物質管制法 (TSCA) 生物技術程序下點名工程化微生物：商業化前90天提出 Microbial Commercial Activity Notice，田間試驗前60天提出田間試驗申請，部分受體生物有豁免。相關條文為 40 C.F.R. Part 725。
statement.en: The Laws and Regulations page states that the EPA's Toxic Substances Control Act biotechnology process names engineered microbes, requiring a Microbial Commercial Activity Notice 90 days before commercialization and a field-test application 60 days before trials, with exemptions for some recipient organisms, under 40 C.F.R. Part 725.

status_note.zh: 法規條文需以官方文本核對。

statement.en: The elementary and junior high lessons both use a spinach leaf-disk experiment in which disks initially sink in a beaker and rise as they produce oxygen under a light source; replacing room-temperature water with warmer water slows or stops the flotation, demonstrating that excess heat damages plant enzymes and disrupts photosynthesis. title.en: Membrane containment has no log reduction value

statement.zh: 貢獻頁明說此項貢獻不含對數削減值：所述的平盤測試是單一次運轉的單一測試，記錄了培養時間與溫度但沒有重複試驗、也沒有偵測極限，建議重複使用的是幾何結構與平盤方法而非截留數值。測試方式為反應器運轉時分別取管腔側與殼側的培養液平盤，於37°C培養24小時後比較。
statement.en: The Contribution page states plainly that this contribution does not include a log reduction value: the plating described is a single test on a single run, with incubation time and temperature recorded but no replicate and no detection limit, so the geometry and the plating method should be reused rather than a retention figure. The test took medium from the lumen and shell sides while the bioreactor was running and compared the plates after 24 hours at 37 °C.

status_note.en: A single test with no replicate and no detection limit.

title.zh: 光度計對 BioDrop 的線性關係
title.en: Photometer linearity against the BioDrop

statement.zh: 貢獻頁寫以同一二氧化鈦懸浮液對照 BioDrop 時，團隊儀器的讀值為 ours = 1.018 × BioDrop − 0.031，R² = 0.995，且在加入超過30毫克二氧化鈦後較 BioDrop 穩定；但這只證明讀值對濁度呈線性，不是細胞計數，連結讀值與生物量的矽石校正已寫成但尚未執行。
statement.en: The Contribution page states that against a BioDrop reading the same titanium dioxide suspension the team's instrument gives ours = 1.018 × BioDrop − 0.031 with R² = 0.995, and above 30 mg of added TiO2 it is the steadier of the two, but that this shows linearity in turbidity rather than a cell count, and the silica calibration that would tie a reading to biomass is written up but not yet run.

status_note.zh: 無生物量校正；最長一次運轉中 OD 通道中途失效，且紀錄未寫下迴路內的內容物。
status_note.en: No biomass calibration; the OD channel failed partway through the longest run and the log does not record what was in the loop.

title.zh: 原始資料有但 wiki 未撰寫的瓊脂實驗
title.en: Agar experiments in raw data but not written up on the wiki

statement.zh: 以下實驗有簡報與葉綠素資料：第 9 組 ACCD 正式鹽逆境（10/3 第 15 天）、ACCD 熱逆境試驗 1（10/2 第 15 天）、第 10 組 BoPEP4 鹽逆境（10/3 第 10 天）、9/11 無逆境 Buffer 對 ACCD、以及 9/5 量測的第 7 組批次。植物頁皆無結果段落。
statement.en: Raw decks and chlorophyll sheets exist for: set #9 official ACCD salinity test (day 15 on 3 Oct), ACCD heat stress trial 1 (day 15 on 2 Oct), set #10 BoPEP4 salinity test (day 10 on 3 Oct), the 11 Sep buffer vs ACCD run without stress, and a set #7 run measured on 5 Sep. None has a results section on the plant page.

status_note.zh: 實驗紀錄無法佐証這五個实验：紀錄中最後一筆琉脂擬南芥工作是 8/21（熱逆境前測鮮重、播 13 盤 0.6% 琉脂）。九月實驗紀錄完全沒有擬南芥、琉脂盤、葉綠素或鮮重條目（植物紀錄九月只有草汁與黃豆水解），十月也沒有植物條目。所以第 9 組 ACCD、ACCD 熱逆境、第 10 組 BoPEP4 與 9/11 buffer 实验只存在於簡報與表格，沒有人員與日期的紀錄。（原始檔："Title: planting seeds on 0.6% agar plates ... Plant 40 seeds on each plate according to the grid"）
status_note.en: The electronic lab notes cannot corroborate any of these five runs: the last agar Arabidopsis entry anywhere in the notes is 21 Aug (fresh weight of the heat stress pretest, and sowing 13 plates of 0.6% agar). The September Electronic Lab Notes contain no Arabidopsis, agar plate, chlorophyll or fresh weight work at all (the plant notebook's September entries are hay infusion and soybean hydrolysis), and there is no October plant entry. So set #9 ACCD, the ACCD heat trial, set #10 BoPEP4 and the 11 Sep buffer run exist only as decks and spreadsheets, with no notebook record of who ran them or when. Raw file reads: "Title: planting seeds on 0.6% agar plates ... Plant 40 seeds on each plate according to the grid"

statement.zh: 實驗記錄 7/4：分成 200 mL 後，150 mM 加 2.192 g NaCl、250 mM 加 3.652 g。7/7 重做每 50 mL 用 0.548 g 與 0.913 g。
statement.en: Notebook 4 July: after splitting the medium into 200 mL flasks, add 2.192 g NaCl for 150 mM and 3.652 g for 250 mM. The 7 July remake uses 0.548 g and 0.913 g per 50 mL.

status_note.zh: 紀錄原文為 600 mL 分成三瓶 200 mL，「Add 2.192 g of NaCl into the flask labelled [150mM NaCl]」，250 mM 為 3.652 g。算起来 2.192 g 是 250 mL 的 150 mM，不是 200 mL（200 mL 需 1.7532 g，正是 Agar Application of Protectant 表中的數值）；7/7 重做的 0.548、0.913 g/50 mL 是同一組數字除四。因此整個第 5 組濃度梯度像是按 250 mL 算後倒入 200 mL，高約 25%（187.5 與 312.5 mM）。瓶中是否真為 200 mL 只能問團隊。（原始檔："Add 2.192 g of NaCl into the flask labelled [150mM NaCl]"）
status_note.en: The notebook text is verbatim: 600 mL split into three 200 mL flasks, "Add 2.192 g of NaCl into the flask labelled [150mM NaCl]" and 3.652 g for 250 mM. Arithmetically 2.192 g is 150 mM in 250 mL, not in 200 mL (150 mM in 200 mL needs 1.7532 g, which is exactly what the Agar Application of Protectant table gives), and 3.652 g is 250 mM in 250 mL; the 7 July remake masses of 0.548 and 0.913 g per 50 mL are the same numbers divided by four. So the whole set 5 ladder looks computed for 250 mL volumes and poured into 200 mL / 50 mL, i.e. about 25% high (187.5 and 312.5 mM). Only the team can say whether the flasks really held 200 mL. Raw file reads: "Add 2.192 g of NaCl into the flask labelled [150mM NaCl]"

statement.zh: 各表 V：2 mL（第 4 組、第 5 組試驗 2、第 6 組、第 7 組試驗 1 與 3）、1 mL（第 5 組試驗 1）、4 mL（熱逆境前測、第 8、9、10 組、ACCD 熱逆境）。第 7 組「trial 4」表改用 95% 丙酮，係數 6.63 與 18.08，波長 665 與 649 nm。
statement.en: Sheet headers give V = 2 mL (set 4, set 5 trial 2, set 6, set 7 trials 1 and 3), 1 mL (set 5 trial 1) and 4 mL (heat pretest, set 8, 9, 10, heat ACCD). The set 7 "trial 4" sheet uses 95% acetone with coefficients 6.63 and 18.08 at 665 and 649 nm.

status_note.zh: 紀錄中的丙酮量：6/7 與 7/2 為每管 1 mL；7/13（第 5 組試驗 1）為 200 µL + 800 µL（即 1 mL，「V=1ml」）；8/5（第 6 組）與 8/10（第 7 組試驗 1）為 4 mL。表格的 V = 2 mL 極可能源於 SOP 本身：Protocol/Chlorophyll Extraction.docx 寫「Add 4 mL to each tube」卻以「V=2ml」結尾，而 Agar Application of Protectant 裡同一流程結尾是「V=4ml」。另外，95% 丙酮與 6.63/18.08（665/649 nm）在所有紀錄與流程中都找不到；所有記錄的萎取都是 80% 丙酮、645/663 nm。（原始檔："Add 4 mL to each tube"）
status_note.en: The acetone volumes logged in the notes are 1 mL per tube on 7 June and 2 July, 200 µL + 800 µL (= 1 mL, "V=1ml") on 13 July for set 5 trial 1, and 4 mL on 5 Aug (set 6) and 10 Aug (set 7 trial 1). The V = 2 mL on the sheets most likely comes from the SOP itself: Protocol/Chlorophyll Extraction.docx says "Dilute acetone to 80% / Add 4 mL to each tube" and then ends "V=2ml", while the same procedure inside Agar Application of Protectant ends "V=4ml". So the 4 mL vs 2 mL mismatch is in the protocol, not only in the set 6 sheet. Separately, 95% acetone and the 6.63/18.08 coefficients at 665/649 nm on the set 7 "trial 4" sheet appear nowhere in any notebook or protocol; every logged extraction is 80% acetone read at 645/663. Raw file reads: "Add 4 mL to each tube"

status_note.zh: 紀錄多了一個日期，也推翻總表的結束日。第 4 組的盤是 6/14 倒的（六月實驗紀錄「½ MS medium 1% agar prep—Purpose: Arabidopsis salinity growth test」，500 mL，每 250 mL 加 1.461 g NaCl（100 mM），海藻糖 0、0.25、0.5、1 mM，即第 4 組梯度，與 Protocol/1_2 MS agar plate preparation 配方相同）。實驗沒有 6/30 停：兩本紀錄都有「20260702 Chlorophyll Extraction—Weight the fresh weight of arabidopsis (9 at a time)」，葉綠素檔的第 4 組工作表也是 20260702。所以 6/30 是最後一次量根長，7/2 才是收樣，符合簡報的「Day 12 (7/2)」。哪一天算 day 1 仍須團隊決定。（原始檔："Weight the fresh weight of arabidopsis (9 at a time)"）
status_note.en: The notes add a fourth date and knock out the tracker's end date. Set 4's plates were poured on 14 June (June ELN, "½ MS medium 1% agar prep - Purpose: Arabidopsis salinity growth test", 500 mL with 1.461 g NaCl per 250 mL = 100 mM and trehalose 0, 0.25, 0.5, 1 mM, i.e. the set 4 ladder, and the same recipe as Protocol/1_2 MS agar plate preparation). The run did not stop on 30 June: both notebooks log "20260702 Chlorophyll Extraction - Weight the fresh weight of arabidopsis (9 at a time)", and the chlorophyll workbook's set 4 sheet is dated 20260702. So 30 June is the last root-length day and 2 July is the harvest, which is why the deck ends at "Day 12 (7/2)". Which day counts as day 1 is still a team call. Raw file reads: "Weight the fresh weight of arabidopsis (9 at a time)"

status_note.zh: 兩種天數在不同時期都是實際做法。6/17 進度報告（第 4 組入生長箱前一天）記「Standardize stratification at 2 days」，支持簡報日期與植物頁。7 月底起所有播種條目都寫四天（7/27、8/5、8/19 與兩份琉脂流程），總表的「vernalized 4 days」屬於那時期。第 4 組本身的春化未記錄，只能請團隊確認。（原始檔："Stratification seeds directly on condition plates (Standardize stratification at 2 days)"）
status_note.en: Both lengths are documented practice, at different times. The 17 June progress report, written the day before set 4 went into the chamber, records the decision "Stratification seeds directly on condition plates (Standardize stratification at 2 days)", which supports the deck dates and the plant page. From late July onward every sowing entry says four days (27 July "vernalize for 4 days", 5 Aug "Vernalize in the 4°C refrigerator for 4 days", 19 Aug, and both agar protocols), which is where the tracker's "vernalized 4 days" belongs. Set 4's own stratification is not logged, so only the team can confirm which it was. Raw file reads: "Stratification seeds directly on condition plates (Standardize stratification at 2 days)"

Trial 1: plates poured 4 July, seedlings transferred 7 July ("Transfer arabidopsis to the salinity plates ... experimental set 5"), fresh weight 12 July, chlorophyll 13 July (34 microtubes, the 12 arm plate map). Trial 2: the July ELN logs "20260720 Transfer Arabidopsis to salinity plates - Purpose: Start experiment set 5 using seeds from 0719", 8 seedlings per plate. So the tracker row collapses two runs; 4 to 12 July is 8 days and covers trial 1 only. Raw file reads: "Purpose: Start experiment set 5 using seeds from 0719"

status_note.zh: 本項引的每一個紀錄數值都與 7/12 條目完全相符（control 0.0154/0.0111/0.014；1 mM 0.0095/0.0014/0.0087；5 mM 0.0101/0.1050/0.0112；10 mM 0.0114/0.0134/0.0024；150 mM 0.0090/0.0013/0.0024 等），所以只剩表格那一邊要核。兩點值得看：5 mM 第二管 0.1050 g 比前後管（0.0101、0.0112）大十倍，像是 0.0105 的小數點誤寫；250 mM NaCl 單組只有一管 7 株（「250mM NaCl (contains 7 plants) 0.0013g」）而非三管，與 7/13 盤位圖 B9、C9 空白相符。（原始檔："5mM trehaslose // -2 0.1050g"）
status_note.en: Every notebook value quoted in this item is verbatim in the 12 July entry (control 0.0154 / 0.0111 / 0.014; 1 mM 0.0095 / 0.0014 / 0.0087; 5 mM 0.0101 / 0.1050 / 0.0112; 10 mM 0.0114 / 0.0134 / 0.0024; 150 mM 0.0090 / 0.0013 / 0.0024; and so on), so only the spreadsheet side still needs checking. Two things to look at: the notebook's 5 mM tube 2 at 0.1050 g sits ten-fold above its own neighbours (0.0101 and 0.0112) and looks like a decimal slip for 0.0105; and 250 mM NaCl alone is a single tube of 7 plants ("250mM NaCl (contains 7 plants) 0.0013g"), not three, which matches the 13 July plate map where wells B9 and C9 are empty. Raw file reads: "5mM trehaslose // -2 0.1050g"

status_note.zh: 植物記錄本 8/9 鮮重那筆逐列標明：對照 (0,0) 0.1537 g／23 株、前處理含 100 mM NaCl 0.0203／24、前處理無鹽 0.1013／23、同時處理含鹽 0.0168／25、同時處理無鹽 0.0406／25、後處理含鹽 0.0234／25、後處理無鹽 0.1830／24。因此葉綠素表的六個標籤確實比數值低一列（少了對照列，含鹽與無鹽因此交錯錯置），與此條所述一致。兩點提醒：八月電子記錄同日另有一筆同樣的表，對照寫成 0.1587，且把含鹽列標成「without 100mM NaCl」，記錄本自身對含鹽標籤互相矛盾；另外每盤是 23 至 25 株，不是 9 株。（原始檔："Control(0,0) 0.1537 23 / Pretreatment(w/ 100mM NaCl) 0.0203 24 / Pretreatment(no salinity) 0.1013 23"）
status_note.en: The 9 August fresh-weight entry in the Plant notebook gives the seven weights with their own labels: Control (0,0) 0.1537 g / 23 plants, Pretreatment w/ 100mM NaCl 0.0203 / 24, Pretreatment no salinity 0.1013 / 23, Cotreatment w/ 100mM NaCl 0.0168 / 25, Cotreatment no salinity 0.0406 / 25, Aftertreatment w/ 100mM NaCl 0.0234 / 25, Aftertreatment no salinity 0.1830 / 24. So the six labels on the chlorophyll sheet sit one row below their values (the control row is dropped and salt/no-salt then alternate wrongly), exactly as the fact says. Two cautions: the August lab notes carry a second entry of the same table on the same day which gives the control as 0.1587 and labels the salted rows 'without 100mM NaCl', so the notebook itself disagrees with itself on the salt labels; and each plate held 23 to 25 plants, not 9. Raw file reads: "Control(0,0) 0.1537 23 / Pretreatment(w/ 100mM NaCl) 0.0203 24 / Pretreatment(no salinity) 0.1013 23"

statement.zh: 兩份簡報皆名為「exp#7 trial 3」：一批 8/9 春化（8/15 至 8/23 拍照），一批 8/19 春化（8/25 至 9/5 拍照）。葉綠素表有「trial 1 20260810」、「trial 3 20260824」、「trial 4 20260905」。總表寫「#7 (3 repeated trials)」。
statement.en: Two decks are both titled "exp#7 trial 3": one run stratified 9 Aug (photos 15 to 23 Aug) and one stratified 19 Aug (photos 25 Aug to 5 Sep). The chlorophyll workbook has sheets "trial 1 20260810", "trial 3 20260824" and "trial 4 20260905". The tracker says "#7 (3 repeated trials)".

status_note.zh: 八月電子記錄確實有中間兩批次及其處理日期：8/9「Vernalize exp#7 trial 2 seeds」；8/13 前處理「Add Zhenhan protectant on horizontal agar(trial #2)」、8/14 同時處理；8/17 下午 3:30「Add zhenhen protectant (pre-treatment) to experiment set #7 trial 3」、8/18「Add NaCl + CH peptide to contreatment (exp set #7 trial 3)」。因此 CH 胜肽共四批（前處理 8/4、8/13、8/17，加上 8/19 播種那批），不是三批，也與 wiki「trial 2、trial 3 日期未記錄」相反。記錄也解釋了為何沒有 trial 2 葉綠素表：瓊脂葉綠素萃取只記錄 8/10（trial 1）與 8/22（熱逆境前測），8/13 前處理那批從未萃取。（原始檔："Add zhenhen protectant (pre-treatment) to experiment set #7 trial 3 (3:30pm)"）
status_note.en: The August lab notes do record the middle runs and their treatment dates: 'Vernalize exp#7 trial 2 seeds' on 9 Aug; pre-treatment 'Add Zhenhan protectant on horizontal agar(trial #2)' on 13 Aug and co-treatment on 14 Aug; then 'Add zhenhen protectant (pre-treatment) to experiment set #7 trial 3 (3:30pm)' on 17 Aug and 'Add NaCl + CH peptide to contreatment (exp set #7 trial 3)' on 18 Aug. That gives four CH peptide runs, not three (pre-treatments 4, 13 and 17 Aug plus the batch sown 19 Aug), and it contradicts the wiki line that trial 2 and trial 3 dates are not recorded. The notes also explain the missing trial 2 sheet: the only agar chlorophyll extractions logged are 10 Aug (trial 1) and 22 Aug (heat pretest), so the run pre-treated 13 Aug was never extracted. Raw file reads: "Add zhenhen protectant (pre-treatment) to experiment set #7 trial 3 (3:30pm)"

Add NaCl + CH peptide to contreatment (exp set #7 trial 3)"）
status_note.en: No notebook holds OD or chlorophyll numbers for 24 August, so the two workbooks cannot be reconciled from the raw notes: the only agar chlorophyll extraction entries are 10 Aug (set 7 trial 1) and 22 Aug (heat pretest). What the notes do settle is which run this sheet belongs to: the August lab notes pre-treated this batch on 17 Aug and co-treated it with 75 and 100 mM NaCl on 18 Aug under the name 'experiment set #7 trial 3', seven days before the 24 Aug reading, so the sheet name agrees with the notebook and the wiki caption calling it trial 2 does not. status_note.zh: 土壤保護劑協議記錄當週使用的 ACCD 製備其實沒有酵素：「western blotting results show no ACCD in b. subtilis so the pretreatment groups that we have done for 0823 and 0824 were not valid(no rescue effectiveness)」。第 8 組瓊脂前測自 8/26 起測試，使用同一批 B. subtilis 來源材料，瓊脂協議並註明該批未做酵素活性測定，因此總表所稱「可用」的比較是建立在未證實有活性的製備上。該比較是否仍成立，須由植物模型組判斷。（原始檔："western blotting results show no ACCD in b. subtilis so the pretreatment groups that we have done for 0823 and 0824 were not valid"）
status_note.en: The soil protectant protocol records that the ACCD preparation in use that week had no enzyme in it: 'western blotting results show no ACCD in b. subtilis so the pretreatment groups that we have done for 0823 and 0824 were not valid(no rescue effectiveness)'. The set 8 agar pretest was tested from 26 August with the same B. subtilis-derived material and the agar protocol marks that run WITHOUT ENZYME ACTIVITY ASSAY TESTING, so the comparison the tracker calls usable rests on a preparation with no demonstrated activity. Whether the control versus 100 mM NaCl versus after-treatment comparison still counts is a call for the plant model team. Raw file reads: "western blotting results show no ACCD in b. subtilis so the pretreatment groups that we have done for 0823 and 0824 were not valid"

title.zh: 團隊繪製的 ACCD 正式測試時程
title.en: ACCD official test timeline as drawn by the team

statement.zh: 時程圖：4 °C 春化 4 天（Day 0 至 4）、長到 7 日齡（Day 11）、Day 11 前處理、Day 12 同時處理、Day 13 後處理、觀察 7 天至 Day 20；處理組噴 3 下保護劑、逆境組噴 3 下 75 或 100 mM NaCl、對照組噴 3 下 TB 培養基。
statement.en: Timeline slide: vernalize at 4 °C 4 days (Day 0 to 4), grow until 7 days old (Day 11), pre-treatment Day 11, co-treatment Day 12, after-treatment Day 13, 7 days observation to Day 20; 3 sprays of protectant on treatment groups, 3 sprays of 75 or 100 mM NaCl on stress groups, 3 sprays of TB medium on control groups.

status_note.zh: 協議檔內有兩個版本，差異正落在 wiki 不一致之處。正式的 ACCD 表面施用協議把 NaCl 加入瓊脂，並以移液器將 0.1 mL 的 50 mU/mL 過濾滅菌液滴於盤面，觀察 10 天期間每 3 至 4 天補施一次。實際採用的「ACCD altered version」把每組都寫成「3 sprays of ACCD」，步驟為「Apply the corresponding NaCl and ACCD by spraying with a spray bottle on the leaves of the plants」，75 與 100 mM NaCl 由 3M 母液現配；故投影片的噴施與實際採用的協議一致，而植物頁「移到已含處理的盤」只符合正式版本。兩個版本都是觀察 10 天，投影片的 Day 20 兩者皆無。（原始檔："Apply the corresponding NaCl and ACCD by spraying with a spray bottle on the leaves of the plants"）
status_note.en: The protocol file holds two versions and they differ exactly where the wiki does. The formal ACCD surface-application protocol bakes NaCl into the agar and pipettes 0.1 mL of a 50 mU/mL filter-sterilised stock onto the plate, reapplied every 3 to 4 days across a 10-day observation. The 'ACCD altered version' actually used lists every group as '3 sprays of ACCD' and says 'Apply the corresponding NaCl and ACCD by spraying with a spray bottle on the leaves of the plants', with 75 and 100 mM NaCl diluted fresh from a 3M stock, so the slide's spraying matches the protocol that was used and the plant page's 'plates that already hold the treatment' matches only the formal version. Both protocol versions observe for 10 days, so the slide's Day 20 is in neither. Raw file reads: "Apply the corresponding NaCl and ACCD by spraying with a spray bottle on the leaves of the plants"

status_note.zh: Soil Application of Protectant 這份 protocol 收了同一個試驗的兩版。初版用 150 mM NaCl，前處理日寫 0823、0824；開頭註記說因為西方墨點顯示 B. subtilis 裡沒有 ACCD，這兩天的前處理組無效，改版把鹽濃度降到 100 mM，從 0825 開始。所以 150 mM 是 8/23 那次，100 mM 是 wiki 標在 8/29 的重做，兩個數字都真的存在。（原始檔："*SOLUTION: change NaCl concentration to 100mM and do protein dialysis before spraying, pretreatment day from 2 days to 1 day."）
status_note.en: The Soil Application of Protectant protocol holds two versions of the same trial. The initial plan is 150 mM NaCl and names 0823 and 0824 as the pretreatment days; a note at the top then says those pretreatment groups were invalid because the western blot showed no ACCD, and the altered version changes the salt to 100 mM from 0825. So 150 mM is the 23 August trial and 100 mM is the restarted trial the wiki indexes on 29 August; both numbers are real. Raw file reads: "*SOLUTION: change NaCl concentration to 100mM and do protein dialysis before spraying, pretreatment day from 2 days to 1 day."

status_note.en: The Soil Application of Protectant protocol gives n for every arm, identically in both versions: pretreatment, cotreatment, posttreatment and the salt-only control each get '1 pot->3 plants', and the unsalted control gets '3 pots->3 plants'. That is the written design; no raw file records what was actually harvested. Raw file reads: "pretreatment(ACCD+150mM NaCl) 1 pot->3 plants ... control(0 ACCD + 0mM NaCl) 3 pots->3 plants"

title.zh: ACCD 施用到土壤的方式
title.en: How ACCD was applied to soil

statement.zh: 紀錄寫 ACCD (dialysis)「on soil」；Kyle 8/25 問是直接噴灑還是施加在土裡，沒有回答，也沒有劑量。
statement.en: The log says ACCD (dialysis) was applied 'on soil'; Dr. Kyle asked on 25 August whether it was sprayed or added to the soil, and no answer or dose is recorded.

status_note.zh: Soil Application of Protectant protocol 回答了 Kyle 老師 8/25 的問題：ACCD 是噴在葉面，不是灌根，初版與改版都寫「spray 3 sprays of ACCD on the leaves of group」，改版還加上「噴之前先做蛋白透析」（與每日記錄上的「ACCD (dialysis)」標籤一致）。仍缺：ACCD 濃度、每次噴的體積、對照盆噴什麼；八月電子紀錄裡完全沒有這個試驗的條目。（原始檔："spray 3 sprays of ACCD on the leaves of group: pretreatment, 150mM NaCl"）
status_note.en: The Soil Application of Protectant protocol answers Dr. Kyle's question: ACCD was sprayed on the leaves, not drenched, 'spray 3 sprays of ACCD on the leaves of group', in both the initial and the altered version, and the altered version adds 'do protein dialysis before spraying' (which matches the 'ACCD (dialysis)' label in the daily log). Still missing: the ACCD concentration, the volume of a spray, and what the control pots received; the August ELN has no entry for this trial at all. Raw file reads: "spray 3 sprays of ACCD on the leaves of group: pretreatment, 150mM NaCl"

title.zh: 8/26 co-treatment 紀錄
title.en: 26 August co-treatment entry

statement.zh: 8/26 ELN 標題為「Cotreatment + NaCl on soil」，但步驟描述的是在 agar plate 加 75、100 mM NaCl 與 1:500 正瀚 protectant。
statement.en: The 26 August ELN entry is titled 'Cotreatment + NaCl on soil', but its procedure describes 75 and 100 mM NaCl with 1:500 CH protectant added to agar plates.

status_note.zh: 這則紀錄本身自相矛盾，原始檔案無法判定。8/26 條目的 Purpose 寫「在 agar 上長的擬南芥加鹽與保護劑（共處理）」，步驟是 75 與 100 mM NaCl 加 1:500 正翰保護劑施在 agar 盤上。另一方面，Soil Application of Protectant protocol 確實把 0826 排為土耕共處理日，但用的是 ACCD 加 100 mM NaCl 澆在土上，藥劑與施用途徑都不同。所以標題可能屬於土耕 ACCD 時間表，記下來的步驟卻是 agar 的正翰試驗；只有做這件事的 Abigail 能說清楚。（原始檔："Purpose: Add salinity and protectant (co-treatment) on agar grown Arabidopsis"）
status_note.en: The entry is internally contradictory and the raw files do not settle it. The 26 August entry reads 'Purpose: Add salinity and protectant (co-treatment) on agar grown Arabidopsis' and the procedure is 75 and 100 mM NaCl with 1:500 Zhenhan (CH) protectant on agar plates. Separately, the Soil Application of Protectant protocol does schedule 0826 as the soil cotreatment day, but with ACCD and 100 mM NaCl poured on the soil, a different agent and a different route. So the title probably belongs to the soil ACCD schedule while the procedure recorded is the agar CH run; only Abigail, who did it, can say. Raw file reads: "Purpose: Add salinity and protectant (co-treatment) on agar grown Arabidopsis"

status_note.zh: 配方與敘述完全相符（0.92 g ½ MS 粉、0.2 g MES、400 mL 水、pH 5.7–5.8，再加 70.128 g NaCl，正好 3.00 M）。滅菌時間可定為 20 分鐘：七月 ELN 寫「127°C 滅菌 20 分鐘」，Hydroponic medium preparation protocol 也是 20 分鐘。寫「127C 30 min」的是 Plant notebook 裡同一則的副本，所以是那份副本不一致，不是 Experiments 頁。（原始檔："Add 70.128 g of NaCl slowly into the flask ... Autoclave for 20 minutes at 127°C"）
status_note.en: The recipe is exactly as stated (0.92 g 1/2 MS powder, 0.2 g MES, 400 mL water, pH 5.7 to 5.8, then 70.128 g NaCl, which is 3.00 M). The autoclave time resolves to 20 minutes: the July ELN entry says 'Autoclave for 20 minutes at 127C' and so does the Hydroponic medium preparation protocol. It is the copy of this same entry in the Plant notebook that reads '127C for 30min', so that copy is the odd one out, not the Experiments page. Raw file reads: "Add 70.128 g of NaCl slowly into the flask ... Autoclave for 20 minutes at 127°C"

Add 10 mL of 3M NaCl to Box 1, 2, 3, and 4', done by Abby T and Audrey H. Since the record sheet makes Box 1 the control, one of the two documents has the box numbers swapped and no raw file in the corpus says which. statement.zh: 紀錄表寫對 12 天大的阿拉伯芥加熱。Plants 頁寫 10 天大。
statement.en: The record sheet says heat was applied to 12-day-old Arabidopsis. The Plants page says 10-day-old.

status_note.zh: 兩則 ELN 日期相減就是 12 天，所以記錄表正確、Plants 頁的 10 天有誤。Set C 於 7/30 播種（「Plant seeds for set C and vernalize in hydroponic system」），照慣例在 4°C 春化 4 天到 8/3；8/15 施加熱逆境（「hydroponic heat stress testing」，培養箱設 37°C、實測 33°C），正好 12 天。（原始檔："Put all boxes into the incubator(setting 37℃, actual temperature 33℃)"）
status_note.en: The two ELN dates give 12 days, so the record sheet is right and the Plants page's 10-day-old is wrong. Set C was sown on 30 July ('Plant seeds for set C and vernalize in hydroponic system') and put at 4 C for the usual 4 days, which ends 3 August; heat was applied on 15 August ('hydroponic heat stress testing', incubator setting 37 C, actual 33 C), 12 days later. Raw file reads: "Put all boxes into the incubator(setting 37℃, actual temperature 33℃)"

status_note.zh: 8/20 那則一字不差地寫著：「準備 4 個新盒，各加 300 mL 0.1X MS 培養液，標為 D1–D4／在 D3（共處理）加 600 µL CH 保護劑……全部放入加熱箱（設定 50°C、實測 35°C）」。8/21 那則同樣寫設定 50°C、實測 35°C。沒有任何原始檔案說 D 組是 37°C，所以 Plants 頁的 37°C 有誤。（原始檔："Place all boxes into the heat box(setting 50℃, actual temp 35℃)"）
status_note.en: The 20 August entry says it word for word: 'Prepare 4 new boxes, add 300mL of 0.1X MS medium into each box. Label them as D!,D2,D3,D4 / Add 600 uL of CH protectant into D3(co-treatment) ... Place all boxes into the heat box(setting 50C, actual temp 35C)'. The 21 August entry repeats setting 50 C, actual 35 C. No raw file says 37 C for the D set, so the Plants page's 37 C is wrong. Raw file reads: "Place all boxes into the heat box(setting 50℃, actual temp 35℃)"

title.zh: 0.1x MS 配方（原文）
title.en: 0.1x MS recipe as written

statement.zh: 8/21 配製 1500 mL 0.1 MS medium：0.69 g MS 粉（無蔗糖）與 1.02 g MES，pH 4.29 調至 5.70。
statement.en: The 21 August entry for 1500 mL of 0.1 MS medium lists 0.69 g MS powder without sucrose and 1.02 g MES, pH 4.29 adjusted to 5.70.

status_note.zh: 條目內容與敘述相符（0.69 g 無糖 MS 粉、1.02 g MES、1500 mL，初始 pH 4.29、最終 5.70，Sophia Y. 操作、Chars 指導），而且換算確實是 0.1 倍：Hydroponic medium preparation protocol 把 ½ MS 定為 2.3 g/L（「Measuring formula:(2.3g/L*2=4.6)」），因此全濃度 MS 為 4.6 g/L，0.1 倍即 0.46 g/L，正好是 1500 mL 裡的 0.69 g。8/14 那則 0.1 MS 的配方表確實是空的。（原始檔："MS powder without sucrose 0.69g / MES powder 1.02g / ddH₂O 1500mL ... Initial pH:4.29, final pH:5.70"）
status_note.en: The entry is as quoted (0.69 g MS powder without sucrose, 1.02 g MES, 1500 mL, initial pH 4.29, final 5.70, done by Sophia Y., supervised by Chars), and the arithmetic does check out as 0.1x: the Hydroponic medium preparation protocol fixes 1/2 MS at 2.3 g/L ('Measuring formula:(2.3g/L*2=4.6)'), so full-strength MS is 4.6 g/L and 0.1x is 0.46 g/L, which is exactly 0.69 g in 1500 mL. The 14 August 0.1 MS entry really does have an empty recipe table. Raw file reads: "MS powder without sucrose 0.69g / MES powder 1.02g / ddH₂O 1500mL ... Initial pH:4.29, final pH:5.70"
